cards.name: Bishop Polish
cards.description: One bishop can jump exactly one piece, twice.

cards.name: Bishop's Stroll
cards.description: Once, one of your bishops may step a single square straight up, down, left or right (capturing allowed), changing the color of its world forever.

cards.name: Castle Quiet
cards.description: When you castle, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Crowned Calm
cards.description: The first time one of your pawns promotes, your nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Doorstop
cards.description: Choose an empty square beside your king: no enemy piece may move onto it for 3 turns. When placed, every enemy piece (their king excepted) standing next to that square is stuck for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Field Glasses
cards.description: Every enemy piece currently standing in your half of the board lights up until your opponent replies, and the spotted pieces hold their fire: they cannot capture on that turn.

cards.name: First Light
cards.description: The first capture you make suspends your nerf for your next turn.

cards.name: Garden Fence
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, for their following 2 turns they cannot capture your pawns standing in your half of the board.

cards.name: Grace Note
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next turn, gain 1 draft reroll, and learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Gum Drop
cards.description: Drop chewing gum under one enemy knight, bishop, rook or queen: it is stuck fast on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Hairline Crack
cards.description: Every one of your pieces that no other piece of yours defends lights up until your opponent replies, and the loose stone nearest your king is mortared: it cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Kind Omen
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns. If that has not happened by your twelfth turn, the unused charge becomes 1 draft reroll instead.

cards.name: Knight's Errand
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may move a single square in any direction (capturing allowed).

cards.name: Leapfrog
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may hop diagonally forward over an adjacent piece, landing on the empty square beyond (never onto the final rank).

cards.name: Lucky Coin
cards.description: Gain 1 draft reroll. Spend a reroll within your next two draft offers and the coin lands heads: you gain that reroll back.

cards.name: Morning Stretch
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next turn, and gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Muddy Boots
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance on their next turn, and every one of their pawns lights up until they reply.

cards.name: Night Watch
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Pawn Umbrella
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, none of your pawns can be captured on their following turn.

cards.name: Promise of Rest
cards.description: The first time one of your pieces crosses into your opponent's half, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Seven League Boots
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may stride up to three squares straight forward across empty squares (never onto the final rank). In exchange, your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Shared Silence
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, both players' nerfs are suspended for their following turn.

cards.name: Shoelace Knot
cards.description: Tie one enemy pawn's laces together: it cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Side Shuffle
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may step one square sideways onto an empty square. The square it lands on lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Small Ritual
cards.description: The next 3 times you move your king, your nerf is suspended for one of your turns, beginning after your opponent's following move.

cards.name: Stutter Step
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, they cannot move the piece they just moved.

cards.name: Tiptoe
cards.description: Once, your king may move two squares in a straight line, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Vaulting Pole
cards.description: Once, after your opponent's next move, one of your pawns may vault straight over a piece directly ahead of it, landing on the empty square beyond (never onto the final rank).

cards.name: Warm Soup
cards.description: Thaw one of your pieces that is frozen or stuck: it can move again on your next turn.

cards.name: Watchman's Lantern
cards.description: Every enemy piece currently aiming at your king lights up until your opponent replies, and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Wheelbarrow
cards.description: Two of your pieces standing side by side (kings excepted) swap squares. Pawns cannot be wheeled onto a first or last rank.

cards.name: Butterfingers
cards.description: Your opponent's queen cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Ancient Custom
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may capture an enemy pawn standing directly beside it en passant, as though it had just double-stepped. That pawn is then rooted and cannot move again on your next turn. Reaching your last rank this way promotes to a queen.

cards.name: Postern Gate
cards.description: An old side door swings open in the keep wall: your right to castle on both sides is restored, even if your king or rooks have already moved. Castling, as ever, can never be used to make a capture.

cards.name: Cold Feet
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, their pawns cannot capture for their following 3 turns.

cards.name: Cold Open
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their queen for their next turn.

cards.name: Cold Snap
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece, other than the king or your opponent's single most valuable piece, for 1 of its owner's turns.

cards.name: Deep Breath
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for one move, beginning after your opponent's next reply, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Diagonal Step
cards.description: Your king moves like a bishop on your very next move only: whether or not you take it, the charge is then spent.

cards.name: Drawbridge
cards.description: Your opponent cannot castle for their next 6 turns, though their first castling attempt slips through as one escape.

cards.name: Escape Hatch
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns; after your opponent's next move, your king swaps places with it, once.

cards.name: Extra Glance
cards.description: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Ferz King
cards.description: Your king may move two squares diagonally to an empty square, twice per game. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Lanternlight
cards.description: For your next 2 turns your king may move two squares in a straight line, as long as the first square is empty.

cards.name: Glowmoss Ward
cards.description: Soft light grows over your king's square and the eight squares around it: pieces standing there cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Thistledown
cards.description: Burrs tangle the enemy cavalry: for their next 2 turns, enemy knights may move but may not take anything.

cards.name: Ghost Pawn
cards.description: One pawn may advance two squares by passing through a single enemy piece directly ahead of it, landing on the empty square beyond without capturing, once.

cards.name: Consolation Scratcher
cards.description: Scratch it: 50% a random pawn of yours advances a free square, 30% you gain a draft reroll, 20% dust and a lovely sentiment.

cards.name: Loaded Dice
cards.description: Pick a pawn and roll two dice. Seven or more: it advances a square. Boxcars (twelve): it advances two. Under seven: the loaded dice grant one free re-roll before giving up.

cards.name: Penny Slots
cards.description: Pull the lever: half the time nothing, 35% one random pawn of yours sidesteps, 15% jackpot: a fresh pawn appears on your second rank.

cards.name: Raffle Ticket
cards.description: For your next 3 turns the drum spins after your move: 1 chance in 3 each time that a random pawn of yours marches a free square forward.

cards.name: River Card
cards.description: You and your opponent are each dealt a hidden card, ace low king high. Higher card wins: the winner steals a random enemy pawn, which walks across and defects. A tie splits the pot and nothing happens.

cards.name: Half Step
cards.description: One pawn moves diagonally forward without capturing, twice.

cards.name: Heavy Boots
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot double-step for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Bad Omen
cards.description: A dark omen is read over their camp: on your opponent's 3rd turn from now, it strikes, and for that one turn they may move only a pawn or their king. They can see it coming and set up around it.

cards.name: Beneath Her Dignity
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their queen refuses to capture pawns.

cards.name: Borrowed Boots
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their king cannot step diagonally, straight steps only. The first diagonal step slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

cards.name: Caught Mid Stride
cards.description: Time hiccups: the piece your opponent moved on their last turn is frozen for 1 of their turns, exactly where it stands. Kings are never caught.

cards.name: Cobweb Corners
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, great webs fill all four corners for their following 3 turns: their pieces may not stop on the corner squares or the diagonal squares beside them (b2, g2, b7, g7).

cards.name: Cold Porridge
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns the infantry refuses breakfast every other morning: on the 1st and 3rd of those turns their pawns cannot move.

cards.name: Creaky Axles
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their rooks may slide at most 4 squares.

cards.name: Dusty Boots
cards.description: One of your opponent's pawns, chosen at random, becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns: it can only shuffle a single square. Their most advanced pawn is spared and is never chosen.

cards.name: Heavy Pockets
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns their pawns cannot make two square advances. Single steps only.

cards.name: Loose Horseshoe
cards.description: One enemy knight you target loses a shoe after your opponent's next move and becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns: no leaping, only a one square hobble.

cards.name: Mild Sting
cards.description: A wasp circles their camp, in plain sight: after 3 of your opponent's turns it settles on one of their pawns, chosen at random. That pawn gets one legal escape move, then is stung and frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: No Man's Reach
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may not land on your two back ranks.

cards.name: One Way Cloister
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their bishops may only move toward the a side of the board.

cards.name: Pebble in the Shoe
cards.description: One enemy pawn you target stops to shake out a pebble: it is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Pigeon Perch
cards.description: A pigeon lands on their king and refuses to leave for 3 of their turns. Not wishing to disturb it, their king does not move on their next turn.

cards.name: Plush Cavalry
cards.description: Your opponent's knights become adorable plush toys for 6 of their turns; stuffed hooves cannot fight, and after their next move their knights cannot capture for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: The Puddle
cards.description: Choose an empty square: it becomes a deep puddle for 2 of your opponent's turns, and none of their pieces will stop in it. The first piece the puddle would turn away may step in once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Red Tape
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft offer excludes draft manipulation cards, and after that draft resolves you gain one reroll. The paperwork was misfiled.

cards.name: Second Thoughts
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they cannot castle. The king keeps re reading the paperwork.

cards.name: Sleepy Sentry
cards.description: One of your opponent's pawns on the a or h file, chosen at random, gets drowsy. It has one legal escape move, then falls asleep at its post and is frozen for 2 of their turns. If no edge pawn remains, nothing happens.

cards.name: Squeaky Wheel
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot capture on their next turn.

cards.name: Tangled Reins
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their knights may not land on any edge square of the board.

cards.name: Thin Ice Patch
cards.description: The two central squares on your side of the midline (your d and e entry squares) turn to thin ice: your opponent's pieces may not stop on them for their next turn. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Will o' Wisps
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, wisp lights dance through their camp: each of their turns, one random empty square in their half becomes briefly impassable to them.

cards.name: Knock Knees
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot land on the rim for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Little Leap
cards.description: One pawn jumps a single blocking piece directly ahead, twice.

cards.name: Long Knight
cards.description: One knight makes two knight-leaps in a single move, once.

cards.name: Molasses
cards.description: Your opponent's queen slides at most 3 squares for their next 3 turns, though it may make one longer move to escape.

cards.name: Nudge
cards.description: Push one enemy pawn back one square if empty behind, once.

cards.name: Airmail
cards.description: Once, your a- or b-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly in front of it.

cards.name: Back Alley
cards.description: Once, your a-file pawn may step one square sideways to the b-file. The destination must be empty; not a capture.

cards.name: Bread for the Table
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a d- or e-file pawn carries the loaves one square forward. The square ahead must be empty, and no enemy piece may be attacking it.

cards.name: Bricklayer
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your queenside pawns (files a through d) cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Change of Address
cards.description: When you castle, gain a draft reroll. If you have not castled by your 12th move, gain a draft reroll instead. One use.

cards.name: Closed for Cleaning
cards.description: Use once as a free action: rope off one empty square on your back rank. Nobody at all, yours or theirs, may end a move there for the next 2 turns.

cards.name: Doorman
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your pawns adjacent to your king cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Fetch the Flour
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a pawn on files a, b, c, d advances one square immediately. The square ahead must be empty.

cards.name: Fresh Sod
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pieces cannot end a non-capturing move on the four center squares (a capture may still land there).

cards.name: Garden Hedge
cards.description: Your queen may hop over an adjacent friendly pawn in any direction, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty. The hop becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Gate Ledger
cards.description: The first enemy bishop, rook, or queen to leave its back rank is marked until you reply, and any temporary shield protecting it is removed. One use.

cards.name: Goat Track
cards.description: Once, your g-file pawn may climb two squares from wherever it stands, forward or backward, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Hired Muscle
cards.description: Use once as a free action: one of your knights or bishops cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Homing Pigeon
cards.description: Twice, your h-file pawn may capture the enemy piece directly in front of it. The second capture must be on a different square than the first.

cards.name: Intermission
cards.description: The first 2 times you give check, gain a draft reroll. 2 uses.

cards.name: Invitation Only
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pieces cannot end a move on your back two ranks. The ban is spent on that one opponent turn whether or not it actually turns a move away.

cards.name: King's Road Watch
cards.description: For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move on your king's file is marked until you reply and loses any temporary shield.

cards.name: Long Jump
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a jump of exactly 3 diagonally, clearing anything between. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Old Post Road
cards.description: Once, on one of your first 7 moves, your d-file pawn may cover two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty. The coach never waits: the charge is spent if you leave the run on offer.

cards.name: Palace Floor Plan
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy piece adjacent to the enemy king flashes on the board until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Parade Elephant
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make an elephant hop, exactly 2 diagonally, jumping anything between. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Parasol Bearer
cards.description: Use once as a free action: your queen cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Personal Space
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pieces cannot end a non-capturing move next to your king (a capture may still land there).

cards.name: Piggyback
cards.description: One of your pawns may hop over the friendly pawn directly ahead of it, landing on the square directly beyond, once. The landing square must be empty. The hop becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Plaza Lantern
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move on the four center squares is marked until you reply and loses any temporary shield.

cards.name: Private Booth
cards.description: Use once as a free action, while your king still sits at his own table: reserve one empty square beside him. No enemy piece may end a move there during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Royal Barter
cards.description: Use once as a free action: if your queen still stands on its home square (d1 for white) and your bishop on c1, they swap places.

cards.name: Second Harvest
cards.description: After your 12th move, gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Second Thoughts
cards.description: Once, after your 6th move, one of your pawns on the d- or e-file may step one square straight backward onto an empty square.

cards.name: Siege Survey
cards.description: Use once as a free action: every enemy queen and rook flashes on the board until your opponent replies, along with each of your pieces they are aimed at.

cards.name: Signal Rocket
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a launch of exactly 4 straight, clearing anything between. It may capture on landing. The leap becomes available only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Special Order
cards.description: Your next draft is dealt from tier 2.

cards.name: Spice Run
cards.description: Use once as a free action: a b- or g-file pawn still on its home square steps one square forward. The square ahead must be empty.

cards.name: Store Credit
cards.description: Gain one extra draft reroll.

cards.name: Tea Leaves
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Use once as a free action: flip a fair coin. Heads: learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer. Tails: nothing but a sheepish flash on your king.

cards.name: Tower Torches
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, any enemy piece that ends a move next to one of your rooks is marked until you reply. The first time the patrol marks a piece, you gain a draft reroll.

cards.name: Towpath
cards.description: Once, your a-file or b-file pawn may advance two squares from wherever it stands. Both squares must be empty; it cannot capture this way.

cards.name: Transfer Window
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Tripwire Bell
cards.description: The first enemy piece to end a move in your half is marked until you reply, and you gain a draft reroll. One use.

cards.name: Vizier's Errand
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a single step to an adjacent square, straight only. It may capture on landing. A turn where the leap is on offer but not taken spends one use.

cards.name: Walking Pace, Please
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy pawns cannot make two-square moves.

cards.name: Wet Floor Sign
cards.description: Use once as a free action: choose an empty square directly in front of one of your pawns. Enemy pieces cannot end a move there for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Window Washer
cards.description: Once, one of your bishops may slide along its diagonals passing through up to 1 friendly piece (never capturing them), landing beyond on an empty square; it cannot capture on landing.

cards.name: Zebra Crossing
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a zebra leap, 3 by 2, in any direction. Not a capture; the landing square must be empty.

cards.name: Backwards Hat
cards.description: One pawn may capture straight ahead on its next move.

cards.name: Checkmate Rehearsal
cards.description: Run the rehearsal, once: every enemy piece currently attacking one of your pieces is spotlighted, and the director's notes include one free draft reroll.

cards.name: Chess Boxing
cards.description: The kings put the gloves on: a 50/50 bout. The winner's player immediately gains one extra move.

cards.name: Fresh Socks
cards.description: Your next move flags the enemy piece that moved last until your opponent replies, and gives you one draft reroll. New socks, new you.

cards.name: Lucky Penny
cards.description: Pick a pawn and flip the coin: 50% heads, the pawn advances one square now (the jackpot); tails, it stays put and the failed flip is banked as two draft rerolls.

cards.name: Manager's Challenge
cards.description: Challenge your opponent's last move: 50% their piece is marched back to the square it came from (if free) and stunned for 1 turn; 50% the call goes against you and your own last-moved piece is stunned for 1 turn.

cards.name: Mirror Shield

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / board-state gate

cards.description: The next time one of your knights or bishops is captured, the shield flashes back and removes a random enemy pawn. If they have no pawns, it keeps waiting.

cards.name: Name Tag
cards.description: Stick a name tag on one enemy piece. It is Gary now. Whichever of your pieces takes Gary cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Nightlight
cards.description: A little lamp clicks on: enemy knights cannot end a move next to your king for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Pebble Toss
cards.description: Choose an unmoved enemy pawn; it loses its two-square first move on your opponent's next turn. The pebble is spent after that turn even if the pawn stays put.

cards.name: Pet Rock
cards.description: One of your pawns cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn. The rock is watching.

cards.name: Pigeon Post
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, every enemy piece attacking your queen is marked by a landing pigeon and loses any temporary shield covering it.

cards.name: Spare Button
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, if you lose a pawn, a fresh one is stitched onto its file's home square if that square is empty. One use.

cards.name: Static Cling
cards.description: The enemy piece that moved last is stuck fast and cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Sugar Glider
cards.description: One knight's next move may be a (2,2) diagonal glide instead.

cards.name: Tiny Trebuchet
cards.description: Launch one of your pawns two squares straight ahead, once. Both squares must be empty; no capturing on landing. It arms only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Wet Paint
cards.description: Choose a square; enemy pieces cannot end their move on it for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Window Shopping
cards.description: You know exactly which shelf you want: your next draft is dealt from tier 2, and once you have seen it you gain one reroll.

cards.name: Quiet March
cards.description: One pawn can move backward one square, once. It cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Reprieve
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns, beginning after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Rook Slide
cards.description: One rook moves one square diagonally, twice.

cards.name: Royal Restraint
cards.description: Your opponent's king cannot capture for their next 4 turns, though it may make one capture to escape.

cards.name: Sentinel Pawn
cards.description: One pawn may capture an enemy piece two squares diagonally ahead, twice.

cards.name: Slippery Grip
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, their rooks slide at most 3 squares for their following 4 turns.

cards.name: Snap Freeze
cards.description: Freeze the piece that last moved for 1 of its turns.

cards.name: Promotion Anxiety
cards.description: Your opponent's first pawn promotion within their next 4 turns is held back one of their turns; the poised pawn stays on its seventh rank. Promotions after the first go through.

cards.name: Steady March
cards.description: Two pawns each advance one square immediately.

cards.name: Stiff Joints
cards.description: Your opponent's queen cannot move diagonally for their next 3 turns, though it may make one diagonal move to escape.

cards.name: Stream Sniper
cards.description: You found their stream: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and your own next draft shows three cards to pick from.

cards.name: Teleport Knight
cards.description: Move one knight to any empty square within the 3x3 box around it, once. It cannot capture with this move.

cards.name: Tempo Shuffle
cards.description: Move one pawn sideways one square, once. Gain one draft reroll when it resolves.

cards.name: Toll Gate
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture en passant for their next 5 turns.

cards.name: Vault
cards.description: One rook jumps its own pawn to the far side, twice.

cards.name: Stone the Pawns
cards.description: For their next 3 turns your opponent's pawns cannot make two-square advances.

cards.name: Walnut Shell
cards.description: Crack it open: free one of your pieces from any freeze or walnut hex. If none of your pieces is stuck, eat the nut instead: gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Watchtower
cards.description: The tower spots the cavalry a mile out: enemy knights cannot move into your half of the board, except to capture, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Quicksand Patch
cards.description: For their next 2 turns your opponent's pawns cannot make two-square advances.

cards.name: Updraft
cards.description: One knight may make a longer 3-by-1 leap, once; after the leap, gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Anchor
cards.description: Choose one piece; after your opponent's next move it can no longer be pushed or swapped by enemy buffs, for the game.

cards.name: Apple
cards.description: Feed one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns and may immediately step one square to an empty square beside it.

cards.name: Banana Peel
cards.description: Toss peels on two empty squares, visible to both players. The first enemy piece other than the king to step on each slips one square back toward its home rank and is too dazed to move on its owner's next turn.

cards.name: Blunted Lance
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot land on any square defended by one of your pawns, for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Bartered Calm
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns. In exchange, your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Bottled Courage
cards.description: Uncork it: your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and every piece of yours standing beside him cannot be captured for those 2 turns either.

cards.name: Boundary Stones
cards.description: Mark 2 empty squares in your half: no enemy piece may move onto them for 4 turns.

cards.name: Confetti Cannon
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) puts on sunglasses for the rest of the game (purely decorative) and struts uncapturable through your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Coupon Book
cards.description: Your next draft offer rolls one tier higher. The redemption fee is one of your rerolls, if you have any.

cards.name: Crowned Strider
cards.description: For your next 4 turns, your king may move two squares in a straight line, if both squares are empty.

cards.name: Day Laborer
cards.description: Place a pawn on an empty square in your half. It works 5 of your turns, then leaves the board.

cards.name: Dowager's Patience
cards.description: While your opponent has a queen on the board and you do not, your nerf is suspended, beginning the turn after each of your opponent's moves.

cards.name: Field Stitches
cards.description: Return one of your captured pawns to an empty square on your second rank.

cards.name: Half Step Back
cards.description: Once, one of your pawns may retreat one square straight back onto an empty square (never onto your back rank).

cards.name: Hearth Ring
cards.description: Every one of your pieces standing beside your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Herald's Truce
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces (your king excepted): for your opponent's next turn it cannot be captured and your king cannot be taken.

cards.name: Kettle On
cards.description: Put the kettle on: every one of your frozen or stuck pieces thaws at once.

cards.name: Militia Call
cards.description: Place a new pawn on an empty square on your second rank.

cards.name: Party Hat
cards.description: Put a party hat on any piece on the board, forever (purely decorative). If it is one of yours, it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns: nobody ruins a party.

cards.name: Pawn's Lullaby
cards.description: The next 2 times you move a pawn, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Pocket Shield
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Slipped Collar
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures your queen, your nerf is suspended for your next 8 turns.

cards.name: Slow Doors
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 2 turns, though they may still capture.

cards.name: Spare Button
cards.description: A pawn slips into your pocket, ready to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn (the drop spends that turn).

cards.name: Steady Hands
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next turn, and none of your pawns can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Stowaway
cards.description: After your next 5 turns, a pawn is discovered aboard and joins your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: Third Wind
cards.description: After your next 6 turns, your nerf is suspended for the 3 turns that follow.

cards.name: Trophy Rest
cards.description: The next 2 times you capture a knight, bishop, rook or queen, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Understudy
cards.description: The first time one of your pawns is captured, a fresh pawn joins your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: Bubble Wrap
cards.description: Shrink-wrap one of your own pieces: it cannot be captured for 3 turns, but it can only move for the last of them. Your king cannot be chosen.

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.description: Two pawns in front of your king cannot be captured for 3 turns.

cards.name: Cornered King
cards.description: Desperation teaches strange footwork: once, while you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your king may move like a knight.

cards.name: Divine Right
cards.description: No peasant may slay a king: enemy pawns can never capture your king, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Scarecrow
cards.description: Prop a scarecrow on an empty square in your half: it stands there as one of your pawns but is rooted and can never move, for the rest of the game. It blocks lines for both sides and can be captured like any pawn.

cards.name: Bishop's Blessing
cards.description: The clergy is above the cavalry's reach: enemy knights can never capture your bishops, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Coronation Bonus
cards.description: The crowning is worth a stolen hour: the first time one of your pawns promotes, you gain 30 seconds on your clock. In untimed games it grants nothing.

cards.name: Rally to the King
cards.description: Call the nearest blade home: teleport any one of your pieces (your king aside) to an empty square directly adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Castle Early
cards.description: Castle even if your king or rooks have already moved. When you next castle, your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Chill Guy
cards.description: He's just a chill guy: every freeze and every walnut currently stuck to YOUR pieces melts off. A free action. Lowkey he doesn't even care.

cards.name: Coconut Bonk
cards.description: Drop a coconut on one enemy piece: it is stunned and cannot move for its next turn. Kings are too hard-headed.

cards.name: Cornerstone
cards.description: Your rooks cannot be captured while they stand on your back rank, for the game.

cards.name: Let It Ride
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Flip a coin and let your winnings ride. Each heads bumps the prize and flips again, up to three. One heads pays 40 seconds, two a knight in your pocket, three a knight and a bishop plus 20 seconds. Tails first loses the ante, your weakest pawn.

cards.name: Cut Purse
cards.description: Steal one of your opponent's unspent cards of tier 1, then take a draft reroll. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Defiance
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf until your opponent's next capture, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Draft Insight
cards.description: Your next draft is fated to offer tier 3 cards.

cards.name: Emotional Support Pawn
cards.description: A small round friend refuses to leave your side: place a new pawn on an empty square right beside your king.

cards.name: Evil Eye
cards.description: One enemy piece you choose cannot capture anything for 4 of their turns. It may still move. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Fey Step
cards.description: One of your knights or bishops slips into the hedgerow and steps out behind their lines: move it to any empty square on your opponent's back two ranks, once. The step lands on an empty square only and cannot capture.

cards.name: Firecracker
cards.description: Startle one enemy piece (not the king): it retreats one square toward its home rank and is too rattled to move on its owner's next turn.

cards.name: Firm Footing
cards.description: Choose one piece: it and your pawns on the squares beside it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Fly Swatter
cards.description: One enemy knight is stunned for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Hearthbread
cards.description: Choose an empty square on your first two ranks. A new pawn appears there.

cards.name: Fogbank
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops cannot move more than 2 squares for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Moonlit Stride
cards.description: For your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square straight up, down or sideways.

cards.name: Fortress
cards.description: One piece standing next to your king becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 4 turns. Your king itself is not shielded.

cards.name: Free Retreat
cards.description: Return your last-moved piece to the square it came from, once.

cards.name: Card Counting
cards.description: Three draws, 55% each, streak ends on a miss: one hit and a random pawn sidesteps; two hits and a random pawn also advances; three hits and a fresh pawn joins your second rank.

cards.name: Double Down Draft
cards.description: Push your chips in, half and half: 50% you take BOTH cards of your next draft, 50% your next draft is skipped entirely while the dealer smiles.

cards.name: Hardship Jackpot
cards.description: The misery meter pays out: 60% a pawn appears on your second rank, 25% one of your frozen or stuck pieces is thawed, 15% the jackpot doubles: a pawn AND a thaw.

cards.name: Rigged Raffle
cards.description: Enter your opponent in a raffle they never asked to join: their next move passes untouched, then for their following 3 turns, 1 chance in 3 after each of their moves that the piece they just moved is glued in place for a turn.

cards.name: Three-Card Monte
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Follow the queen, one chance in three: find her and you win a free reroll plus a look at your opponent's next draft offer. Miss and the dealer tips his hat.

cards.name: Guarded King
cards.description: Enemy pieces cannot move to the squares diagonally adjacent to your king for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Handstand Pushup
cards.description: Flip one pawn upside down. Forever it may also step and capture straight back or diagonally back toward your own side, but never onto its own back rank.

cards.name: Held Breath
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for this turn and your next turn, used at the moment you choose. Cannot be used while your king is in check.

cards.name: Blood IOU
cards.description: The next time your opponent captures one of your pieces within their next 6 turns, the debt comes due: they lose 12 seconds of clock (nothing in an untimed game) and a draft reroll if they hold one. Held blades for 6 turns and it expires unpaid.

cards.name: The Long Road Home

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Lay a calling on one enemy knight, bishop or rook: every move it makes must bring it closer to its own back rank. The curse lifts the moment it stands on that rank, and otherwise fades after 5 of their turns.

cards.name: Tarnished Crown
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn they promote arrives exhausted and frozen for 2 of their turns. The very first pawn to promote escapes and arrives free; every coronation after it pays.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece that captures is seized by frenzy and must capture again on their very next turn if any capture is open to it. If it has none, the frenzy passes and they move freely.

cards.name: Handed Down
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns one enemy piece is hobbled to at most 2 squares a move. Capturing the bearer does not end it: the curse leaps to whichever of their pieces is nearest. Kings never take it.

cards.name: Wrong Foot
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every piece they move must land on the opposite colour square to their last landing: light, then dark, then light. Their king is exempt, and if no legal move fits the pattern they move freely that turn.

cards.name: Blunted Horseshoes
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, a knight of theirs that moved on their previous turn is too winded to capture.

cards.name: Borrowed Ladder
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their bishops may not move backward toward their own back rank.

cards.name: Borrowed Lantern
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, they cannot capture anything standing on a dark square. The lantern only lights half the world.

cards.name: Bridge Toll
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, only their pawns and king may cross the midline into your half. The bridge keeper distrusts officers.

cards.name: Clumsy Heralds
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, every check they give is followed by apologies: on their following turn they may only move a pawn or their king.

cards.name: Cold Barracks
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their rooks may not stop on their own back rank. The first rook to try slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. The barracks heating failed.

cards.name: Cold Start
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, the first knight of theirs to move pulls a muscle and is frozen for 1 of their turns immediately after.

cards.name: Famine
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot capture any of your pawns. The granary is warded.

cards.name: Flinching Blades
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they may not capture from an adjacent square: every kill must come from at least 2 squares away. Kings are exempt.

cards.name: Frost Footprints
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 2 turns, every square one of their pieces leaves ices over behind it: no piece of theirs may stop there on their following turn.

cards.name: Glacier Gate
cards.description: A wall of ice fills the four center squares: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on d4, e4, d5 or e5 for their next turn.

cards.name: Gum Wrapper
cards.description: One enemy pawn you target is wrapped up like a sweet: after your opponent's next move it becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns, shuffling one square at best.

cards.name: Halo of the Crown
cards.description: A faint halo guards your court: for your opponent's next 3 turns, they cannot capture any piece standing adjacent to your king. The first such capture slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

cards.name: Hand Cramp
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 2 turns, any rook they move seizes up afterward and is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Honey Spill
cards.description: A barrel of honey bursts over the stables: all but one of your opponent's knights are stuck fast and cannot move for 2 of their turns. The first knight the honey reaches wriggles free.

cards.name: House Arrest
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their king may not move beyond their own second rank.

cards.name: Leaking Boats
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces standing on the a and h files are too busy bailing water to fight: they cannot capture.

cards.name: Moth Eaten Gloves
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their queen may only capture on light squares. Her dark glove is full of holes.

cards.name: Moths in the Banner
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot move on their next turn: the regimental colors are being mended.

cards.name: Muddy Moat
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their pawns on the d and e files cannot advance. The center is a soup.

cards.name: Narrow Lane
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their bishops, rooks and queen may slide at most 2 squares.

cards.name: No Doubling
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their pawns refuse to share a file: a pawn may not capture onto a file that already holds another of their pawns.

cards.name: No Trampling
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their knights may not capture pawns. The first such capture slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. The cavalry has been sued before.

cards.name: Paddock Fence
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may not land in your half of the board. The first knight the fence would stop may leap across once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Reined Back
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their knights may not leap toward your side of the board: sideways and backward leaps only.

cards.name: Short Stirrups
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may not land adjacent to your king. The horses refuse the last stretch.

cards.name: Shrunken Shoes
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, none of their pieces may move more than 3 squares.

cards.name: Sticky Floorboards
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their pieces standing on their own back rank cannot move, except their most valuable such piece, which stays free. Someone waxed the throne room.

cards.name: Tea Break
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn, only pieces within 2 squares of their king may move. The first piece they try to move from further out slips through as one escape.

cards.name: The Quarrel
cards.description: The royal couple is not speaking: for your opponent's next 4 turns, their queen may not end a move adjacent to their king.

cards.name: Toad Pond
cards.description: Choose an empty square: for your opponent's next 6 turns it is a cursed pond, and the first piece of theirs to stop in it becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns. Kings do not fit in ponds.

cards.name: Two Step
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns, no move may cover the same distance as their previous move. The dance master insists on variety.

cards.name: Vegetarian Vows
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their bishops will not capture pawns. A dietary matter of conscience.

cards.name: Wet Powder
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their rooks may not capture along files: straight ahead kills misfire, only sideways captures along ranks work.

cards.name: Winded Monarch
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their king cannot move on two consecutive turns: after any king move, it must rest a turn. The first blocked king move slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds.

cards.name: Imp Familiar
cards.description: A smug little imp perches on an empty square of your back rank and fights as a bishop for 3 of your turns, then scampers back through the veil. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Ironbound Rook
cards.description: Bind one enemy rook to its rank: for 4 of their turns it cannot leave the rank it stands on. Its first move may still break to any rank; after that it may only slide sideways along the rank it then holds.

cards.name: Lame Horses
cards.description: Your opponent's knights cannot move backward for their next 4 turns, except the first knight to retreat may do so once before the lameness sets in.

cards.name: Leaden Queen
cards.description: Your opponent's queen can only capture at arm's length: for their next 3 turns her captures must be exactly one square away. The first capture the curse would deny is allowed once.

cards.name: Ley Line
cards.description: You wake the old current sleeping under the board: choose one of your pieces and an empty square on its own file. After your opponent's next move, it rides the current there.

cards.name: Long Castle Anywhere
cards.description: Regain castling rights, and queenside castling ignores the b-file square. When you castle, spend your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Tight Formation
cards.description: Pawns still standing on your second rank cannot be captured, for the game. Once a pawn steps forward it is on its own.

cards.name: Loosen the Leash
cards.description: Each of your next 3 captures loosens the leash: after your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended for one of your turns.

cards.name: Mind Nudge
cards.description: Force one enemy pawn to advance one square where empty, once. Using it spends the card even if the push cannot resolve.

cards.name: Moai Head
cards.description: Drop a moai on an empty square. For the next 4 turns of each side no piece may move onto it; then it crumbles.

cards.name: Muscle Up
cards.description: Explosive pull-up: take one of your pieces except the king and hurl it straight up its own file to any empty square, phasing past your own pieces but stopping short of the first enemy in its lane. Once.

cards.name: No Man's Land
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, they cannot enter the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Onett
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, a townsperson reports for duty: a new pawn takes the nearest open square on your pawn line, or just ahead of it if the line is packed.

cards.name: Chimney Sweep
cards.description: Once, one of your bishops may slide along its diagonals passing through up to 2 friendly pieces (never capturing them), landing beyond as normal.

cards.name: Do-Si-Do
cards.description: Once, your king may hop sideways over an adjacent friendly piece on his rank, landing on the empty square directly beyond.

cards.name: Exchange Student
cards.description: The first of your pieces to enter the enemy half cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn, except by a pawn. One use, automatic.

cards.name: Full Coverage
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next turn, your pawns can never be captured en passant.

cards.name: Lady in Waiting
cards.description: The first time an enemy piece attacks your queen, that queen cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn. The guard ends once it has turned that reply aside. One use.

cards.name: New Locks
cards.description: When you castle, your king cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn, except by a pawn. One use.

cards.name: Old Counselor
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a single diagonal step to an adjacent square. It may capture on landing.

cards.name: Quiet Cloister
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, enemy bishops cannot end a move in your half.

cards.name: Sampler Platter
cards.description: Your next draft offers three cards instead of two.

cards.name: Siege Wagon
cards.description: Once, one of your knights may make a wagon hop, exactly 2 straight, jumping anything between. It may capture on landing.

cards.name: Stable Groom
cards.description: One use: the first time an enemy piece attacks one of your knights, that knight cannot be captured for one turn, but the guard begins only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Stage Armor
cards.description: The first time you give check, the piece that gave check cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn, and the guard ends the moment that piece captures. One use.

cards.name: Tower Warden
cards.description: The first time an enemy piece attacks one of your rooks, that rook cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn, except by a pawn. One use.

cards.name: Victory Lap
cards.description: When you make your first capture of the game, the capturing piece cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn, and the guard ends the moment that piece captures. One use.

cards.name: Oracle's Eye
cards.description: The oracle inhales the vapors and names a better price: your bank offer improves by one tier, unless your opponent's next draft is already skipped, in which case the oracle offers nothing.

cards.name: Broom Sweep
cards.description: Pick a rank. After your opponent's next move, every enemy pawn on it is swept one square back toward its own side, wherever the square behind it is empty.

cards.name: Chariot Lessons
cards.description: Hitch up one rook: for 5 of your turns it is a chariot, keeping its rook moves and adding one-square diagonal steps.

cards.name: Compost Heap
cards.description: For your next 5 turns, gain 13 seconds whenever one of your pawns is captured.

cards.name: Encore
cards.description: If your next move puts the enemy king in danger, you immediately move again. That bonus move cannot capture.

cards.name: Free Sample
cards.description: The next shared draft round arrives one full turn sooner for both players.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.description: Mark one enemy piece (not the king). After your opponent's next move, pull it one square toward you along its file, if it is still there and the square behind it is empty.

cards.name: Gravity Flip
cards.description: For 2 of your turns, your pawns may also step one square straight backward onto an empty square. No backward captures.

cards.name: Growth Ring
cards.description: Bless one square and its neighbors: for your opponent's next 4 turns, your pieces standing in that area cannot be captured by enemy pawns.

cards.name: Loading Screen Tip
cards.description: A parody loading tip plays. After your opponent's next move, the spotlight lands on the cheapest undefended enemy piece; if everything is defended, it highlights their cheapest piece anyway.

cards.name: Loan Shark
cards.description: Gain 60 seconds now. In 8 of your turns the shark collects: unless you have captured 3 or more pieces by then, your next draft is skipped and your opponent pockets a free reroll.

cards.name: Loose Floorboard
cards.description: Rig one empty square: the first enemy piece that ends a move there is bounced straight back to the square it came from. One use.

cards.name: Loot Filter
cards.description: Gain a draft reroll. Filter bonus: the first time an offer deals you two cards of the same category, the filter flags the dupes and refunds another reroll.

cards.name: Masterclass
cards.description: One pawn graduates: it permanently gains the ability to capture straight ahead.

cards.name: Midas Gauntlet
cards.description: Your next 3 captures each gain you 10 seconds, and the capturing piece is gilded for the trophy cabinet.

cards.name: Moat Digger
cards.description: Dig a moat on two adjacent empty squares in your half: enemy pieces cannot end a move on them for your opponent's next 3 turns. Use it before your next move, or the charge is spent unused.

cards.name: Molting Season
cards.description: One of your bishops sheds its robes and permanently becomes a knight. Using it consumes your next unused draft reroll, if any.

cards.name: Monks of the Fifth Bell
cards.description: Permanent: every fifth of your turns the bell tolls and one random pawn of yours takes a free step forward.

cards.name: Olympus Voicemail
cards.description: For your next 2 turns, after each of your moves a bolt stuns the enemy piece that moved most recently (kings excluded) for 1 turn.

cards.name: Poltergeist
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, a poltergeist shoves one random enemy pawn one square sideways at the start of each (when a side square is empty).

cards.name: Portal Pair
cards.description: Open two portals on empty squares for 5 of your turns: whenever one of your pieces ends a move on a portal, it exits from the other one (if that square is empty).

cards.name: Private Gallery
cards.description: Your next draft offers 3 cards, and you pocket 10 seconds at the door.

cards.name: Sandbags
cards.description: Stack sandbags on up to 2 of your pawns: they cannot be captured during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Second Opinion
cards.description: A consulting monocle highlights every currently undefended enemy piece, once.

cards.name: Slingshot
cards.description: One of your pawns shoots down an enemy pawn up to 2 squares directly ahead of it. The shooter stays put. Using it consumes your next unused draft reroll, if any.

cards.name: Smoke Ring
cards.description: Blow a smoke ring over a 2x2 area. The smoke turns enemy pieces away: they cannot end a move inside it for your opponent's next 2 turns. Use it before your next move, or the charge is spent unused.

cards.name: Tandem Bike
cards.description: Two of your pawns standing side by side advance one square together, as your move for this turn. Both squares ahead must be empty: neither pawn may capture.

cards.name: Traffic Cone
cards.description: Drop cones on up to 3 empty squares of one file in your half: enemy pieces may pass over them but cannot end a move on them for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Wallhack Goggles
cards.description: Three scans, one after each of your opponent's moves: every piece of yours standing on an enemy slider's line, even behind blockers, is highlighted. Each scan spends one of the three even if it finds nothing.

cards.name: Weather Balloon
cards.description: Three scans, one after each of your opponent's moves: every square the opponent could reach with their next move is highlighted. Each scan spends one of the three even if it lights up nothing.

cards.name: Wheelbarrow
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, one of your pawns may trundle to any adjacent empty square, once.

cards.name: Whittle

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Carve one unmoved enemy pawn on the a-file or h-file into shavings. It is removed.

cards.name: Pawn Push
cards.description: On any turn, one of your pawns with two empty squares ahead may advance two squares in a single move, even after it has left its starting square, for the game. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Pawn Shield
cards.description: One pawn cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Pawn Storm
cards.description: Every one of your pawns still on its starting square advances one square, if the square ahead is empty. It resolves at once and is spent even if no pawn can advance.

cards.name: Piece Swap
cards.description: Choose any two of your own pieces; they swap places after your opponent's next move, once.

cards.name: Pinned Down
cards.description: Choose one enemy piece, never the king. Starting after your opponent's next move it freezes for 2 of their turns, then stays a heavy walnut for 1 more turn, able only to shuffle a single square.

cards.name: Prep
cards.description: Your next buff draft shows three cards to pick from instead of two, once.

cards.name: Quick Glance
cards.description: Your opponent loses one draft reroll. If they have none to lose, you gain one instead.

cards.name: Rake
cards.description: One wide swing: every enemy pawn standing beside a piece you choose is raked one square back toward its home rank, wherever that square is free.

cards.name: Rally
cards.description: One of your knights may move like a king for 1 turn. The king step cannot capture.

cards.name: Rank Runner
cards.description: One pawn advances to any empty square on its file up to your 5th rank, once.

cards.name: Recall
cards.description: Return one piece to any empty square in your back two ranks, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Reposition
cards.description: Move one piece, your king included, one square in any direction to an empty square, once. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Royal Handicap
cards.description: Nerf the crown itself: for your opponent's next 4 turns the patch removes diagonal movement from their king, save one diagonal escape step the king may still take once.

cards.name: Safe Passage
cards.description: The roads along the edge are under truce: for their next 4 turns your opponent cannot capture anything standing on the outer rim of the board. The first capture the truce would deny is allowed once.

cards.name: Bobrito Bandito
cards.description: Bonk one enemy piece with the log: the swing lands after your opponent's next move, stunning that piece so it cannot move for its next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

cards.name: Sealed Orders
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft offer contains no draft-manipulation cards, and you take a draft reroll.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.description: One captured pawn returns to an empty square on your 2nd rank after your opponent's next move, once.

cards.name: Shieldmaiden
cards.description: A shieldmaiden plants herself before one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, but the instant that piece moves to attack the enemy king, her guard shatters and the protection ends.

cards.name: Short Leash
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Sidestep
cards.description: Choose one piece: it steps one square to an empty square beside it and cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Sidestep King
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Slack in the Chain
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Small Mercies
cards.description: The next 2 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Snowball
cards.description: One enemy pawn is frozen for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Spring Pawn
cards.description: Your pawns can spring one square sideways onto an empty square, twice.

cards.name: Steady Hand
cards.description: Enemy knights cannot move to squares that attack your king for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Summon Intern
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the intern quietly takes over the empty desk: a pawn joins your pocket, to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn.

cards.name: Timid King
cards.description: Your opponent's king cannot end a move beside any of your pieces, for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Touch Grass
cards.description: You step outside for your own good: add 30 seconds to your clock, and your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Trampoline
cards.description: Bounce one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square within two squares of it.

cards.name: Undying Thrall

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / temporary 4 turns / unconditional

cards.description: Bind a restless spirit into service: one of your captured knights or bishops claws back onto an empty square of your back rank and fights for 4 of your turns, then crumbles to dust, once.

cards.name: Vanguard
cards.description: One pawn on your 5th rank or beyond promotes to a knight, once.

cards.name: Camel Rider
cards.description: Each of your knights on the board right now gains one longer 3-by-1 camel leap, usable once. Knights that arrive later gain none.

cards.name: Conjured Scout
cards.description: Conjure a knight on an empty square on your back rank. It fights for 2 of your turns, then fades.

cards.name: Quicken
cards.description: Time reasserts itself around your army: every freeze, stasis, and walnut afflicting YOUR pieces is dispelled on the spot.

cards.name: Warp Field
cards.description: Move one of your pieces to an empty square next to it, once.

cards.name: Warp Home
cards.description: Teleport one of your pieces back to a vacant starting square of its own type, once. It does not use your turn.

cards.name: Slip on Ice
cards.description: Choose one of your opponent's rooks. It skates on: only after their next move does the ice bite, freezing that rook in place for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Yeet
cards.description: Wind up and launch one of your own pieces deep into enemy territory: send it to any empty square in your opponent's half, once. Your king stays put. Launching it burns your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Frost Nip
cards.description: Frost nips at the rearguard: after your opponent replies, every enemy piece except the king still standing on its own back rank is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Regrow
cards.description: One of your captured pawns takes root on your 4th rank, or the nearest rank with room, and sprouts after your opponent's next move, already pointed at promotion.

cards.name: Verdant Shield
cards.description: A canopy of bark: all of your pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn. Any enemy pawn directly in front of one of your pawns is rooted and cannot move for 1 turn.

cards.name: Whoopee Cushion
cards.description: Hide a whoopee cushion on an empty square. The first enemy piece other than the king to land on it makes a rude noise and must move that same piece again on their next 2 turns. Then the cushion is done.

cards.name: Field Hospital
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your knights, a new pawn is raised on an empty square of your back rank.

cards.name: Reclaim the Fallen
cards.description: Battlefield salvage: the next 2 enemy pawns you capture are pressed into service, joining your pocket to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Anchored Rooks
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, they cannot move their rooks for their following 2 turns.

cards.name: Anvil Drop
cards.description: Drop an ACME anvil on one enemy piece: it is flattened and cannot move for 3 of their turns, and the impact knocks it one square back toward its home rank. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Ballerina Cappuccina
cards.description: The coffee-cup ballerina leads a formation twirl: choose one of your pieces (not the king) to step one square, then up to two allies that stood beside it may each step one square too. No captures, just choreography.

cards.name: Basilisk's Gaze
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece to stone. It may make one last legal move to escape; then it becomes a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for 4 of their turns, and while petrified it cannot capture. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Blink Army
cards.description: Teleport two pawns forward two squares each if empty, once.

cards.name: Blinkered Bishops
cards.description: Your opponent cannot move their bishops for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Auditor's Ledger
cards.description: Every undefended piece on the board, yours and your opponent's alike, lights up until your opponent replies. Yours are underwritten: they cannot be captured on that turn. Gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Baker's Dozen
cards.description: Your next draft shows three cards, and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Beetle Shell
cards.description: Your knights and bishops cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Bribe the Clerk
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended for your next 5 turns. The clerk pockets one of your draft rerolls, if you have any.

cards.name: Care Package
cards.description: Open the parcel: at random, either a pawn (half the time), a knight (a quarter), or a bishop (a quarter) joins your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: Causeway
cards.description: For your next 2 turns, your rooks may slide straight through your own pieces (never capturing them) to any empty square beyond. Each square a rook lands on this way lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Changeling Child
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns standing beside one of your knights or bishops: it grows into that same kind of piece where it stands.

cards.name: Cobbler's Bench
cards.description: Return one of your captured pawns to any empty square in your half.

cards.name: Coffee Break
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Danger Sense
cards.description: Every enemy piece currently aiming at your king or your queen lights up until your opponent replies, and both crowns brace: neither can be captured on that turn.

cards.name: Falconer's Glove
cards.description: Choose one of your knights: for the rest of the game it may also step one square in any direction (capturing allowed). Each time it takes that step, it cannot move again on your next turn.

cards.name: Flash Frost
cards.description: One enemy piece of your choice (their king excepted) is frozen solid for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Glass of Water
cards.description: Cleanse one of your pieces of a temporary freeze, seal, or one-square movement restriction, and suspend your nerf for your next turn.

cards.name: Gryphon Rider
cards.description: Choose one of your knights: for your opponent's next 4 turns it may also glide up to two squares diagonally (capturing allowed). The gift ends early the moment your king crosses the midline.

cards.name: Harvest and Fallow
cards.description: You keep both cards of your next draft offer. The draft after it is skipped while the field rests.

cards.name: Hermit's Hour
cards.description: Spend your turn in retreat: your nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Hush Money
cards.description: Your next 2 captures each suspend your nerf for your next turn.

cards.name: Keep Gate
cards.description: The three squares directly ahead of your king are barred to enemy pieces for 4 turns.

cards.name: Letters Home
cards.description: After your next 4 turns, the letters arrive: two pawns join your pocket, ready to drop on later turns.

cards.name: Matryoshka Surprise
cards.description: Paint one of your pawns as a nesting doll. When it is captured, two smaller pawns pop out into your pocket, ready to drop on later turns.

cards.name: Night Gardener
cards.description: The next 2 of your pawns that are captured each return at once to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: Over the Shoulder
cards.description: See the cards in your opponent's next draft offer, and gain 1 draft reroll. If that draft is already skipped, only the reroll arrives.

cards.name: Over the Wall
cards.description: The next 2 times one of your pieces reaches your opponent's back two ranks, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Overtime Claim
cards.description: Add 45 seconds to your clock. In untimed games it adds nothing.

cards.name: Pathfinders
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, your knights may also make a long leap to an empty square: three squares one way and one square the other. The leap cannot capture.

cards.name: Pawn's Ransom
cards.description: Give up one of your pawns (it is removed and truly lost): your nerf is suspended for your next 6 turns.

cards.name: Pocket Metronome
cards.description: Add 25 seconds to your clock, gain 1 draft reroll, and learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer. In untimed games only the reroll and the tier reveal arrive.

cards.name: Promotion Paperwork
cards.description: The next 2 times one of your pawns reaches your opponent's back two ranks, it cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn while the papers are stamped.

cards.name: Puddle Freeze
cards.description: Two enemy pawns of your choice are frozen in place for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Punch Card
cards.description: Gain 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: Queen's Gambol
cards.description: Once, your queen may leap like a knight (capturing allowed). Her landing square is revealed and stays marked until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Rampart Watch
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, none of your pieces standing on your second rank can be captured for their following 2 turns.

cards.name: Retraining
cards.description: One of your knights becomes a bishop, or one of your bishops becomes a knight, where it stands. Your next draft is then skipped.

cards.name: Royal Incognito
cards.description: Your king puts on sunglasses for the rest of the game (purely decorative) and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Nobody recognizes him. Everybody recognizes him.

cards.name: Scout's Report
cards.description: Every enemy piece currently aiming at any of your pieces lights up until your opponent replies, and your threatened pieces dig in: they cannot be captured on that turn.

cards.name: Slow Procession
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their queen cannot move. When it resolves, their queen lights up until they reply.

cards.name: Small Consolation
cards.description: The next 2 times your opponent captures one of your rooks or queens, a pawn joins your pocket.

cards.name: Town Walls
cards.description: No enemy piece may move onto your second rank for 2 turns.

cards.name: War Room Map
cards.description: Every enemy piece that no other enemy piece defends lights up until your opponent replies, and the planners hand you 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: Wind-Up Knight
cards.description: Place a clockwork knight on an empty square on your home rank. It fights like the real thing, then winds down and leaves the board after 6 of your turns.

cards.name: Board Quake
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, push every enemy pawn back one square where empty behind.

cards.name: Boxing Glove
cards.description: A spring-loaded glove punches one enemy piece one square back toward its own side and stuns it for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Break the Nerf
cards.description: Free action: break your nerf, suspending it for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Burned Dispatches
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and in return they gain one draft reroll for a later offer.

cards.name: Ascetic's Bargain
cards.description: Take a vow of refusal: your next draft is skipped outright. The draft after that shows three cards to pick from and rolls one tier higher. If it is not claimed within two of your drafts, the vow lapses.

cards.name: Blood Duel
cards.description: Call a duel of equals: choose one enemy knight, bishop or rook, then one of your own pieces of the same kind. Both are removed from the board. Both losses are real and feed both revival pools.

cards.name: Blood Price
cards.description: The deck feeds on sacrifice: destroy one of your own pieces (your king excepted), and your next draft is fated to offer tier 6 cards.

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the next time one of your pieces makes a capture, it strikes and slips straight back to the square it came from, dodging any reprisal. Once.

cards.name: Pioneer's Banner
cards.description: The next 3 times one of your pieces (your king excepted) crosses from your half into your opponent's half, it plants the banner: that piece cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Castle in the Storm
cards.description: Choose one of your rooks on your king's rank with an empty path to the king and castle toward it at once, king two squares over, rook to the square it passed, even if your king or that rook has already moved. That rook cannot move again on your next turn.

cards.name: Field Knighting
cards.description: Knighted on the battlefield, no cathedral required: choose one of your pawns that has advanced at least to the middle of the board (its fifth rank or beyond) and it becomes a knight where it stands.

cards.name: Forced March
cards.description: For your next 2 turns, any of your pawns may advance two squares in one move from wherever it stands, both squares ahead being empty, not only from its starting rank. It cannot double-step onto the final rank. Each such advance flashes its landing square.

cards.name: Heir Apparent

terms.note: promotion (target unstated, priced at a minor)

cards.description: The line of succession is settled in advance: the first time your opponent captures one of your knights or bishops, your pawn nearest your home rank is knighted into that same kind of piece where it stands.

cards.name: Ironwright's Bargain
cards.description: The forge takes iron and gives iron back heavier: one of your knights or bishops is reforged into a rook, and in payment one of your pawns is thrown into the fire and lost. Your next draft is skipped while the forge cools.

cards.name: King's Shield
cards.description: The king's own shieldbearer never falls first: your piece standing on the square directly in front of your king cannot be captured. Whichever piece holds that square is protected while it stays there.

cards.name: Martyrdom

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional
2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: One of yours falls so one of theirs must: destroy one of your own knights or bishops, then remove one of your opponent's knights or bishops from the board. Every loss here is real.

cards.name: Martyr's Gift
cards.description: Every loss leaves you something: each of the next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, you gain a draft reroll and 5 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Second Face
cards.description: It learns a second way to move: choose one of your bishops, and for your opponent's next 4 turns it may also leap like a knight, keeping all of its bishop moves as well. The second face falls away early if your opponent spends a draft reroll.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.description: Shoulder to shoulder they cannot be broken: any of your pawns that stands directly beside another of your pawns (on the next file over, same rank) cannot be captured. A lone pawn is on its own.

cards.name: Tunnelers
cards.description: It digs its own lines: choose one of your rooks, and for the rest of the game it may slide straight through your own pieces to any empty square beyond. The tunneling slide can never capture, friend or foe.

cards.name: Underdog's Gambit
cards.description: While you have fewer pieces than your opponent, kings aside, your pawns may also capture an enemy piece standing directly beside them, one square left or right. Draw level and they fight like pawns again. It takes hold after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Camel Knight
cards.description: One knight also moves as a camel (3-1 leap), for the game.

cards.name: Cannon
cards.description: Choose one rook. For the game it keeps its normal moves and may also capture along a rank or file by jumping exactly one piece of either color and taking the first enemy piece beyond it.

cards.name: Chains of Binding
cards.description: A spectral chain shackles the enemy's rooks to each other. It settles after your opponent's next move, then while both live neither rook may end a move more than 3 squares from the other, for the 5 of their turns after.

cards.name: Clone

terms.note: copy of the named piece / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Run one of your pawns through the photocopier: place an exact copy on an empty square beside it, once.

cards.name: Counterstep
cards.description: After your opponent's next capture, you take two moves in reply, once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Roulette Wheel
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: You put it all on red and the croupier spins. Land red for a knight in your pocket and 30 seconds. Land black and you lose your weakest piece. Land the green zero and the house cleans you out: lose your weakest piece and your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Scratch Card
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Scratch off three panels with the edge of a coin. Match all three for a knight in your pocket. Match two for 35 seconds, a free forward pawn step when one is open, and a draft reroll. Three blanks and the dud ticket costs you your weakest pawn.

cards.name: Slot Machine
