cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Pull the arm and watch three reels spin. Match all three symbols for the jackpot: a rook and a knight drop into your pocket to place later, plus 45 seconds. Match two for a knight in your pocket. Match none and the machine eats your weakest piece.

cards.name: Ctrl+Z

terms.note: 3-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Undo, but the tape rewinds a beat late: only after your opponent's next move may you return one of your captured pawns, knights, or bishops to an empty square in your half, once.

cards.name: Returned to Sender
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, but their following draft offers three cards instead of two, plus one free reroll.

cards.name: Decoy
cards.description: Summon a decoy on an empty square in your half, and your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Detonate
cards.description: Sacrifice one pawn to clear all pieces on its adjacent squares except kings.

cards.name: Double or Nothing
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Bet one of your other held cards on a coin flip. Heads: it is upgraded two tiers. Tails: it is knocked down one tier, but you keep it.

cards.name: Battering Line
cards.description: Your pawns can capture straight ahead for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Durian
cards.description: Lob the king of fruits onto an empty square: for your opponent's next 3 turns no enemy piece may move onto a square next to it. The first piece caught by the stench still gets one step into the ring; after that the ring is sealed until the stench clears.

cards.name: Dewdrop
cards.description: Your most advanced pawn cannot be captured for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Brambleroot
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot move sideways along a rank for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Wyrmscale Mail
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces other than the king. It cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Fork Guard
cards.description: Whenever one of your knights gives check, it cannot be captured on the reply turn.

cards.name: Frigo Camelo
cards.description: The fridge-camel opens both doors: two of your pieces (never the king) are refrigerated: they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, but each is frozen solid for 1 of your turns while it defrosts.

cards.name: Frost
cards.description: Freeze two adjacent enemy pieces for 1 turn each, starting after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.description: Target one enemy piece, kings excluded. The frost bites after your opponent's next move, following the piece if they move it, then freezes it for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Gargoyles
cards.description: Petrify one of your opponent's bishops for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Glamour
cards.description: The courts trade changelings: one enemy pawn you choose joins your army, and one of your pawns you choose joins theirs. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Cursed Dice
cards.description: Your opponent rolls the bone dice. 40%: one random enemy piece is cursed to freeze for a turn, but gets one free move to escape first and freezes wherever that leaves it. 35%: a random enemy pawn stumbles back a square. 25%: the dice grin and nothing happens.

cards.name: Heads or Tails
cards.description: Call the coin or take the sure thing. Gamble: flip two coins at 50% each, heads on either wins an extra move right now (75% overall), both tails and nothing. Or skip the flip to reveal the tier of your opponent's next draft offer and gain one reroll.

cards.name: Jackpot Pawn
cards.description: Fit one pawn with slot reels for 5 of your turns: every time it advances, the reels spin: 20% it banks a king-step charge it can spend later, 3% JACKPOT, it promotes to queen on the spot.

cards.name: Lootbox
cards.description: Crack it open: 55% common, a knight of yours may camel-leap on its next move; 25% rare, a pawn spawns on your second rank; 15% epic, your next draft offers three cards; 5% legendary, a random tier 5 card lands in your hand.

cards.name: Piece Roulette
cards.description: Bet one of your pawns on the wheel: 45% it comes back a knight, 10% it hits the green zero and comes back a rook, 25% nothing, 20% the house takes it.

cards.name: Seven Cases
cards.description: Seven cases, one opens at random: two hold pawns, one a knight, one a bishop, one a rook, one a full intelligence packet (a reroll plus your opponent's next offer revealed), and one holds absolutely nothing.

cards.name: Underdog Parlay
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Two legs: put the enemy king under attack within 5 of your turns AND capture within 3. Both hit: a knight joins your back rank. One: a pawn joins your second rank. Neither: the parlay busts and nothing happens.

cards.name: Gorgon's Glance
cards.description: Turn one enemy knight or bishop you target into a walnut: 2 of their turns if it stands in its own half, 4 if it was caught in yours, where the gaze is strongest.

cards.name: Grasshopper
cards.description: Choose one non-king piece. For the game it may also move along any rank, file, or diagonal and land on the empty square immediately beyond the first piece in its path. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Hard Reset
cards.description: Your opponent's most advanced pawn reboots to its starting square. If that square is taken, the pawn freezes for 1 turn instead.

cards.name: Hobbled Cavalry
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, their knights turn to walnuts for their following 2 turns: a walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: No Reins
cards.description: Their next move keeps its footing, then for their following 4 turns every bishop, rook or queen slide must run as far as the line allows: to the edge, into a capture, or up against one of their own pieces. Knights, pawns and the king are unaffected.

cards.name: No Retreat
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, none of their pieces may move toward their own back rank: no retreating, no sidestepping backward. They may advance or move straight across. The king is exempt, and a piece with no forward move is freed for that turn.

cards.name: Wandering Sentry
cards.description: A spectral sentry paces a rank in your opponent's half for 4 of their turns: the square it stands on is barred to their pieces, and every turn it steps one file across, turning back when it reaches the edge.

cards.name: Ash Veil
cards.description: A veil of ash hides your minor pieces: your opponent cannot capture your knights or bishops for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Bramble Patch
cards.description: Choose 2 empty squares: brambles cover them for 2 of your opponent's turns, and none of their pieces may stop there.

cards.name: The Burned Keep
cards.description: Your opponent may not castle, and both of their rooks, busy fighting the fire, are frozen for 1 of their turns. The ban has no time limit and holds until they make a capture, which douses the flames.

cards.name: Carrion Crows
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that captures inside your half of the board is mobbed by crows and frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Clay Hooves
cards.description: Every enemy knight that has left its starting square hardens into clay and is frozen for 2 of their turns. Knights still at home are spared.

cards.name: Cold Reception
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any pawn of theirs that enters your half of the board is frozen for 1 of their turns on arrival. The first pawn to cross slips through unfrozen; every pawn after it freezes.

cards.name: Cold Shoulder
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their king may not end a move adjacent to any of your pieces.

cards.name: Court Gossip
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 2 turns, none of their pieces may end a move adjacent to your queen: everyone is terrified of being mentioned.

cards.name: Crown of Lead
cards.description: Their king is crowned with lead and wears the dunce cap for 9 of their turns. Under its weight, for their next 3 turns no piece standing adjacent to their king may capture.

cards.name: Donkey Ears
cards.description: Their king sprouts magnificent donkey ears (the dunce cap, worn for 6 of their turns), and the shame stings: for their next 2 turns their king cannot capture anything.

cards.name: Drawn Curtain
cards.description: Choose one rank. Your opponent's next move passes freely; then, for their following turn, none of their pieces may stop on it or cross it. Your pieces pass freely.

cards.name: Falling Rubble
cards.description: Collapse a 2x2 block of squares you choose: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on any of those 4 squares for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Fear of Open Ground
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their rooks may not stop on a file that holds no pawns of either color. Open ground makes them itch.

cards.name: Frost Heave
cards.description: The ground in your half buckles with frost: every enemy pawn currently standing in your half of the board, except the first, is frozen for 2 of their turns. One pawn shakes free.

cards.name: Gale Warning
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move on an edge square is pinned flat and frozen for 1 of their turns. The first piece the gale would pin keeps its footing. Kings keep their footing.

cards.name: Gargoyle Perch
cards.description: Up to two enemy rooks you target turn into walnuts for 1 of their turns: they can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Groom's Leash
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may only land on squares adjacent to another of their own pieces. Stray leaps are forbidden. The first stray leap slips through once, then the leash binds fully.

cards.name: Guild Insurance
cards.description: Your rooks are insured by the masons' guild: your opponent cannot capture them for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Haunted Gallery
cards.description: Ghosts walk the great dark diagonal (a1 to h8): every enemy piece standing on it is frozen in dread for 1 of their turns. Their king is spared.

cards.name: Hearth Frost
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, frost creeps into their barracks: every enemy pawn still standing on its owner's second rank is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Heavy Dew
cards.description: A freezing dew settles at dawn: every enemy piece standing on its owner's fourth rank is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Hobble Strap
cards.description: Buckle a hobble onto one enemy piece (never the king): starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns it may move at most 1 square at a time.

cards.name: Hollow Fanfare
cards.description: For your opponent's next 7 turns, any pawn they promote arrives as a walnut for 2 of their turns: crowned, celebrated, and unable to do more than shuffle.

cards.name: Hundred Year Nap
cards.description: Put one enemy piece you target into an enchanted sleep: it is frozen for 3 of their turns, but it thaws at once if any of your pieces comes to attack it. Kings cannot be enchanted.

cards.name: The Iron Ring
cards.description: An iron ring closes around the board's rim: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on any edge square for their next turn.

cards.name: Jam on the Row
cards.description: Pick any square: starting after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece then on that rank (never the king) is stuck in spilled jam and frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Know Your Place
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their knights and bishops may not capture rooks or queens. The first such capture slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Rank has its privileges.

cards.name: Narcolepsy
cards.description: Two of your opponent's pieces, chosen at random (never the king), fall asleep mid campaign and are frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: River Watch
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their rooks may not cross the midline into your half of the board. The first rook the ferry would stop may cross once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Rusted Battlements
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, both of their rooks seize with rust and cannot move for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Rusty Visor
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns, their visors stick shut: no piece may capture an enemy piece more valuable than itself. Capturing the king is always allowed.

cards.name: Severed Lines
cards.description: Their supply roads are cut: your opponent's pieces cannot stop on their own 3rd or 4th rank for their next turn.

cards.name: Skittish Mounts
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their knights may not land adjacent to any of your pieces. The horses smell trouble.

cards.name: Soft Shells
cards.description: Two of your opponent's pawns, chosen at random, molt into walnuts for 2 of their turns: one square shuffles only. The first affected pawn gets one legal escape move before it molts.

cards.name: Soggy Invaders
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their pieces standing in your half of the board cannot capture. Wet powder, wetter morale.

cards.name: Soot Fall
cards.description: Soot blankets both long diagonals: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their bishops may not stop on any square of the a1 to h8 or h1 to a8 diagonals.

cards.name: Tar Flood
cards.description: Tar floods your opponent's third rank: for their next 2 turns, none of their pieces may stop anywhere on it. The first piece the tar would stop may cross once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Undertow
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that moves backward, toward its own back rank, is frozen for 1 of their turns on arrival. Kings never freeze.

cards.name: Wagon Ruts
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, their rooks may only move along files, never sideways along ranks.

cards.name: Widow's Veil
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, their queen cannot capture anything. She is in deep mourning.

cards.name: Winded Destrier
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight of theirs that captures must catch its breath and is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Wrong Map
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their knights may only land on dark squares. The first knight to try a light square slips through as one escape, then the restriction holds. Someone printed the map inverted.

cards.name: Insurance
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, a new knight appears on your queen's starting square (d1 for White, d8 for Black), or on the nearest empty square of that rank if her home is taken. Triggers once.

cards.name: Jet Lag
cards.description: Book your opponent a red-eye: their clock loses 20 seconds, and the next piece they move is left so groggy it must move again on the turn after. If that piece can no longer move, the repeat is skipped.

cards.name: Knight to Nightrook
cards.description: One knight also slides straight up and down its file, any distance, for the game.

cards.name: Leaden Crown
cards.description: The crown is too heavy to march: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns their queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Sideways and homeward slides are free.

cards.name: Magnet
cards.description: Drag one enemy piece (not the king) one square toward your king.

cards.name: Main Character
cards.description: One of your pieces gets plot armor: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns, but the armor drops the instant it makes a capture.

cards.name: Mirror
cards.description: Copy one random unspent buff your opponent holds. Locked-in upgrades cannot be copied.

cards.name: Momentum
cards.description: After your next capture, immediately take a second move that cannot capture, once.

cards.name: Monkeytype
cards.description: Type at full speed: relocate up to 2 of your pieces, each exactly one square, in a rapid burst of keystrokes. Kings sit this test out.

cards.name: Mystery Box
cards.description: Rattle the crate and pop the lid: your next draft offer rolls at a completely random tier, anywhere from 2 to 7.

cards.name: Napping
cards.description: The enemy piece farthest from its own king sneaks a nap while nobody is watching: it is frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings never nap; ties pick the square nearest a1.

cards.name: No Trespass
cards.description: A truce holds at the crossroads: after your opponent's next move, they cannot capture anything standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their following 5 turns.

cards.name: North Star
cards.description: The fixed star steadies your hand: your next draft is fated to offer tier 4 cards.

cards.name: One Arm Muscle Up Is My Dream
cards.description: One chosen piece reaches for the bar: once, it may slide diagonally like a bishop, one long arm across the board. That reach is a single grasp, taking it spends it, and so does the first of your turns where the reach is available but you move without using it.

cards.name: Layaway Plan
cards.description: Your next draft offer rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Bodyswap Ball
cards.description: The disco ball drops: two random pieces in your army swap squares, and two random pieces in your opponent's army swap squares. Kings sit the dance out.

cards.name: Booster Pack
cards.description: Tear the foil: immediately receive one random tier-4 card, fair odds.

cards.name: Chat Vote
cards.description: Chat votes on your prize, winner random: gain 25 seconds, every one of your pawns with an open square ahead advances one, or a random enemy minor is stunned for 1 turn.

cards.name: Feng Shui Plot
cards.description: Claim a 2x2 plot for 6 of your turns: your pieces standing inside it may also step one square in any direction, but that step cannot capture.

cards.name: Fire Drill
cards.description: Sound the alarm on one rank of your half: swap pairs of your pieces standing on it, up to 3 swaps, then everyone pretends this was orderly.

cards.name: Frog Prince
cards.description: Turn one enemy knight or bishop into a frog for your opponent's next 3 turns: it may only hop one square diagonally and cannot capture. Knights cannot hop at all and just ribbit.

cards.name: Glass Bridge
cards.description: Choose one of the four central ranks: it turns to glass for 4 of your turns. Any piece of either side that ends a move there has a 50% chance to fall through and be removed. Kings are exempt.

cards.name: Identity Crisis
cards.description: One random minor piece of yours and one random enemy minor swap sides. After 4 of your turns, each one still on the board swaps back.

cards.name: Insider Trading
cards.description: See the cards of your opponent's next draft, and pocket 10 seconds for the tip.

cards.name: Night Shift
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, your rooks may move straight through your own pawns, but these moves cannot capture.

cards.name: Petting Zoo
cards.description: A Goat, a Duck, and a Sheep (a pawn each) appear on random empty squares in your half for 8 of your turns. They cannot move or capture, they just block, then they wander home.

cards.name: Pillow Fort
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn, their bishops, rooks and queen cannot move to any square from which they would attack your king. Knights and pawns may still menace.

cards.name: Prophecy Engine
cards.description: Point at an enemy piece: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every move they make with that piece type gains you 6 seconds. If they never move one, the engine pays 40 seconds when the prophecy closes.

cards.name: Templar Vows
cards.description: Choose one of your bishops: for 6 of your turns it is a Templar and may also make knight leaps onto empty squares. These leaps cannot capture.

cards.name: Thunderstorm
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, lightning strikes a random square in their half after each of their moves, destroying any enemy pawn standing there.

cards.name: Trojan Pawn
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns: if it is captured within 8 of your turns, two fresh pawns leap out onto empty squares adjacent to where it fell.

cards.name: Wizard Duel
cards.description: One of your bishops duels an enemy bishop: 50% either way, the loser is removed. If your bishop wins, it also gains single king steps for 3 of your turns.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.description: Your knights move like knights or kings for 3 turns. The added king step cannot capture.

cards.name: Petrified Towers
cards.description: Turn one enemy rook you target into a walnut for 1 of their turns, and while the tower stands petrified your opponent cannot castle at all.

cards.name: Phase Rook
cards.description: Choose one rook. For the game it may pass through one friendly piece per move; it still cannot capture friendly pieces or phase through two.

cards.name: Piece Steal
cards.description: Convert one enemy pawn to your color, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Pin Breaker
cards.description: One of your pieces breaks free with a knight's leap to an empty square and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, once. Using it spends the card even if the leap cannot resolve.

cards.name: NerfChess Defender
cards.description: Threat detected. A fake antivirus sweeps their board and quarantines up to 2 random enemy pieces: they cannot move for 2 of your opponent's turns. Kings are too big to quarantine.

cards.name: Raise Dead
cards.description: Choose an empty square in your OPPONENT'S half now, and one of your fallen pawns, knights, or bishops rises there after your opponent's next move, once. If the square is taken by then, the revival fizzles and the charge is still spent.

cards.name: Regenerate
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, revive two of your captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

cards.name: Regroup
cards.description: Return your advanced pawns to their starting rank where empty, once.

cards.name: Reinforce
cards.description: One of your pieces cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Rewind One
cards.description: Undo the last two half-moves: send the last piece each side moved back to the square it came from, once.

cards.name: Rubber Chicken
cards.description: Bonk one enemy piece with a rubber chicken. It gets one escape move; wherever it lands it is then dazed and can only shuffle one square at a time for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be bonked.

cards.name: Rubik's Cube
cards.description: Scramble the cube: choose up to 3 twists, each swapping the spots of two of your own pieces standing within 2 squares of each other. Kings never twist. The twists only resolve after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Screen
cards.description: Choose one bishop. While it stands on a square next to your king it cannot be captured, for your next 6 turns.

cards.name: Seance
cards.description: Send one of your knights or bishops across to the other side, and one of your captured rooks returns in its place, on the square that knight or bishop just vacated. Casting the circle also spends your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Seized Axles
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks cannot move sideways for their next 4 turns: they may only slide up and down their own file.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.description: One of your pieces slips through shadow to a nearby empty square and cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, once.

cards.name: Shielded Advance
cards.description: Choose one pawn. While it stands in the enemy half it cannot be captured, for your next 6 turns.

cards.name: Sliding King
cards.description: Your king moves like a king or bishop for 3 turns.

cards.name: Sown Salt
cards.description: Your opponent's pawns are rooted in salted ground for their next 2 turns and cannot move, not even to capture, except that the first pawn to move may take one escape move, after which every pawn is locked.

cards.name: Split March
cards.description: Four of your pawns each advance one square immediately, once. Using it spends the card even if fewer than four pawns can advance.

cards.name: Starlight Ward
cards.description: Starlight pools around the crown: your pieces standing on the squares beside your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Stinky
cards.description: One enemy piece other than the king reeks: after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns their other pieces cannot move onto any square adjacent to it. The smelly piece itself may still move anywhere.

cards.name: Stone Curse
cards.description: Target one enemy piece, not a king. It gets one unaffected move; then it turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Stone Hooves
cards.description: Petrify one of your opponent's knights for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Super Glue
cards.description: Empty the tube on one enemy piece: it and every enemy piece orthogonally next to it are stuck fast and cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted or stuck.

cards.name: Tidal Push
cards.description: Choose one enemy piece and where it lands; after your opponent's next move, shove it two squares in a straight line if the path is still empty, once.

cards.name: Time Out
cards.description: The referee throws a flag on your opponent: their next draft is skipped and their clock loses 15 seconds.

cards.name: Time Rewind
cards.description: Turn back time: restore some of your clock and free all of your own frozen or petrified pieces, once.

cards.name: Trade Up
cards.description: The next 2 times you lose a minor piece, a new pawn appears in your half.

cards.name: Trapdoor
cards.description: Rig a spring on an empty square. For your next 4 turns, an enemy piece except a king that steps onto it is flung one square back toward its home rank and cannot move for 1 of their turns. A slapstick trap, not a delete.

cards.name: Trippi Troppi
cards.description: The shrimp-cat scrambles their proprioception: mark up to 3 enemy pieces (never the king). After your opponent's next move they grow stubby shrimp legs, and for their next 2 turns each can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Understaffed
cards.description: Half the office calls in sick. The first piece your opponent moves gets out freely; then for their next 2 turns they cannot move any piece standing on files a through d.

cards.name: Arcane Conduit
cards.description: One of your rooks may also move up to two squares diagonally, but never to capture, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Arrest the Hour
cards.description: Freeze one enemy rook or queen for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Banish

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Mark one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop: after your opponent replies, it is banished from the board, once.

cards.name: Chrono Siphon
cards.description: Steal up to 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and freeze one enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Far Step
cards.description: Teleport one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square on the board, once.

cards.name: Spectral Retinue
cards.description: Your retinue turns spectral and re-forms: your knights and bishops swap forms where they stand, knights becoming bishops and bishops becoming knights, but one of them is spared whenever more than one would change.

cards.name: Suppress Magic
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft offer contains no draft-manipulation cards, and the next buff they draft arrives nullified.

cards.name: Time Stop
cards.description: Stop one piece in time, yours or theirs (never a king): for 2 of its owner's turns it cannot move, and for the first of those turns it cannot be captured. It is simply not here right now.

cards.name: Transmute
cards.description: Turn one of your pawns into a knight, once. Using it also spends one of your draft rerolls, if you have any.

cards.name: Twin Blink
cards.description: Two knots in the world come undone at once: choose one of your pieces and one enemy piece (kings aside); each blinks away to a random empty square.

cards.name: Wall
cards.description: Raise a wall on one empty square you pick: enemy pieces can never move onto it, for the game. The wall only rises on an empty square and captures nothing.

cards.name: Warp Step
cards.description: Move one piece up to three squares in a straight line to an empty square, passing over any pieces in between, once. It cannot capture.

cards.name: Wasted Hour
cards.description: The officers argue all morning: after your opponent's next move, on their following turn they may only move a pawn or their king.

cards.name: Wazir Bishop
cards.description: Choose one bishop; for the game it may also step one square horizontally or vertically.

cards.name: Wazir Rook
cards.description: Choose one rook; for the game it may also step one square diagonally.

cards.name: Backseat Driver
cards.description: Someone will not stop yelling push a pawn: it takes a turn to sink in, so only after your opponent's next move, on the turn that follows, must they move a pawn if any pawn of theirs can legally move.

cards.name: Black Hole
cards.description: Open a black hole on one empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it, never a king, is swallowed off the board. It stays open for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Moonwalk
cards.description: Teach your pawns to moonwalk: for your next 3 turns each of your pawns may also step one square straight backward onto an empty square. The backstep is never a capture.

cards.name: Pinata
cards.description: Swing wildly and hope: one random enemy piece other than the king is knocked off the board, but one of your own pawns bursts in the mess and is lost too.

cards.name: Red Tape
cards.description: Bury your opponent in paperwork: it takes a move to process, so after their next move they skip a turn, and then the forms catch up with you and you skip the turn after that.

cards.name: Sacrificial Bishop

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Feed one of your bishops to the volcano to smite one enemy knight or bishop you name: both leave the board, once.

cards.name: Stage Fright
cards.description: The next time your opponent's queen moves, she freezes where she lands for one of their turns. If that move gives check, stage fright hits harder and she becomes a walnut, shuffling one square at a time, for two of their turns instead.

cards.name: Tar Pit
cards.description: Every one of your opponent's bishops is stuck fast and cannot move or capture for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Cinder Strike
cards.description: Remove one of your opponent's pawns from the board, once.

cards.name: Gale
cards.description: A driving wind opens gaps: for your next turn your bishops may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

cards.name: Seedlings
cards.description: Plant two seeds on empty squares in your half: they take root after your opponent's next move, and 3 of your turns later a pawn sprouts on each square that is still empty.

cards.name: Static Field
cards.description: Static builds on anything that runs: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that travels 3 or more squares in one move without capturing is grounded, frozen for 1 turn where it lands.

cards.name: Whirlpool
cards.description: A whirlpool drags one enemy pawn to your side and deposits it on an empty square of your 4th rank, never a capture, yours now and ready to advance.

cards.name: Will-o'-Wisp
cards.description: A cold flame dances ahead of one enemy piece and it follows: lure one enemy piece except a king one square diagonally forward, toward your side, onto an empty square you choose. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Counter Charge
cards.description: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the capturing piece is frozen in place for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Dragoons
cards.description: One of your knights trains to vault the line: it may also jump exactly two squares straight in any direction, over anything, for the game.

cards.name: Flank March
cards.description: For up to your next 3 turns, each of your bishops may also step one square straight in any direction. This ends the first turn you play without taking one of those steps.

cards.name: Forced Retreat
cards.description: Mark one enemy piece, a king aside: after your opponent's next move it is pushed one square directly away from your king, if that square is empty, once. Kings cannot be pushed.

cards.name: Phalanx Advance
cards.description: Shields lock across the front: enemy pawns can never capture your pawns, save your single most advanced pawn (furthest forward, ties toward the a-file) whenever more than one of your pawns stands. For the rest of the game.

cards.name: Pikemen
cards.description: One of your pawns may also move and capture one square sideways, for the game.

cards.name: Pontoon Bridge
cards.description: One of your rooks, bishops, or queens may pass through up to two of your own pieces on its move, landing only on an empty square, once.

cards.name: Regroup the Lines
cards.description: Sound the recall: every one of your pieces standing in the enemy half falls back one square toward home, wherever the square behind it is free.

cards.name: Reserve Cavalry
cards.description: The reserve waits for the line to break: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a knight rides in on the empty back-rank square nearest your king's file.

cards.name: War Wagon
cards.description: One of your bishops may also move, without capturing, up to two squares straight in any direction, for the game.

cards.name: Abandoned Post
cards.description: Nobody presses the attack: starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 3 turns any move toward your side of the board may cover at most 2 squares. Sideways moves and retreats keep their full range.

cards.name: All In
cards.description: Push everything to the center. Your next draft offer is skipped. The offer after that shows three cards, and you take all three.

cards.name: Bear Trap
cards.description: Hide a bear trap on an empty square, visible only in your nightmares: the first enemy piece except a king to step onto it is snapped up and cannot move for 4 of their turns.

cards.name: Berolina Pawns
cards.description: Your pawns may also step diagonally forward to empty squares and capture straight ahead, for the game.

cards.name: Bishop to Archbishop
cards.description: One bishop also moves like a knight, for the game.

cards.name: Blockade
cards.description: Wall the enemy front: their pawns cannot advance or capture for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Border Survey
cards.description: Every square in your half currently reachable by an enemy attack lights up until your opponent replies, and the surveyed ground is staked: your opponent cannot move onto a lit square on their next turn.

cards.name: Bread and Salt
cards.description: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pawns, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Cathedral Choir
cards.description: Place a new bishop on any empty square in your half.

cards.name: Clerical Error
cards.description: Your handicap's paperwork is misfiled: your nerf is suspended for your next 3 turns, and your next draft shows three cards.

cards.name: Cold Snap
cards.description: Two enemy pieces of your choice (their king excepted) are frozen for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Costume Trunk
cards.description: Dress up to three of your pieces (your king excepted) from the trunk, forever (purely decorative). Costumed pieces cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn: nobody hits an actor mid-scene.

cards.name: Crown of Masks
cards.description: The grand carnival: every one of your pieces (your king excepted) is dressed from the trunk, forever (purely decorative), and none of your pieces can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Endless Militia
cards.description: For the rest of the game, the first three of your pawns that are captured each return at once to the empty square nearest your home rank (while there is room for it). Later captured pawns stay captured.

cards.name: Furlough
cards.description: Spend your turn signing out: your nerf is suspended for your next 6 turns.

cards.name: General Strike
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn, only their king will move, and it cannot capture unless a capture is its only legal move: every other piece is off the job.

cards.name: Genie Lamp
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Rub the lamp for one random gift, equal odds each: a knight, a bishop or a rook into your pocket, 3 draft rerolls, or 30 seconds on your clock.

cards.name: Glacier Calving
cards.description: Up to three enemy pieces of your choice (their king excepted) are frozen for your opponent's next turn. Your next draft is then skipped.

cards.name: Harvest Rest
cards.description: After your next 5 turns, your nerf is suspended for the 6 turns that follow. On the final turn the relief applies only to movement restrictions: you may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Hold the Door
cards.description: The next 2 times an enemy piece reaches your back rank, your nerf is suspended for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: The King's Champion
cards.description: Name one of your pieces (your king excepted) champion: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and for the rest of the game it may also step one square in any direction (capturing allowed).

cards.name: King's Leap Year
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, your king may leap like a knight (capturing allowed). Each leap's landing square is revealed and stays marked until your opponent replies.

cards.name: The King's Own Wings
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, your king may leap like a knight (capturing allowed). The moment he captures, the wings fold and the power ends.

cards.name: Lightning Rod
cards.description: The next time your opponent puts your king in check, you immediately gain an extra move. You cannot capture the king on a bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Mountain Pass
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, your bishops may slide diagonally through one of your own pieces (never capturing it) to squares beyond. The square a bishop lands on this way lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Pawnbroker's Deal
cards.description: Hand one of your pawns over the counter (it is removed and truly lost): a knight joins your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: Private Auction
cards.description: Your next draft offer is fated to deal tier 5 cards. If it has not been dealt within two of your drafts, the fated offer is reclaimed.

cards.name: Processional
cards.description: Rearrange the court: move up to 2 of your pieces (your king excepted) to empty squares within your half. Each destination lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Shieldmaidens
cards.description: Every one of your pieces standing beside your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. The protection ends the moment one of those pieces makes a capture.

cards.name: Sting of the Wasp
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces (your king excepted); its square is marked until your opponent replies. When it is captured, the piece that took it is removed too (enemy kings survive the sting).

cards.name: Warding Circle
cards.description: Chalk 4 empty squares of your choice: no enemy piece may move onto them for your opponent's next 4 turns. Capturing onto a chalked square clears that mark.

cards.name: Winter Palace
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and up to four pieces of your choice on your home rank cannot be captured on their next turn.

cards.name: Board Lock
cards.description: The whole board seizes up: no enemy piece may travel more than 3 squares in a single move, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.description: Add a knight to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Borrowed Time
cards.description: Your queen becomes uncapturable for your next 4 moves, and then her time runs out: she is removed from the board.

cards.name: Buff Thief (Minor)
cards.description: Steal one tier 1 buff from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Jester's Rule
cards.description: The court demands variety: for your opponent's next 6 turns, they can never capture the same kind of piece their previous move just captured.

cards.name: Queen's Testament

terms.note: up to, 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / capture gate

cards.description: Her will is already written: the first time your opponent captures your queen, up to two of your captured knights and bishops immediately return to empty squares nearest your home rank.

cards.name: Battlefield Commission
cards.description: If you have fewer pieces than your opponent, kings aside, your most advanced pawn is promoted where it stands: to a knight, or to a rook if you are outnumbered by four or more. The new piece cannot move again on your next turn.

cards.name: Double Down
cards.description: Push it all onto the next hand: your next draft shows three cards and you keep all three of them. In return, the draft after that is skipped.

cards.name: Eleventh Hour
cards.description: When the last of the line is nearly spent, help arrives: the first time your non-king pieces number three or fewer, your best captured piece returns to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: King's Road
cards.description: One lane on the board is declared yours: choose a file, and for the rest of the game no enemy piece may stand on that file across your own half of the board, save its most advanced square, which stays open. Your pieces travel it freely.

cards.name: Last Muster
cards.description: Call up whoever is left in the village: place up to 3 pawns on empty squares in your half. They hold the line, then disband four of your turns later, vanishing from the board.

cards.name: Mummers' Dance
cards.description: Every one of your knights becomes a bishop and every one of your bishops becomes a knight, all at once, where they stand. Your material is unchanged, only re-tasked. None of the re-tasked minors can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Plunderer's Ledger
cards.description: Every prize is entered in the ledger: each of your next 3 captures earns you one draft reroll to spend whenever you like. The ledger closes after two of your drafts, and any captures not yet cashed in are lost.

cards.name: Praetorian
cards.description: The guard never leaves her side: your queen cannot be captured while at least one of your knights or bishops stands on a square adjacent to her. Cut down her escort and the guard is gone.

cards.name: Royal Caper
cards.description: A cornered king learns to vault: while your king is in check it may leap like a knight, its landing square flagged for your opponent until they reply. The trick works twice, then the old bones remember their age.

cards.name: Cascade Freeze
cards.description: For 2 turns, each capture you make freezes the nearest enemy piece 1 turn.

cards.name: Chain Mail
cards.description: All your minor pieces are uncapturable for 2 full turns.

cards.name: Chess Diff
cards.description: Pause the game and play a clean 1+0 chess game with no cards. The winner gains a tier 9 buff, then the paused game resumes.

cards.name: Coffee
cards.description: Knock it back: take two extra moves right now, but the jitters hand your opponent one extra move on their reply.

cards.name: Counter-Nerf
cards.description: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for one of your turns, but each suspension only begins after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Rosen's Stafford Trap
cards.description: Mark one of your knights or bishops as bait. If an enemy piece takes it within their next 3 turns, that piece is trapped in place for 2 of their turns and you gain 20 seconds. If nobody bites, the bait cannot be captured for 2 turns.

cards.name: Crown and Castle
cards.description: Your opponent's queen and rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Cryostasis
cards.description: Flash-freeze one enemy piece you target: it and every enemy piece beside it are frozen for 1 of their turns. The defender keeps their single most valuable caught piece free. Kings are never frozen.

cards.name: Blackjack
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: The dealer feeds you cards until your hand reaches seventeen, then you stand. Twenty one pays a rook in your pocket and 45 seconds. Seventeen to twenty pays a minor piece. Bust and the house takes your weakest piece while you cool off for two turns.

cards.name: Poker Bluff
cards.description: Shove all in holding nothing. Roughly forty five times in a hundred they fold, and you rake one of their pieces into the pot along with 20 seconds. The rest of the time they call, and you pay your weakest piece and take a two turn walk of shame.

cards.name: Direwolf Pack
cards.description: Two spectral direwolves answer your howl: place two knights on empty squares in your half. The pack melts back into the mist after 5 of your turns. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Dragon Form
cards.description: One of your rooks unfurls a pair of dragon wings for a single flight: choose a rook; until it next moves it may also slide diagonally like a queen, but the first move it makes, diagonal or straight, folds the wings and spends the charge.

cards.name: Dragon Mount
cards.description: One of your knights breaks a young dragon to the saddle: for the game it may also slide any distance diagonally, though the dragon's glide cannot capture.

cards.name: Dragon Pawn
cards.description: One pawn moves as a pawn or knight until it promotes.

cards.name: Empty Handed
cards.description: Your opponent's next draft is blocked and skipped.

cards.name: Excalibur
cards.description: Draw the lake's blade: choose one of your bishops. Until it next moves it may also slide like a rook, giving it full queen movement, but the first move it makes, straight or diagonal, spends the blade.

cards.name: Extra Move
cards.description: Take two moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Faerie Ring
cards.description: A ring of pale mushrooms springs up around a square you choose: the 8 squares surrounding it are impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Flypaper File
cards.description: Coat one file in flypaper, visible to both players: for your next 6 turns, enemy pieces (kings excepted) that enter that file are stuck and cannot move for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Oathstone
cards.description: None of your pawns can be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Siren's Call
cards.description: Choose an enemy knight, bishop, rook or queen. It stands entranced and cannot move for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Stormcaller
cards.description: For your next 2 turns your rooks may also move diagonally and your bishops may also move straight, each as far as a queen would.

cards.name: Fortress Realm
cards.description: Pick a 3x3 zone: up to three of your pieces there, your king aside, cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn, then the zone becomes ordinary terrain.

cards.name: Giant Slayer
cards.description: Your pawns carry slings and know the soft spots: twice this game, one of your pawns may capture an enemy piece on any square directly beside it. Each such capture consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Glacial Flanks
cards.description: Freeze your opponent's knights and bishops for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Crash Game
cards.description: Strap a pawn to the rocket and let it ride: 30% it lands with a free sidestep, 25% it comes back a knight, 20% a knight plus a draft reroll, 10% it comes back a ROOK, 15% the rocket crashes and the pawn burns up.

cards.name: Wheel of the Cosmos
cards.refused: branch odds stated only in total
cards.description: Twelve equal segments, spun once. Eight are kind: revive a captured minor, march every pawn, a three card draft, stun two enemy pieces, promote a random pawn to knight, two rerolls, thaw your army, or summon a knight. Four are cruel, up to a defecting pawn.

cards.name: Grace Period
cards.description: Suspend your nerf entirely for 4 turns.

cards.name: Gremlins
cards.description: For their next 4 turns, your opponent's rooks can only move an even number of squares.

cards.name: Guard Rotation
cards.description: Swap your king with a rook anywhere on the board, once.

cards.name: Hallowed Return

terms.note: 3-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / board-state gate

cards.description: A prayer is answered exactly: one of your captured knights, bishops, or rooks is restored to life on one of its own starting squares, if one is free, once.

cards.name: Heavy Shackles
cards.description: Your opponent's queen and rooks are in irons for their next 2 turns. The first heavy piece they move slips free for that one move; after it, no queen or rook may move for the rest of the duration.

cards.name: Hex Doll

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: You bind a lock of horsehair to a little cloth doll: choose one enemy piece except a king. If it captures anything within their next 2 turns, the pin goes in and it is destroyed.

cards.name: Hot Potato
cards.description: Curse one enemy piece other than the king into a hot potato: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they must move that piece if it has any legal move.

cards.name: Hunter Knight
cards.description: One knight captures a piece one leap away and lands a second leap beyond, once.

cards.name: Curse of Recoil
cards.description: Their weapons kick like cannons: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is flung straight back to the square it attacked from (the victim is still taken, but the ground is not). Captures that promote are too heavy to throw back.

cards.name: Exile's Mark

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / temporary 5 turns / unconditional

cards.description: Brand one enemy knight, bishop or rook: every move it makes must carry it closer to your side, and if it has not set foot in your half within 5 of their turns it crumbles to dust. The mark lifts the moment it stands in your half. Kings are never exiled.

cards.name: Hydra Hex
cards.description: Brand one enemy piece as the hydra's head for the next 8 of their turns. If you cut it off, two heads grow back: the two enemy pieces nearest where it fell are each frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings are neither head nor spawn.

cards.name: Standing Guard
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, every time their king moves, whichever of their pieces stands nearest it is frozen for 1 of their turns. The first piece caught this way is spared and makes one move instead. The king itself is never frozen.

cards.name: Mutiny
cards.description: It takes hold after your opponent's next move, then for their next 6 turns: the first time one of their knights captures a piece, it turns its coat on the spot and fights for you for your next 3 turns, then rides back to them.

cards.name: Sinking Mire
cards.description: A mire of four squares opens in your opponent's half: no enemy piece may step onto it, though pieces caught inside may still climb out. It drains away one square on each of their turns until nothing is left, over 4 of their turns.

cards.name: Ashen Bread
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, killing the little ones curdles the stomach: any piece of theirs that captures one of your pawns is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Beartrap Cache
cards.description: Hide traps on 2 empty squares you choose: the first enemy piece to stop on each is caught and frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings step over traps.

cards.name: Bounty Posted
cards.description: Post a bounty for 5 of your opponent's turns: whenever YOU capture one of their pieces in that window, panic spreads and another of their pieces, chosen at random, is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Brittle Arsenal
cards.description: Every enemy bishop, rook and queen turns to a walnut for 1 of their turns: the whole long range arsenal reduced to shuffling.

cards.name: Burden of Command
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every time their queen moves, the whole army stops to salute: on their following turn they may move only their king. When the burden lifts, they bank one draft reroll.

cards.name: Choke Point
cards.description: Caltrops blanket the central 4x4 (c3 to f6): your opponent's pieces may not stop anywhere in it for their next turn. Their king picks its way through freely.

cards.name: Circling Vultures
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs with no friendly piece adjacent to it is watched too closely to fight: isolated pieces cannot capture.

cards.name: Creaking Gallows
cards.description: The gallows creak for 2 of your opponent's turns, then the rope drops: their most advanced piece at that moment (never the king) is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Crime Scene
cards.description: Starting after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns, every capture they make gets roped off: the square where the capture happened is sealed against them for 2 of their turns after the deed.

cards.name: Doting Retinue
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, pieces standing adjacent to their queen may not move: the retinue will not leave her side. The queen herself moves freely.

cards.name: Famine Year
cards.description: The harvest fails utterly: your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 5 turns. They may still capture diagonally.

cards.name: The Food Taster
cards.description: Paranoia grips the throne: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their queen may not end a move on any square one of your pieces attacks.

cards.name: Frozen Harbor
cards.description: The queenside harbor ices over: every enemy piece standing on files a, b or c is frozen for 1 of their turns, except the two most valuable, which resist the ice. Their king stays free.

cards.name: Gilded Cage
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their queen may only move to squares on their own back two ranks. The palace doors are locked from outside.

cards.name: Glass Ceiling
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, their pawns may not promote. The final step simply is not there.

cards.name: King's Ransom
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every time their king moves the ransom is collected: 2 of their other pieces, chosen at random, are frozen for 1 of their turns. The very first piece the ransom would seize slips free.

cards.name: Kraken Arms
cards.description: Three tentacles burst from the board: choose 3 enemy pieces (never the king). The first you choose may make one move before the tentacle seizes it; each of the three is held fast, frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Lovestruck Majesty
cards.description: Your opponent's queen falls head over heels: she may make one move, then is frozen, swooning, for 2 of their turns. Any other queens they have swoon at once.

cards.name: Mitred Blinders
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, their bishops may slide at most 1 square.

cards.name: Moat Diggers
cards.description: Your sappers dig 4 pits at random empty squares in your opponent's half. The defender keeps one as a bridge, the pit nearest their king; their pieces cannot stop on the other 3 for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Night Soil
cards.description: The first rank of your half of the board is freshly manured: your opponent's pieces cannot stop anywhere on it for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Oathbreaker's Brand
cards.description: A brand hangs over their castle gate for their next 6 turns: if your opponent castles in that window, the castling rook is frozen for 3 of their turns and their king wears the dunce cap for 8.

cards.name: Overslept Officers
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their knights and bishops cannot move. The officers overslept.

cards.name: Pawn Embargo
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, their pawns may not enter or move within your half of the board. The first pawn the border would stop may cross once, then it binds fully. The infantry is stopped at the border.

cards.name: Pawnbroker's Lien
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every pawn they move is seized as collateral: it is frozen for the remainder of the window.

cards.name: Poacher's Snare
cards.description: A snare waits at the border: within your opponent's next 6 turns, the first piece of theirs to enter your half of the board is caught and frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings slip the noose.

cards.name: Rusted Crown
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their queen may move only 1 square at a time, like a stiff old king.

cards.name: Sagging Shelves
cards.description: Their undeveloped officers are shelved: starting after your opponent's next move, every enemy knight and bishop still standing on its own back rank is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Second Frost
cards.description: The cold doubles down: starting after your opponent's next move, every freeze and every walnut then gripping your opponent's pieces lasts 1 of their turns longer.

cards.name: Silken Net
cards.description: Cast a net over a square you choose: every enemy piece except the king within one square of it is frozen for 1 of their turns, save the strongest caught piece, which slips the mesh.

cards.name: Solstice Shadow
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, the solstice shadow falls on their king's square color: pieces of theirs standing on that color cannot capture.

cards.name: Stone Garden
cards.description: All of your opponent's knights, bishops and rooks turn to walnuts for 1 of their turns, heavy nuts that can only shuffle one square at a time. Their two most valuable affected pieces resist and keep their footing.

cards.name: Thunderhead
cards.description: A storm gathers over their throne, in plain sight: after 1 of your opponent's turns, lightning falls and every piece adjacent to their king is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Tin Soldiers
cards.description: Their knights and bishops are recast as toy soldiers: wooden for 5 of their turns, and stiff jointed for the first 2, during which they may move at most 2 squares.

cards.name: Traitor's Gala
cards.description: Two of your opponent's knights or bishops, chosen at random, drink the wrong toast and become walnuts for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Velvet Rope
cards.description: Your back rank is roped off: your opponent's pieces cannot stop anywhere on it for their next 3 turns. No entry, no promotion party.

cards.name: I Love Abs
cards.description: Brace your core. Every one of your pieces standing in the central 16 squares becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Immobilizer
cards.description: One piece freezes all adjacent enemy pieces except kings while it stands there. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Iron Bishop
cards.description: One bishop cannot be captured by enemy pawns or knights, for the game.

cards.name: Iron Wall
cards.description: Every piece on your back rank, your king aside, is uncapturable for 2 turns.

cards.name: Kingslide
cards.description: Your king slides any distance in a straight line to an empty square, once. This move cannot capture.

cards.name: Landlord
cards.description: Claim four empty squares as your property. Any enemy piece (never a king) that ends its move on one of them owes rent: it is stuck fast for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Legendary Forge

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / pocket / unconditional

cards.description: The forge mends what war broke: one of your captured knights or bishops is reforged and returns to your pocket. Spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

cards.name: Mass Recall
cards.description: Return any two pieces to your back rank, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Medusa's Stare
cards.description: Turn one enemy queen you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: Metamorphosis
cards.description: Force a violent change of form on one of your own pawns, knights, or bishops: it reshapes itself into a rook, once. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Middle Part
cards.description: Not one hair off the axis: choose one of your pieces except the king or queen, and a perfect mirror copy of it materializes on the file-reflected square (a-file to h-file), if that square is empty. Once.

cards.name: Mind Control
cards.description: Choose one enemy knight or bishop; after your opponent's next move it turns to your color for the rest of the game, unless it has moved or been lost.

cards.name: Minor Recall

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Return a captured knight or bishop to your back rank, once.

cards.name: Mute Button
cards.description: You mute the loudest voices in their army: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks cannot capture. The first of those pieces they move gets one free move before the mute takes hold.

cards.name: Origami
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks are folded into paper cranes: they may move at most 1 square for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Ancestral Audience

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Revive your highest-value captured piece onto an empty square in your half. In fairness before the ancestors, your opponent's best captured pawn or minor returns to a random empty square in their half.

cards.name: Cartographer's Vault
cards.description: Your next 2 drafts each offer 3 cards.

cards.name: Demolition Derby
cards.description: Choose a 3x3 arena: every piece inside except kings lurches one random square (blocked pieces stay put), and any two that crash into the same square are both wrecked.

cards.name: Dev Console
cards.description: Open the console once and run the whole macro: spawn a pawn on a chosen empty square in your half, add 20 seconds to your clock, and dump your opponent's next draft offer to your screen.

cards.name: Flash Mob
cards.description: Four pawns appear on random empty squares of your third rank. They hold the final pose (cannot move) for 1 turn.

cards.name: Golden Goose
cards.description: Place a goose (a pawn stuck fast in golden honey) on an empty square in your half. For your next 8 turns it lays 6 seconds onto your clock after each of your moves. If it is captured, the gold stops.

cards.name: Growth Potion
cards.description: Choose one of your knights: it is a Warhorse for 5 of your turns. Each time it captures a pawn, you immediately move again, but that bonus move cannot capture.

cards.name: Lightning Rod
cards.description: Bolt a rod onto one of your pieces (not the king). If it is captured within 6 of your turns, the storm answers: the capturer is destroyed too.

cards.name: Milkman's Round
cards.description: Spawn a pawn on an empty square of your second rank now, and reserve a second square: in 3 of your turns another pawn is delivered there (or to any free second-rank square if yours got taken).

cards.name: Mole Tunnels
cards.description: The tunnels do not open until after your opponent's next move. Then, for 5 of your turns, up to twice: one of your pawns may tunnel to the empty square directly behind an enemy pawn on its own file.

cards.name: Paperwork Avalanche
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any enemy piece that captures is buried in forms and cannot move on their following turn.

cards.name: Write the Patch Notes
cards.description: Spend your turn: plant a new pawn on an empty square of your second rank, and your next draft is dealt exactly one tier higher.

cards.name: Plot Armor
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces (king excluded): it cannot be captured during your opponent's next 6 turns. The script insists.

cards.name: Priest Hole
cards.description: Once within 5 of your turns, while your king is in check: swap your king with one of your rooks standing on a square that is not currently attacked. Using this consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Regency Council
cards.description: For 4 of your turns, while your queen is off the board your rooks and bishops may also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Season Pass
cards.description: Swipe the gold card: gain 3 draft rerolls.

cards.name: Siege Ladder
cards.description: Slap ladders on one file: for 3 of your turns, your rooks, bishops and queen may slide straight through enemy pawns standing on that file.

cards.name: Sleeping Draught
cards.description: Dose one enemy knight or bishop. After your opponent's next move it falls asleep for their following 3 turns. It wakes early if any piece adjacent to it is captured.

cards.name: Time Heist
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn. 6 of your turns later the timeline collects: they take one extra move.

cards.name: Ventriloquist
cards.description: Once, throw your voice: pick an enemy knight and make it perform a legal knight move of your choice to an empty square. No captures.

cards.name: Overclock Major
cards.description: All your pieces may move like kings as an alternative, for 1 turn.

cards.name: Patch Notes
cards.description: The balance patch lands: your opponent's next draft is skipped. Once that draft has passed, you gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Pawn Nerf
cards.description: Nerf your opponent's pawns: their two-square double step is removed for the rest of the game. Every enemy pawn crawls one square at a time.

cards.name: Phalanx
cards.description: Your entire pawn line becomes uncapturable for 2 turns.

cards.name: Phantom Guardian
cards.description: Call up a phantom guardian: after your opponent's next move it appears and fights beside you as a bishop for 5 of your turns, then dissolves back into the aether.

cards.name: Phantom Rook
cards.description: Choose an empty square in your half; after your opponent's next move a rook appears there and vanishes after 4 of your turns.

cards.name: Piece Parole
cards.description: Release one of your pieces on parole: it gains a lasting shield, and your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Pizza Delivery
cards.description: The delivery scooter double-parks and the boxes pile up: choose three empty squares; your opponent's pieces cannot move onto them for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Captcha Check
cards.description: Select all squares with a bicycle to continue. Verification fails: whichever piece type your opponent has moved the most is locked and cannot move for their next turn.

cards.name: Chain Letter
cards.description: Forward to 10 friends or else: a cursed email hops around their army. One random enemy piece freezes each of your opponent's next 3 turns, jumping to a different piece every time. Never a king.

cards.name: Pop-up Storm
cards.description: HOT DEALS raining on their side: plant 1 pop-up window on an empty square in your opponent's half. For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that clicks onto it (a king is too careful to) is closed out of the game.

cards.name: Ratio'd
cards.description: Nobody asked, plus you fell off: after your opponent's next move, if that move captured one of your pieces, the capturing piece gets bonked straight back toward its own side by up to 2 squares.

cards.name: Purge Two
cards.description: Remove one enemy pawn, and freeze every other enemy pawn for their next turn.

cards.name: Queen of Stone
cards.description: The curse waits in her shoes: the next time your opponent moves their queen, she turns to a walnut for 3 of their turns the moment she lands.

cards.name: Recast
cards.description: Gain an extra draft reroll, and your next draft rolls one tier higher. The bonus reroll expires after two drafts if unspent.

cards.name: Royal Decree
cards.description: Your king gains queen movement for up to 2 of your turns, but the decree is spent the first turn a decreed move is available and your king does not take it (the king still loses on capture).

cards.name: Royal Duty
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn they may move only their king.

cards.name: Salted Earth
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns their pawns cannot advance; they may still capture diagonally. After that the salt lifts and their pawns advance normally again.

cards.name: Scout
cards.description: Take both cards in your next draft instead of one, but spend one of your rerolls. The take-both offer expires after two drafts if unused.

cards.name: Sea Monkeys
cards.description: Just add water: four tiny pawns hatch on random empty squares in your half and grow into real pawns.

cards.name: Sealed Gate
cards.description: Brick up one gate of your choosing: pick any square. The first enemy piece to step onto that square's file passes through freely; the instant it does, the whole file seals against your opponent for the remainder of their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Second Army
cards.description: Add two pawns to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Seelie Blessing
cards.description: The bright court smiles on one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and any freeze or stun on it melts away as the blessing lands.

cards.name: Shackle the Queen
cards.description: Bind the enemy queen in cursed iron: your opponent's next move slips free, then for the 4 of their turns after it they cannot move their queen.

cards.name: Siege Rook
cards.description: One rook slides along a clear rank or file to an empty square: it cannot capture, but the rank or file it travels stays barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Skibidi Flush
cards.description: Up to 3 enemy pieces (never the king) are sent back to their home squares, or the nearest empty square toward home.

cards.name: Skill Issue
cards.description: Diagnosis delivered: their minor pieces whiff every attack: enemy knights and bishops cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Snooze Button
cards.description: Pump sleeping gas down one file you pick: every enemy piece except the king standing on that file falls asleep and cannot move for their next turn.

cards.name: Solstice
cards.description: The longest day gives everyone one more step: for your next turn, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Stone Clergy
cards.description: Your opponent's bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time. The first bishop keeps one free move before it too sets.

cards.name: Sugar Rush
cards.description: Slam a sugar rush: take three extra moves right now. Then comes the sugar crash and you skip your next turn.

cards.name: Summon Knight
cards.description: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, once.

cards.name: Swap Meet
cards.description: Set up a stall and shake on a deal: your lowest-tier held card and a random one of your opponent's held cards are swapped between you.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.description: You deal your opponent the worst card in the deck: name one enemy rook. After your opponent's next move, it crumbles to rubble wherever it then stands.

cards.name: Timely Lull
cards.description: Free action: a lull settles over the whole board: both players' nerfs are suspended for their next 3 turns, used at the moment you choose.

cards.name: Total Recall
cards.description: Pull each of your pieces past your 4th rank back to your 3rd rank where empty, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Twin Knights
cards.description: Both knights become nightrooks, for the game.

cards.name: Twist the Knife
cards.description: Their drawback bites back: for your opponent's next 3 captures, the capturing piece is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Understudy
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, one of your bishops, or a knight if you have no bishop, immediately turns into a queen on its own square. If you have neither, nothing happens. Triggers once.

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.description: The whole room tilts sideways: for their next turn your opponent may only make diagonal moves. Their king keeps its footing and may still step anywhere.

cards.name: Bind the Queen
cards.description: Arcane chains seize the enemy queen and every piece standing next to her: they cannot move for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Blink
cards.description: Your king blinks: it trades places with one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, once.

cards.name: Borrowed Minute
cards.description: Borrow one enemy knight for a minute: it fights for you for your next 2 turns, then walks back to their side, or returns the moment it makes a capture. If it dies meanwhile, the loan is settled.

cards.name: Conjured Bishop
cards.description: Conjure your bishop's reflection: choose one of your bishops whose mirror square (same rank, file flipped left-to-right) is empty, and a new bishop appears there.

cards.name: Dominate

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Take control of one enemy knight or bishop for your next 2 turns. When the time is up it reverts to your opponent.

cards.name: Glyph Seal
cards.description: Seal one file: pick any square and its whole file becomes impassable to your opponent for their next turn, and every enemy piece already standing on it is bound in place for its next turn.

cards.name: High Roll
cards.description: Force your next draft offer to roll at tier 5.

cards.name: Mind Read
cards.description: Your opponent's next drafted buff arrives nullified, and their reroll token slips away if they hold one.

cards.name: Sigil Ward
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to move up next to it in that time is frozen for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Phase Field
cards.description: One of your bishops slips half out of the world: each move it may pass through a single piece of either color, for the game. It still cannot capture its own side.

cards.name: Void Rift
cards.description: Tear a permanent rift on an empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it (never a king) is pulled out of the game, and any enemy piece that ends its move on a square next to the rift is frozen for its next turn.

cards.name: Warding Circle
cards.description: You chalk a circle of old names around your throne: no enemy piece may end its move on any of the squares around your king, for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Warp Reign
cards.description: Swap the positions of your king and queen and shield both for your opponent's next 3 turns. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Warp Sovereign
cards.description: Swap up to three pairs of your pieces, once. Stop after any pair.

cards.name: Warp Storm
cards.description: Move up to four of your pieces, your king aside, one square each in any direction onto an empty square, once. The attempt is spent even if a chosen relocation turns out illegal when it resolves.

cards.name: Clumsy Dash
cards.description: Bolt for it and fumble: take one extra move right now, but one of your pawns is dropped and frozen in place for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Double Trouble

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: One of your knights or bishops splits in two: place its exact twin on an empty square right beside it.

cards.name: Haunted House
cards.description: Two rooms turn haunted: mark two empty squares and any enemy piece that enters one, never a king, vanishes. The haunting lasts 3 of your turns.

cards.name: Juggling Act
cards.description: Keep every plate spinning: take three extra moves right now, then it all comes crashing down and you skip your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Lost and Found
cards.description: Dig through the lost and found: pick the empty square in your half where a captured piece other than the queen will return. It reappears only after your opponent's next move, and only if that square is still empty. The heaviest lost piece comes back first.

cards.name: Voodoo Doll
cards.description: Stitch a little doll of the enemy army: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a random enemy piece of the very same type is destroyed in sympathy. Kings are never harmed.

cards.name: Ancient Grove

terms.note: 3-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Old roots give one piece back: return a captured rook, knight, or bishop to an empty square on your back rank; it returns after your opponent's next move, once.

cards.name: Arc Lightning
cards.description: One rook arcs lightning along a diagonal, removing up to two enemy pieces in its path (never a king) and landing beyond them. The bolt then jumps to freeze the nearest surviving enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

cards.name: Backdraft
cards.description: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, every enemy piece other than a pawn or king on the squares around it is destroyed.

cards.name: Bramble Wall
cards.description: Thorns snare the clergy: your opponent's bishops cannot move or capture for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Creeping Roots
cards.description: Roots grip at the border: your opponent's pawns cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Flame Lance
cards.description: One of your rooks breathes a lance of flame straight up its own file, without moving: the first enemy piece in the jet, if it is not a king, burns away. Friendly pieces block the flame, once.

cards.name: Glaciate
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece (never a king) for 3 of their turns, and the frost spreads: all but one of the enemy pieces directly beside it (up, down, left, or right) are frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Hailstorm
cards.description: After your opponent replies, freeze every one of their pawns for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
