cards.description: One queen charges a bolt down a diagonal; after your opponent's next move it fires, removing the first enemy piece in its path (never a king) and landing beyond it, once.

cards.name: Stone Soldiers
cards.description: Up to four of your pieces (never your king) are carved into stone soldiers: each cannot move and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns, then the stone crumbles and they wake.

cards.name: Undertow
cards.description: A current sweeps one of your pieces to any empty square, then drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward where it lands.

cards.name: Bayonet Charge
cards.description: One of your bishops charges diagonally, capturing the first enemy piece in its path and landing just beyond, once.

cards.name: Command Tent
cards.description: Your king may also leap like a knight to an empty square, without capturing, for the game.

cards.name: Defectors
cards.description: Mark one enemy pawn or knight: after your opponent's next move it turns to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

cards.name: Field Fortification
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of them, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Flanking Knights
cards.description: Both of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king, without capturing, for the game.

cards.name: Forward Observer
cards.description: The observer calls in indirect fire: for your next turn, your rooks may capture an enemy piece along a rank or file even when exactly one piece stands in the way. The blocker is unharmed; the rook lands on its target.

cards.name: Last Reserves

terms.note: up to, 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Commit everything: pick empty squares on your back rank; after your opponent's next move, up to two of your captured knights or bishops return to them, once.

cards.name: Sapper Team
cards.description: The sappers surface behind their lines: place a new pawn on an empty square in your opponent's half of the board.

cards.name: Spearhead
cards.description: One of your rooks drives in a straight line, capturing the first enemy piece in its path and stopping. The squares it punches through stay barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Suppressive Fire
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, every one of their knights is pinned down for their next 2 turns, and so is every enemy pawn standing directly beside one.

cards.name: Wyvern's Dive
cards.description: A wyvern folds its wings and dives: one of your knights streaks in a straight line, snatches the first enemy piece it reaches, and lands just beyond, once.

cards.name: Apotheosis

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / pocket / unconditional

cards.description: Raise one of your knights, bishops, or rooks to godhood: it leaves the board for a higher plane, and a queen joins your pocket to descend in its place on a later turn. In exchange, you skip your next draft.

cards.name: Army of the Dead
cards.description: The fallen answer the roll: one pawn musters into your pocket for every two of your pieces captured so far, plus one more, up to five in all. Drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Bee Swarm Simulator
cards.description: Choose 3 empty squares on the two centre ranks. After your opponent's next move, one of your pawns appears on each square still empty.

cards.name: Court Procession
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, your queen may slide straight through your own pieces (never capturing them) to squares beyond. Each such move reveals her landing square until your opponent replies.

cards.name: The Duke's Patent
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, your rooks may also step one square diagonally (capturing allowed). The moment one of your rooks captures, the patent lapses and the power ends.

cards.name: Field Hospital
cards.description: Return one of your captured pawns to an empty square in your half. It comes back bandaged: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Frozen Moat
cards.description: Every enemy piece standing in your half of the board (their king excepted) is frozen for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Gentlemen's Agreement
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 5 turns. As a courtesy, your opponent gains 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Grandma's Cookies
cards.description: Every one of your frozen or stuck pieces thaws at once, and each of them cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Griffin's Brood
cards.description: Your knights and bishops cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Heavy Price
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent captures one of your rooks or queens, your nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Holy Water
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 4 turns, and choose up to four of your pieces (your king counts): each chosen piece cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: House of Banners
cards.description: Choose up to two of your pawns that have reached the fifth rank or beyond. After your opponent's next move, each chosen pawn still standing is knighted where it stands.

cards.name: Leave of Absence
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 5 turns and gain 1 draft reroll, used at the moment you choose. On the last of those turns you may only step one square (a king step).

cards.name: Life Insurance
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces (your king excepted). When it is captured, a piece of the same kind pays out into your pocket, ready to drop on a later turn.

cards.name: The Old Guard
cards.description: One of your captured knights and one of your captured bishops both return at once, each to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: Open Season
cards.description: For the rest of the game, every capture you make suspends your nerf for your next turn.

cards.name: Pocket Cavalry
cards.description: A knight and a pawn join your pocket, ready to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns (each drop spends that turn).

cards.name: Quartermaster's Lock
cards.description: Choose up to four of your rooks or your queen: each chosen piece cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Royal Household
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the next 5 times you move your queen your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

cards.name: Royal Writ
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 4 turns, and your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Scapegoat

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Send one of your knights or bishops into the wilderness (it is removed and truly lost): your nerf is suspended for your next 12 turns. On the last of those turns you may only step one square (a king step).

cards.name: Shepherd's Watch
cards.description: None of your pawns can be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Smoke Break Union
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 6 turns. Each capture you make while it is suspended adds 2 more turns, up to 18 in total.

cards.name: Stone Cloak
cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) can never be captured, for the rest of the game. Your next draft is then skipped.

cards.name: Stray Cat

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: A pawn wanders in: place it on any empty square in your half. Then choose up to four of your pieces: each cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn while things settle.

cards.name: Triumphal Arch
cards.description: Your next capture grants you an immediate extra move. You cannot capture the king on that bonus move: your opponent replies first. Each of the two captures after that grants you 1 draft reroll instead.

cards.name: Velvet Queue
cards.description: Your next draft offer is fated to deal tier 6 cards.

cards.name: Veteran's Pension
cards.description: After your next 6 turns, your nerf is suspended for the 10 turns that follow. On the last of those turns you may only step one square (a king step).

cards.name: Wall of Faith
cards.description: Consecrate 6 empty squares of your choice, no two of them touching: no enemy piece may move onto them for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Winter Garrison
cards.description: Place three new pawns on empty squares on your second through fourth ranks. Only the first pawn you place cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Bombombini Gusini
cards.description: The bomber-goose lobs a stun grenade on a square: every enemy piece except a king in the 5 by 5 area centred on it (that square and the 24 around it) is bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Nobody is removed.

cards.name: Buff Thief
cards.description: Steal one active buff of any tier from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Alchemist's Trade
cards.description: One of your knights, bishops or rooks becomes a queen. In payment, another of your officers (not on a first or last rank) becomes a pawn.

cards.name: Bolt Hole
cards.description: Old castles keep old secrets: while your king is in check, it, or one other of your pieces, may escape through the walls to any empty square within 2 squares of where the king stands. The passage bears 2 such escapes, then collapses.

cards.name: Deathless Oath

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / capture gate

cards.description: One of your pieces (your king excepted) swears the oath: the first time it is captured, it instantly returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. One rebirth, then the oath is spent.

cards.name: Diplomatic Immunity
cards.description: Appoint one of your pieces (your king excepted) as an envoy: it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half of the board, for the rest of the game, but the protection ends the moment the envoy makes a capture. In your own half it is fair game.

cards.name: The Eternal Keep
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, your pieces standing on your first rank cannot be captured, your king excepted. The ward ends the moment your king crosses the midline into their half.

cards.name: Masquerade
cards.description: Two of your pieces trade masks: choose two of your knights, bishops, rooks or queens of different kinds, and they swap types where they stand. Your material never changes, only where the powers live.

cards.name: Prisoner Exchange
cards.description: Envoys meet at the river: your finest captured piece returns to the board, placed on the empty square nearest your home rank (queens first, then rooks, bishops, knights, pawns).

cards.name: Hallowed Ground
cards.description: Consecrate one empty square in your half: no enemy piece may ever stand on it, and while your king is in check it may step there from anywhere on the board.

cards.name: Kingsguard Duel
cards.description: Honor demands the guards settle it: remove one enemy piece standing beside your opponent's king, and in payment remove one of your own pieces standing beside your king. Both monarchs are left a little more exposed.

cards.name: Turn the Tide
cards.description: The whole line surges as one: every one of your pawns that can advance takes one non-capturing step forward at once, into the empty square directly ahead. Pawns whose square ahead is occupied, or that would reach the final rank, hold their ground.

cards.name: Watchword
cards.description: Up to four of your pieces, your king aside, that are defended by one of your pawns cannot be captured. When more than four qualify, the four most valuable are sheltered.

cards.name: Cast a Nerf
cards.description: Cast a nerf on your opponent: they cannot capture for their next 2 turns, though the first piece caught by the curse may still make one capture. Their next drafted card arrives nullified.

cards.name: Chimpanzini Bananini
cards.description: The banana-monkey goes ape: for the game every one of your knights may also slide diagonally up to two squares, keeping its knight leap on top. It gains no rook movement.

cards.name: Comet Shard

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: A shard of a passing comet crashes onto the board as a bishop: place it on any empty square in your half. It lands still glowing, and its light also shields up to three other pieces you choose: those four cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Gotham's THE ROOK!!
cards.description: Pick one of your rooks. For your next 2 turns it moves like a queen, and every capture it makes gains you 10 seconds.

cards.name: Loot Box
cards.description: Crack the crate and pray to the drop table. Legendary, the rarest, grants a random apex card. Epic grants a bishop and 30 seconds. Rare grants a knight. Common grants a pawn. Almost one in three is a mimic that bites off your weakest piece.

cards.name: Danielle
cards.description: Sunshine: grow three new pawns on any empty squares in your own half, basking in a warmth that keeps each of them uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Divine Reckoning
cards.description: Choose an enemy piece, not the king. It is sent to a free starting square of its kind if any, may make one last move, then freezes for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Doom March
cards.description: The march ends where it stands: after your opponent's next move, enemy pieces that have crossed into your half of the board are gripped by dread and cannot move, for the 4 of their turns after it.

cards.name: Double Queen
cards.description: Choose any one of your pawns, even mid-board; after your opponent's next move it promotes to a queen, unless it has moved or been lost.

cards.name: Duelist
cards.description: Choose one piece; after your opponent's next move it survives the first capture against it and that attacker dies instead, once (kings excluded).

cards.name: Expansion Permit
cards.description: The construction crew bolts a ninth file onto the board: for your next 3 turns your rooks and queens may slide off one side of the board and back on the other.

cards.name: Fault Line
cards.description: Split the board; enemy pieces cannot cross one file you pick, for 2 turns.

cards.name: Fissure Field
cards.description: The ground splits open behind the enemy army: your opponent cannot move any piece onto their own back rank for their next 4 turns.

cards.name: Windrider
cards.description: For your next 2 turns each of your bishops may also leap like a knight.

cards.name: Gorgon Gaze
cards.description: Every enemy knight and bishop turns to stone for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Phoenix Feather

terms.note: 3-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: One of your captured knights, bishops or rooks returns to the board on an empty square in your half. Knights first, then bishops, then rooks.

cards.name: Frost Wall
cards.description: A wall of blue ice seals the keep: your opponent cannot move any piece onto your back two ranks for their next 4 turns, save one bridge square left open for the defender, the wall square nearest their king.

cards.name: Frozen Moment
cards.description: The next piece your opponent moves freezes solid the instant it lands and cannot move again for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Fur Elise
cards.description: Run your fingers down the keys. Choose a bishop and glide it along one diagonal, sweeping away up to 3 enemy pieces in its path as it lands. Using it spends your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Geometry Dash
cards.description: One of your pieces hits the beat: it dashes straight forward, phasing over your own pieces and smashing up to 2 enemies in its lane before landing. Never kings.

cards.name: Ghost Legion
cards.description: All your pawns may jump over a blocker one square ahead, landing two ahead where empty, for 2 turns. The jump is use-it-or-lose-it: the first turn a jump is available but you move otherwise, Ghost Legion ends.

cards.name: Blood Wager
cards.description: Lay one of your knights or bishops on the dais: 55% it rises as a rook, 35% it is taken, 10% the blood god is DELIGHTED: a rook, plus a pawn steps out of the mist beside it.

cards.name: Gossamer Veil
cards.description: A shimmering veil of spider-silk tangles every long blade: your pieces cannot be captured by enemy bishops, rooks, or queens for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pawns, knights, and kings still cut through.

cards.name: Granite Ramparts
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and for their next 2 turns they cannot move any piece onto their own back two ranks.

cards.name: Great Wall
cards.description: One full rank you pick is impassable to enemies for 3 turns, but any enemy piece already standing on that rank is left free to move off it.

cards.name: Greenhouse

terms.note: promotion (target unstated, priced at a minor)

cards.description: Raise a glass dome over one file. For the game, your pawns may promote one rank early, on your 7th rank instead of your 8th, when they advance along that file, capture out of it, or capture into it.

cards.name: Haerin
cards.description: Cat's pounce: choose one of your pieces, then an enemy a knight's leap away. Snatch that piece off the board, land yours on its square, and it stands shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next turn, unless landing there gives check.

cards.name: Hanni
cards.description: Spotlight: choose an enemy piece. It and every enemy piece within two squares of it are charmed and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings shrug it off.

cards.name: Hard Frost
cards.description: Freeze two enemy pieces you target so they cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Hero's Journey
cards.description: The call to adventure rings out: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, and your bank offer improves by one tier.

cards.name: Homesick
cards.description: Your opponent's army is homesick: every piece may only move toward or along its own back rank for their next 4 turns. The first piece they move gets one free move before the pull sets in.

cards.name: Horn of Summoning
cards.description: One long note wakes the stone itself: for the rest of the game, your rooks may also step one square diagonally.

cards.name: Creeping Blight
cards.description: Blight one square in your opponent's half. Their next move may still cross it, then no enemy piece may move onto blighted ground, though pieces already there may leave. Each of their following turns it creeps to one more adjacent square, for 5 turns.

cards.name: Banquet of Dust
cards.description: Their heavy pieces are seated at a feast of nothing: for your opponent's next 5 turns, their queen and rooks cannot capture.

cards.name: Castle of Sand
cards.description: Both of your opponent's rooks crumble into walnuts for 4 of their turns: heavy husks that can only shuffle one square at a time. The first tower the sand would claim may make one move, then it too crumbles.

cards.name: Change of Step
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, each move they make must use a different piece type than their previous move. Their king is always allowed. The first move the drill would forbid slips through once, then the rule binds fully.

cards.name: Court in Session
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any of their pieces standing adjacent to their own king may not move. The king itself is free to go.

cards.name: Dead Letter
cards.description: Your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified: they still pick it, but it does nothing.

cards.name: High Water
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, their rooks and queen may not enter your half of the board. The first piece the flood would stop may cross once; after that it binds fully.

cards.name: Iron Portcullis
cards.description: The armory gate slams shut: your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and their following draft offers only two cards and cannot be rerolled.

cards.name: Lantern Out
cards.description: The lights go out at home: for your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot capture anything standing in their own half of the board.

cards.name: Lead Rain
cards.description: A rain of lead pins the field: 4 of your opponent's pieces, chosen at random (never the king), are frozen for 1 of their turns. Their single most valuable piece is immune and is never among them.

cards.name: Leaden Boots
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, none of their pieces may move more than 2 squares. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Night Ledger
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, their rooks and queen answer to the accountants: they may only move if the move is a capture. Quiet heavy moves are struck from the ledger.

cards.name: No Quarter
cards.description: Your half of the board rejects the invasion: every enemy piece currently standing in your half becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Quicksand Quarter
cards.description: The queenside quarter of your half (files a to d) turns to quicksand: your opponent's pieces may not stop there for their next 3 turns. Pieces already standing in the quarter may still move freely. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Sandstorm
cards.description: Grit chokes every sightline: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen may slide at most 3 squares. The first piece the storm would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Stone Rain
cards.description: Petrifying hail sweeps their lines: 5 of your opponent's pieces, chosen at random (never the king), become walnuts for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Summons to Court
cards.description: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king. The crown answers alone.

cards.name: Tar Pits
cards.description: Choose 3 empty squares: they become bubbling tar for 3 of your opponent's turns, and none of their pieces may stop on them. The first piece the tar would stop may wade through once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: The Bell Tolls
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn entirely. The board waits for no one, except them.

cards.name: Tidal Wall
cards.description: Your opponent's pieces cannot stop on either central rank, the 4th and 5th, for their next 2 turns, save one bridge square left standing: the wall square nearest their king.

cards.name: The Toy Box
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, their non-knight pieces may move at most 1 square; their knights move normally.

cards.name: Tribute Demand
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture they make demands tribute: whichever of their other pieces stands nearest the kill is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Wall of Teeth
cards.description: Your two back ranks grow a wall of teeth: for your opponent's next 3 turns their pieces cannot stop anywhere on them, though any piece already standing there may still move freely. No infiltration, no promotion.

cards.name: Hyein
cards.description: Long legs: for the game each of your pawns may also stride straight forward to the first or second empty square ahead, springing over anything in between.

cards.name: I Love Chaewon
cards.description: Fearless choreography: gracefully reposition up to 3 of your pieces, gliding each to any empty square in your own half of the board.

cards.name: Iron Furrow
cards.description: The field is sown with iron spikes: your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, and any enemy pawn that captures during that time is caught on the spikes, unable to move for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Iron Will
cards.description: Whenever your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next turn, beginning after your opponent's following move.

cards.name: Ironclad
cards.description: Every piece on your back two ranks, your king aside, cannot be captured for 2 turns.

cards.name: La Vaca Saturno Saturnita
cards.description: The ringed cow swings into orbit: place a new knight on any empty square along the board's outer rim. While it settles it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, but this orbit shelter burns out early once the new knight has captured twice.

cards.name: Lone Sovereign
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king and their knights. Every other piece is stuck fast.

cards.name: Lost Weekend
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and their clock loses 20 seconds.

cards.name: Mass Promote Minor
cards.description: Two pawns on your 4th rank or beyond become knights instantly. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Medusa's Verdict
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, their queen turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and every enemy piece then standing next to her is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Mind Dominion

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Take control of one enemy rook or bishop for the game.

cards.name: Mind Empire
cards.description: Take control of one enemy piece of any type below queen. Your control ends the moment that piece makes a capture, and it returns to your opponent.

cards.name: Minji
cards.description: Leader's guard: every one of your pieces standing within two squares of your king links arms and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns, but the guard drops the instant two of the protected pieces have captured.

cards.name: Mirror of Souls
cards.description: You hold the glass between two reflections: name one of your pieces and an enemy piece of the same kind. After your opponent's next move, they trade places. Kings cast no reflection.

cards.name: Necromancer

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / temporary 5 turns / unconditional

cards.description: Raise your strongest fallen piece as a spectre on an empty square in your half. It fights for you, then crumbles to dust after 5 of your turns. If nothing of yours has been captured, nothing rises.

cards.name: Archmage's Sabbatical
cards.description: For 4 of your turns, instead of a normal move you may teleport one of your pieces (king excluded) to any empty square in your half.

cards.name: Blood Moon
cards.description: For your next 3 moves, any capture you make lets you immediately move again.

cards.name: Coliseum
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces and an enemy piece of equal or greater value (kings excluded): both are removed, and you gain 10 seconds per point of value difference.

cards.name: Deja Vu
cards.description: You take one extra move right away, and the enemy piece that moved last (king excluded) is stuck in the loop and cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Duplicate Glitch
cards.description: Dupe glitch: gain a second copy of a random unspent card you hold. If your hand is empty, gain 2 draft rerolls instead.

cards.name: Emergency Patch
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, one randomly chosen enemy slider type (bishop, rook or queen) is limited to moves of 2 squares that turn.

cards.name: Fireworks Barge
cards.description: Choose a 2x2 area: at the end of your opponent's next turn the rockets go off. Enemy pawns inside are destroyed; every other piece inside except kings is pushed one square outward if the square is free.

cards.name: Lantern Festival
cards.description: Revive up to 4 of your captured pawns onto empty squares of your second rank as lantern wisps. Any still on the board after 6 of your turns drift away.

cards.name: Mod Powers
cards.description: Mute up to 3 enemy pieces (king excluded): they cannot move on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Off-Broadway Queen
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns: it promotes to a queen the moment it stands on your 6th rank. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Pied Piper
cards.description: Choose a file: up to two enemy pawns on it are lured one square toward you, onto empty squares, most advanced first.

cards.name: Promotion Jubilee
cards.description: For 5 of your turns, the first of your pawns to step or capture onto the seventh rank may promote there, but only to a rook, bishop, or knight. That one early promotion ends the jubilee.

cards.name: Puppet Practice
cards.description: Once: move an enemy bishop or rook yourself, along its normal lines, onto an empty square. No captures.

cards.name: Squire's Ascension
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, one of your pawns is knighted, permanently becoming a knight. If it ever captures a queen, it is crowned a queen.

cards.name: Tornado
cards.description: A funnel travels a chosen file: every piece within one file of it (kings excluded) is flung to a random empty square in its own half.

cards.name: Winter Palace
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any enemy piece except the king that ends its move on your back two ranks is frozen in ice for 1 turn.

cards.name: World Serpent
cards.description: For 4 of your turns the serpent bites its tail: your rooks' and queen's horizontal moves wrap around the board edge.

cards.name: Overclocked
cards.description: Crank the clock speed: add 75 seconds to your own clock. Then everything runs hot and has to cool down, so for your next 3 turns all your pieces can move only one square.

cards.name: Pay to Win
cards.description: Money buys more of whatever is working: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, and a store-bought copy of it joins your pocket, ready to drop onto an empty square on a later turn. The bill comes due at the shop: you skip your next draft.

cards.name: Peasant Levy
cards.description: The levy defends only the homeland: for your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only pieces standing in their own half of the board. Anything already across the middle is stranded.

cards.name: Phase Army
cards.description: Your bishops, rooks, and queen pass through one friendly piece per move for 1 turn.

cards.name: Pop-up Ad
cards.description: An ad nobody can close appears on the board: place a knight on any empty square. It is finally dismissed after 4 of your turns.

cards.name: Promote Now
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns on your 6th rank or beyond; it promotes to a queen after your opponent's next move, once.

cards.name: Puck's Mischief
cards.description: A hobgoblin ties every royal shoelace together: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks may move only one square at a time.

cards.name: Purge
cards.description: Remove one enemy piece below queen rank from the board.

cards.name: Queen's Echo
cards.description: Your rooks move like queens for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Rampart
cards.description: Place a pawn on each of three empty squares you choose in your half; those pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns, but the shield ends early once two of the protected pawns have made a capture.

cards.name: Rehab
cards.description: Check into rehab: your nerf is suspended permanently for the rest of the game, but your next two drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.description: Two pawns march in from the depot right now: place them on empty squares of your back two ranks.

cards.name: Rent-a-Rook
cards.description: A rook arrives on loan: place it on an empty square in your half. It cannot be captured while on loan, but that loaner protection lapses once it has made two captures, and it drives off after 5 of your turns.

cards.name: Resurrect
cards.description: Bring back your strongest captured piece to your half, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Resurrect Major

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Revive a captured rook or bishop to any empty square, once.

cards.name: Scorched Middle
cards.description: Your opponent cannot enter the 4th or 5th ranks for their next 3 turns, save one bridge: the square on their king's file, on whichever of the two ranks sits nearer their own side, stays passable.

cards.name: Second Wind Major
cards.description: Return a captured rook to any empty back-rank square, once. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Sever
cards.description: Permanently disable one enemy buff and block its retrigger.

cards.name: Shatter
cards.description: Choose one enemy rook, bishop, or knight; after your opponent's next move it shatters into a walnut for the rest of the game (it can only shuffle one square at a time), unless it has moved or been lost.

cards.name: Smurf Account
cards.description: A suspiciously strong new player joins your side mid-game: choose an empty square in your half, and a fresh rook drops in there right after your opponent's next move, so it cannot capture before they reply.

cards.name: Spirit Guide
cards.description: A patient spirit settles into one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it may also step one square in any direction, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: Staff of Stasis
cards.description: Bind the staff to one of your pieces: whoever dares capture it is locked in a bubble of frozen time for 3 of their turns. The ward lasts the rest of the game.

cards.name: Starfall
cards.description: A rook crashes down into your pocket: drop it onto any empty square on a later turn.

cards.name: Statue Stable
cards.description: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and your own knights harden into living statues: they cannot be captured for those same 2 turns.

cards.name: Stone Golem
cards.description: Bind a spirit into rock and stone: a lumbering golem serves as a rook for 5 of your turns, then crumbles back to rubble.

cards.name: Stone Menagerie
cards.description: Target two enemy minor pieces (knights or bishops). After your opponent's next move, both are petrified for 3 of their turns.

cards.name: Supply Drop
cards.description: A knight is airlifted into your reserves, and a crate of spares lands with it as a pawn, arriving only after your opponent's next move. Later, spend turns to drop them onto empty squares.

cards.name: Throne Bound
cards.description: The queen may not stray from her king: for your opponent's next 3 turns, her every move must end within 2 squares of their king.

cards.name: Total Freeze
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, freeze every enemy piece except the king that stands on a square next to one of your pieces, for 1 turn.

cards.name: The Void Realm
cards.description: Three squares you pick become voids for your opponent's next three turns: any enemy piece except a king that lands directly on one is swallowed. Pieces beside a void are safe.

cards.name: Border Ward
cards.description: A warded frontier: for their next 2 turns your opponent may not move any piece into your half of the board, unless the move captures.

cards.name: Disjunction
cards.description: The conjuration is disjoined: up to two pieces waiting in your opponent's pocket wink out of existence, strongest first.

cards.name: Jinx
cards.description: The jinx sours every friendship: for their next 2 turns, your opponent's pieces cannot end a move on a square beside another of their own pieces.

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.description: Saboteurs in their war room: your opponent's next draft is skipped, and their reroll token is stolen away if they still hold one.

cards.name: Spelltheft
cards.description: A trade, technically: steal any one of your opponent's unused buffs, but the spell demands payment: your own lowest-tier unused card goes to them in exchange. Casting it also spends one of your draft rerolls, if you have any.

cards.name: Stolen Hours
cards.description: Steal 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and take one extra move this turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move.

cards.name: Twin Familiars
cards.description: A familiar perches on each of your bishops: for the rest of the game your bishops may also step one square straight (up, down, or sideways) but never to capture, finally changing their color.

cards.name: Unmake
cards.description: The next capture your opponent makes is unmade: their piece snaps back to the square it came from, and your captured piece is restored where it stood. Kings cannot be unmade.

cards.name: Watermelon Rind
cards.description: Duck behind the rind: every one of your pieces standing on your back two ranks cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pieces further forward are outside the shell.

cards.name: Attack Goose
cards.description: An attack goose invades your opponent's half as a knight for 2 of your turns, then honks off.

cards.name: Berserk Pawn

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: One of your pawns flies into a frenzy: for your next 3 turns it also moves like a queen, then it burns out and is removed from the board.

cards.name: Butterfingers
cards.description: Your whole army is slathered in butter: enemy pawns and knights cannot capture your pieces for their next 2 turns. Nothing short-armed can keep a grip.

cards.name: Confetti Cannon
cards.description: Your next capture goes off like a confetti cannon: every enemy piece other than a king within one square of the captured square is blown off the board.

cards.name: Conga Line
cards.description: The whole line dances one step to the side: every one of your pawns shifts one square toward the board edge you pick, onto an empty square only, never a capture (pawns with no room sit the song out).

cards.name: Deal with the Devil
cards.description: Sign here: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but the devil collects and you skip your next 2 turns, and the signing burns your next unused draft reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Hot Seat
cards.description: The spotlight swings to their king and queen: on your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their queen, and neither of them may capture.

cards.name: Musical Chairs
cards.description: The music stops: swap the squares of one of your pieces and one of your opponent's pieces, once. Neither may be a king.

cards.name: Repo Rook

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: A repo man's rook rolls up behind enemy lines: place it on an empty square in your opponent's half, and it tows itself away after 3 of your turns.

cards.name: Shy Pieces
cards.description: Your opponent's pieces are too shy to approach the crown: for their next 2 turns none of them may move onto a square touching your king.

cards.name: Ball Lightning
cards.description: Your next 2 captures each also destroy the enemy pieces (never a king) on the two squares immediately left and right of the captured square.

cards.name: Firestorm
cards.description: After your opponent replies, a firestorm falls on the crossroads: every enemy piece except a king standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) is consumed.

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.description: Your opponent's pieces go numb: for their next turn they cannot make any capture, and no piece may move more than 2 squares.

cards.name: Mountain Range
cards.description: Three peaks heave up out of the board: pick three empty squares; your opponent's pieces can never move onto them, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Overgrowth
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns; after your opponent replies it blooms into a queen for your next 3 turns, then withers back into a pawn.

cards.name: Petrify the Ranks
cards.description: Every enemy knight and bishop turns to stone: they cannot move for their next 2 turns. The card is spent even if your opponent has no knights or bishops to petrify.

cards.name: Riptide
cards.description: A countercurrent runs through the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that ends its move on the 4th or 5th rank is dragged one square back toward its home rank, when that square is free.

cards.name: Stoneskin
cards.description: Choose up to four of your pieces: they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and every enemy piece standing next to one of them is locked in place for its next turn.

cards.name: Thunderhead
cards.description: A charged cloud takes shape as a knight on an empty square in your half, and its arrival blasts one enemy pawn standing beside it off the board. It fights for 3 of your turns, then rolls away.

cards.name: White Monster
cards.description: Crack the can: take 2 extra moves right now for a triple-move turn. Zero sugar means zero crash. Once.

cards.name: Withering Touch
cards.description: One enemy piece freezes solid for 2 of their turns, then withers to a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Claymore Line
cards.description: Mark two empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto either one, a king aside, is destroyed along with every enemy piece on the squares around it. The mines stay armed for the game.

cards.name: Demolition Charge
cards.description: Rig one of your pieces with charges: each of its next two captures also destroys the enemy's least valuable piece standing next to the capture square (ties break toward the lower square). Kings are never caught in the blast.

cards.name: Form Square
cards.description: Pick any square: your pieces standing on it or any of the up-to-eight squares around it, your king aside, cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: High Ground
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: for the game it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half, but its shield drops on any turn it is giving check to the enemy king.

cards.name: Mass Defection
cards.description: Mark two enemy pawns: after your opponent's next move they turn to your side for the rest of the game, once.

cards.name: Muster the Ranks
cards.description: The trumpet sounds and the whole line steps off: every one of your pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square. Pawns one step from the last rank hold their ground.

cards.name: Outriders
cards.description: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, then up to two different pawns each advance one square behind it.

cards.name: Recommission
cards.description: Return one of your captured rooks to an empty square on your back rank. For the rest of the game the refitted rook may pass through one friendly piece on each move, landing only on an empty square (it cannot capture on a phased move).

cards.name: Relentless Assault
cards.description: Each of your next two capturing moves immediately grants you an extra move. You cannot capture the king on a bonus move: your opponent replies first. Once both bonus moves are spent, you skip your next draft.

cards.name: Zodiac Wheel
cards.description: You read all twelve houses at once: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, all fated to tier 4.

cards.name: Abyss
cards.description: Two squares you pick open an abyss for the game: any enemy piece except a king that enters is swallowed. The defender keeps one bridge, the void nearest the enemy king, which never swallows.

cards.name: Amazon Knight
cards.description: One knight becomes a knight plus queen for 2 turns.

cards.name: Annihilate
cards.description: Remove one enemy piece below the queen, and freeze every enemy piece orthogonally beside it for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Ball and Chain
cards.description: Their drawback grows teeth: for your opponent's next 5 turns, the piece they just moved must rest a turn before moving again.

cards.name: Bayview Secondary School
cards.description: Detention for the whole class. Choose a square: after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece except the king in the 3 by 3 around it is locked in place for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: 225 Bench
cards.description: Press 225 and shove up to 3 enemy pieces one square back toward their own home rank. Blocked pieces stay put, nobody is captured.

cards.name: Blitzkrieg
cards.description: Take one bonus move now, then one more stored bonus move on your next turn after your opponent replies. You cannot capture the king during a bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Blood Pact
cards.description: Sign in blood: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but another pawn of yours, you choose which, bursts and is lost.

cards.name: Ancestral Shield
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, none of your pieces can be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Castle Ditch
cards.description: Every empty square around your king becomes a moat for your opponent's next 5 turns: no enemy piece may advance onto them, though the moat cannot stop a capture that lands there.

cards.name: Clay Colossus
cards.description: Raise a rook of fired clay on an empty square on your home rank. It serves like the real thing, then crumbles after 8 of your turns.

cards.name: Cornucopia

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / pocket / unconditional

cards.description: The horn tips over: two pawns join your pocket, a knight or a bishop (at random, even odds) joins them, and you gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Dancing Master
cards.description: For your next 2 turns, your knights may also move like bishops and your bishops may also leap like knights.

cards.name: Diplomatic Pouch
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 5 turns, and see the cards in your opponent's next draft offer.

cards.name: Double Pardon
cards.description: Both players' nerfs are suspended for their next 6 turns. On the last of your 6 turns you may only step one square (a king step).

cards.name: Fisherman King
cards.description: Once, your king may slip away to any empty square directly beside one of your rooks. On arrival it cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Guardian of the Line
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, your queen cannot be captured while she stands beside your king, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Hidden Clause
cards.description: After your next 8 turns, a buried clause activates: your nerf is suspended for the 12 turns that follow.

cards.name: Hollow Crown
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended while their queen is off the board.

cards.name: Hourglass Throne
cards.description: Add 60 seconds to your clock and steal 30 more from your opponent's. In untimed games nothing changes hands.

cards.name: Long Holiday
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended for your next 8 turns.

cards.name: Marshal's Baton
cards.description: Redraw the whole line: move up to 3 of your pieces (your king excepted) to empty squares anywhere on the board. The first piece you move cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Minister's Seal
cards.description: Free action, used at the moment you choose: your nerf is suspended for your next 7 turns, beginning after your opponent's next reply.

cards.name: Pillars of Home
cards.description: While at least two of your rooks stand on the board, your nerf is suspended.

cards.name: Quiet Coup
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 6 turns, and your next draft offer rolls one tier higher. On the last of those turns you may only step one square (a king step).

cards.name: Raven's Court
cards.description: See both the cards and the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, and gain 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: Relief Column
cards.description: Your best captured rook and your best captured minor (a bishop, or else a knight) both return to empty squares nearest your home rank. The muster costs your next draft, which is skipped.

cards.name: Rule of Three
cards.description: Every 3rd capture you make suspends your nerf for your next 4 turns. Lasts the rest of the game.

cards.name: Saint's Procession
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, none of your pieces can be captured and your king cannot be taken. The blessing ends the moment one of your pieces makes a capture.

cards.name: Second Spring
cards.description: Every one of your captured pawns returns at once, each to the empty square nearest your home rank. Your next draft is then skipped.

cards.name: Spymaster's Leave
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 5 turns, learn the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, and gain 2 draft rerolls. On the last of those turns you may only step one square (a king step).

cards.name: Stormcrossing
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, your bishops, rooks and queen may slide straight through your own pieces (never capturing them) to squares beyond. A piece that crosses this way cannot move again on your next turn.

cards.name: Tithe of Time
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 9 turns, and steal 20 seconds from your opponent's clock. In untimed games only the suspension applies.

cards.name: Tower Toll
cards.description: Tear down one of your rooks (it is removed and truly lost): your nerf is suspended for your next 14 turns.

cards.name: Worldgate
cards.description: Open the great door: move up to 3 of your pieces (your king excepted) to empty squares anywhere on the board, all at once.

cards.name: Early Coronation
cards.description: The heralds cannot wait, though the coronation is a modest one: once, a pawn move of yours that reaches your opponent's second rank may promote on the spot to a rook, bishop, or knight.

cards.name: Spoils of War

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: The finest piece you have captured defects to your colours: place it on an empty square on your home rank. It leaves your opponent's revival pool for eighteen of your turns, then rejoins it, and you gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: From the Ashes
cards.description: The dead are called back only far enough to make it even: your captured pieces return one at a time to your home rank, strongest first, until your non-king pieces number exactly as many as your opponent's. From ahead or level, nobody rises.

cards.name: Funeral Pyre

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Light one of your own and let it take the neighbors with it: choose any of your pieces (your king aside). It is removed, and every enemy piece on a square adjacent to it is destroyed in the blast. Shielded enemies and enemy kings survive.

cards.name: King's Sanctuary
cards.description: Spirit the king home to the quietest corner: your king is moved to the empty square on your home rank that sits furthest from any enemy piece.

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.description: Clear all but one of the enemy pawns on the board.

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.description: One bishop captures up to three enemy pieces down a diagonal and lands beyond them; the bolt then jumps on to freeze the next enemy piece further along that diagonal for 2 of their turns, once.

cards.name: Changeling
cards.description: The cradle swap ran the other way: one enemy knight or bishop you choose was a changeling all along. The glamour breaks and it is just a pawn.

cards.name: Chaos Theory
cards.description: A tornado sweeps the board: every pawn, yours and your opponent's, is randomly reshuffled among the squares pawns currently stand on. Happens once.

cards.name: Check Out Our Socials
cards.description: Go live to the squad. Freeze up to 3 enemy pieces except the king for their next turn, then take one bonus move.

cards.name: Collapse
cards.description: Pull every enemy piece except the king one square toward their back rank across the whole board, once.

cards.name: Colossus
cards.description: One piece becomes uncapturable and gains queen movement for 3 turns, but while it is shielded it cannot give check.

cards.name: Creeping Frost
cards.description: Freeze three enemy pieces (not the king) for 2 of their owner's turns. The first piece you choose gets one escape move: its freeze sets in only after your opponent's next move.

cards.name: Detonation Field
cards.description: Your next three captures each remove at most one adjacent enemy piece: the most valuable non-king beside the captured square, kings aside. The blast never chains.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to strike at your king in that time is hurled clean off the board. Kings are never banished.

cards.name: Divine Mandate

terms.note: 3-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: You speak with the authority of heaven: one enemy knight, bishop, or rook joins your army, and heaven shields the defection so it cannot be recaptured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Kings cannot be swayed.

cards.name: Double Amazon
cards.description: Choose two knights; each may make one queen-style move once, then moves as a normal knight again.

cards.name: Draft Domination
cards.description: Force your opponent's next draft down to tier 2, so both cards they are offered come from a weak tier.

cards.name: Draft Seize
cards.description: Take both cards in your next draft and skip your opponent's next, though they gain a reroll in return.

cards.name: Endless Turn
cards.description: Take exactly one bonus move. If that bonus move does not capture, take one more bonus move after your opponent replies.

cards.name: Eternal Statue
cards.description: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for 6 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Everfrost Shard
cards.description: Freeze one enemy piece you target for 4 of their turns. The shard radiates: for those 4 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto a square beside it. Kings cannot be targeted.

cards.name: Lifebloom
cards.description: One of your captured pawns returns to an empty square on your fourth rank and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Dragonblood
cards.description: For your next 4 turns your queen may also leap like a knight.

cards.name: Iron Maiden

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Choose an enemy piece other than the king. It is locked in place for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Full Planche
cards.description: Lock one of your pieces into a perfect hold. It slides like a rook along every open rank and file for the game, and hovers uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns, until the moment it makes a capture, which ends the immunity early.

cards.name: Full Rewind
cards.description: Send up to five of your pieces back to their original home squares, once.

cards.name: Giant's Maul
cards.description: The maul comes down once: crush one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and the shock leaves every enemy piece beside it (kings aside) frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Gacha Banner
cards.description: Three pulls, resolved on the spot: 55% common, a random pawn sidesteps; 30% rare, a pawn spawns on your second rank; 12% epic, a random tier 4 card joins your hand; 3% SSR, a random tier 7 card. Pity rule: three commons upgrade the third to epic.

cards.name: Martingale
cards.description: Flip until you miss, half odds each flip, ladder capped at four. One win pays a pawn, two pays two pawns, three a knight and a pawn, four a rook and a knight. You keep the rung you reached.

cards.name: Progressive Jackpot
cards.description: For 6 of your turns every capture by either side drops a soul in the pot. When time is called, whoever made the LAST capture summons the pot: 2 souls a pawn, 4 a knight, 6 or more a rook, placed in their half. No captures, no winner.

cards.name: The House
cards.description: For 6 of your turns you ARE the house: every draft either player resolves pays you a chip. Cash out automatically: 2 chips buy a reroll, 4 chips a fresh pawn on your second rank.

cards.name: Grand Summon
cards.description: Add a knight and a bishop to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns; your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Gravity Well
cards.description: Your king bends space around it: enemy pieces standing within one square of your king are caught in orbit and cannot move to a square farther from it. Enemy kings are not affected.

cards.name: Grounded Command
cards.description: The heavy pieces are grounded: for your opponent's next 4 turns a queen or rook still in their own half cannot move onto any square in your half. One already standing in your half moves freely.

cards.name: Pauper's Crown
cards.description: Their queen becomes a rook for 4 of their turns, or until she captures. If she is taken while a rook, she is lost as a rook.

cards.name: Effigy of Dread
cards.description: Raise a leering effigy on an empty square in your opponent's half. No enemy piece may step onto the ring around it, though a piece already inside may leave. It stands 6 of their turns, and it is a piece they can capture: smashing it ends the curse.

cards.name: The Inverted Crown

terms.note: promotion (target unstated, priced at a minor)

cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn that reaches the last rank is crowned a mere knight, no matter what they choose to promote to.

cards.name: Powder Keg
cards.description: Roll a powder keg onto an empty square in your opponent's half with a lit 4-turn fuse, in full view. When it blows, every enemy piece except the king standing on or next to that square is blown off the board, and you gain one draft reroll.

cards.name: Black Lotus
cards.description: The lotus blooms once over their army: one random pawn, knight, bishop, rook and queen of theirs (one of each they still have) is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Chain Gang
cards.description: On your opponent's next turn, every piece they own may move at most 1 square, except their single most valuable piece, which the chains spare. King captures are always allowed.

cards.name: Dead Calm
cards.description: The wind dies: for your opponent's next 2 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen may slide at most 1 square. The first piece the calm would rein in may slide freely once, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Dead March
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns, the drums forbid haste: on every second turn (the 2nd, 4th and 6th) their rooks and queen cannot move.

cards.name: Frozen Reserves
cards.description: The reserves never got the mobilization order: every enemy piece standing on their own back rank, except pawns and the king, is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Gorgon's Court
cards.description: Choose 2 enemy pieces (never the king): both become walnuts for 3 of their turns. The first piece chosen may make one move before it petrifies.

cards.name: Grave Chill
cards.description: A chill rises from below: every enemy piece standing on a dark square is frozen for 1 of their turns. Their king shivers but stays free.

cards.name: Hall of Mirrors
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, every piece must land on a square of the same color it started from. Knights, whose every leap changes color, cannot move at all. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Hunter's Moon
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is cursed by the moon and becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns. Kings are beyond the curse.

cards.name: Pied Piper
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then the pipe plays and the infantry follows: for their next 2 turns, if any pawn move is available they must move a pawn.

cards.name: Prowler's Bell
cards.description: A bell is tied to every gate in your half: for your opponent's next 3 turns, their pieces may not end a move on an EMPTY square in your half. They may enter only by capturing. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Quagmire March
cards.description: Your half of the board turns to bog: your opponent's next move passes freely, then for their following 3 turns, any piece of theirs standing in your half may move at most 1 square. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Reaper's Due
cards.description: The reaper collects from the front line: your opponent's 3 most advanced pieces (never the king) are frozen for 2 of their turns. The most advanced of them may make one move before it freezes.

cards.name: Sealed Meridian
cards.description: Choose a file: for 2 of your opponent's turns none of their pieces may cross it, though they may move along it, stop on it, or leave it. Your pieces pass freely.

cards.name: Spider's Parlor
cards.description: Invisible webs stretch between the armies: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move adjacent to one of your pieces is snared and frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings tear free.

cards.name: Jackpot
cards.description: Pull the lever for a one-in-two shot at a random apex card, one of the game's most powerful. Miss, and the consolation is still rich: your next draft rolls one tier higher and offers three cards instead of two.

cards.name: Leaden Fields
cards.description: Their pawns are cast in lead: every advanced enemy pawn first sinks one square back toward home (if that square is free), and then their pawns cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Lich Phylactery
cards.description: The first time your queen is captured, a new queen appears on her home square, or on the nearest empty square of your back rank if her home is taken.

cards.name: Lightning Strike
cards.description: Mark up to three enemy knights, bishops, or pawns; after your opponent's next move, lightning falls and removes each marked piece that still stands.

cards.name: Lost Days
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn entirely. On the turn after that, they may move only pawns, knights, or their king.

cards.name: Loyal Pawn

terms.note: promotion (target unstated, priced at a minor)

cards.description: Once, a pawn stepping onto your 7th rank may promote there instead of the 8th. The new piece cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Lunar Eclipse
cards.description: The moon slides into shadow and the enemy's great powers still with it: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for 3 of their turns, though the first of them may slip away with one move before the shadow takes it.

cards.name: Mass Resurrect
cards.description: Revive any four captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

cards.name: Nova
cards.description: Sacrifice one pawn to clear every enemy piece except the king from its file, once.

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.description: The whole army surges: for your next 3 turns, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: Cloud Serpent
cards.description: A serpent coils a chosen rank: enemy pieces cannot enter or cross it for your opponent's next 5 turns (yours can). As it lands it may crush one enemy pawn on an adjacent rank.

cards.name: Frost Wyrm
cards.description: An ice dragon sweeps a chosen rank: every enemy piece on it (king excluded) is frozen for 2 turns, and its empty squares become ice walls your opponent cannot enter for their next turn.

cards.name: Grail Quest
cards.description: Send one of your knights away on quest. After 5 of your turns it returns to a random empty square in your half as a Grail Knight, permanently able to also step one square in any direction.

cards.name: The Great Flood
cards.description: A wave washes every piece on the central four ranks (kings excluded) one square toward its own back rank, where that square is empty. Blocked pieces stay.

cards.name: Heavenly Bureaucracy
cards.description: Once within your next 8 turns: when an enemy move puts your king in check, the check is misfiled and your king is relocated to a random empty square that is not attacked. If no safe square exists, the filing stands.

cards.name: High Water Mark
cards.description: The middle two ranks flood: for your opponent's next 3 turns their bishops, rooks and queens cannot move through them, only into them.

cards.name: Locust Swarm
cards.description: Choose a rank: every pawn on it, yours and theirs, is devoured.

cards.name: NerfChess: The Musical
cards.description: The whole board takes the stage, once: rearrange up to five of your pieces onto empty squares in your half, then collect 10 seconds for putting on a show.

cards.name: Puppeteer's Gala
cards.description: Pull the strings: move up to two different enemy minor pieces yourself, each along its own normal non-capture moves, onto empty squares.

cards.name: Royal Food Taster
cards.description: Place a Taster pawn on an empty square next to your queen. The next time your queen is captured, the Taster dies in her place and your queen returns on the Taster's square.

cards.name: Parole
cards.description: Your nerf is removed for good after your next 10 turns.

cards.name: Promotion Storm
cards.description: All pawns on your 5th rank or beyond promote to knights.

cards.name: Purge Realm
cards.description: Remove every enemy minor piece from one half of the board.

cards.name: Purge Storm
cards.description: Remove three enemy pawns and freeze the rest for 1 turn.

cards.name: RGB Keyboard
cards.description: Light up every key. For the game your knights add a 1-square step any direction, your bishops slide 2 straight, and your rooks slide 2 diagonally, but these added moves cannot capture.

cards.name: Rift Storm
cards.description: Teleport up to two of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, then swap the squares of two enemy pieces caught in the churn, once.

cards.name: Royal Ascension
cards.description: Your king gains queen movement permanently, but its added long-range moves cannot capture; it still captures as a normal king (and still loses on capture).

cards.name: Rust
cards.description: Idle enemy pieces seize up: any enemy piece (never a king) that has stood still for 2 of your opponent's turns rusts solid and may only move if the move is a capture, until it finally moves.

cards.name: Sealed Avenues
cards.description: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the d or e files for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Second King
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns, on any rank; after your opponent's next move it becomes a second king. Your opponent must capture both of your kings to win.

cards.name: Serpent Brood
cards.description: Venomous stone serpents coil around the enemy clergy: every one of your opponent's bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the venom lingers so no enemy bishop may capture for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Sinkhole
cards.description: The earth chooses where to open: three sinkholes appear on random empty squares in your opponent's half. Any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one plunges out of the game. They stay open the rest of the match.

cards.name: Statue Garden
cards.description: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, shuffling one square at a time. The first one struck petrifies only after your opponent's next move, and escapes if they move it away.

cards.name: Stone Bastions
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and each stone bastion seals its ground: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto the files their petrified rooks stand on.

cards.name: Sundering
cards.description: Choose three files: each is barred to your opponent until the end of their next turn, then collapses.

cards.name: The Big Chill
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for one of their turns. As the ice lets go, two random survivors turn to walnuts, able to shuffle only one square at a time, for one more of their turns.

cards.name: Thorn Hedge
cards.description: A hedge of black thorns walls off your realm: enemy bishops, rooks, and queens cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Time Lock
cards.description: Lock your opponent's clock and hand: they skip their next turn, and their next draft is skipped, once.

cards.name: Time Skip
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the piece they last moved is frozen for their next 2 turns. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

cards.name: Time Stop (Short)
cards.description: Time stops: freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 turn, then take one extra move right now, once. You cannot capture the king during the bonus move: your opponent replies first. Afterward your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Total Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in piece upgrades resist. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
cards.description: The drum-man marches on your opponent's king. On each of your next 5 turns, the two enemy pieces nearest their king are bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

cards.name: Union Rules
cards.description: Your pieces get mandated rest: for your opponent's next 2 turns after they capture one of your pieces, they cannot make a capture. If capturing is their only legal option, the rule is waived for that turn.

cards.name: Valkyrie

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / pocket / unconditional

cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight, bishop, or rook of yours they capture is carried home to your pocket instead of being lost for good. Drop it back onto an empty square on a later turn. In exchange, you skip your next draft.

cards.name: Void
cards.description: The void takes one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop, and the square it stood on stays a void that swallows any enemy piece except a king that enters it, for the game; the defender gets one bridge, so the first enemy piece to enter crosses it safely.

cards.name: Frozen Moment
cards.description: Seal this moment in glass: choose one enemy piece except a king. After 3 of their turns, wherever it has run to, it is snapped back to the square it stands on right now (if that square is free again).

cards.name: Leaden Crown
cards.description: Turn one of your pawns into a queen, and the leaden crown guards it: that new queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Wall of Thorns
cards.description: A thicket of thorns bursts up around one of your pieces: the up to 8 squares surrounding it are barred to your opponent for 3 of their turns. If your opponent captures that piece, the wall of thorns falls at once.

cards.name: Walnut Curse
cards.description: Their greed turns to wood: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece becomes a walnut for 3 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time. Kings shrug the curse off.

cards.name: Clown Car

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Two knights pile out of one tiny car: place them on two empty squares that touch each other. Both are too dizzy to move on your next turn.

cards.name: Wrecking Ball
cards.description: Your queen winds up a full swing: after your opponent's next move, every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her is smashed off the board. Shielded pieces resist the swing, once.

cards.name: Conflagration

terms.note: 4-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Remove two enemy pieces, each a pawn, knight, or bishop, once.

cards.name: Flash Freeze
cards.description: After your opponent replies, freeze every enemy piece standing next to your king for their next 2 turns and bonk it where it stands.

cards.name: Frost Ward
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece that ends a move next to your king in that time is frozen for 1 turn and bonked where it stands.

cards.name: Glacier Wall
cards.description: Two walls of ice rise: pick any two squares, and every empty square on each of their files becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns. Any enemy piece already standing on a frozen file may leave normally.

cards.name: Quagmire
cards.description: Open two patches of sucking mud on empty squares: any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one is stuck fast for its next 3 turns instead of removed. The mud stays for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Armored Breakthrough
cards.description: One of your bishops spearheads the drive: it sweeps along one diagonal, capturing every enemy piece on it, and stops where the drive ends. Friendly pieces and enemy kings block the drive, once.

cards.name: Bridgehead
cards.description: Place a new knight on an empty square in your half and a new pawn on an empty square on your fourth rank or lower, once.

cards.name: Combined Arms
cards.description: Armor learns from cavalry: for your next 3 turns, your rooks may also leap like knights.

cards.name: Forward Outpost
cards.description: Place a new rook on any empty square in your own half, once.

cards.name: Mercenary Queen
cards.description: Hire a sellsword who fights as a queen for 3 of your turns, then rides off with her pay.

cards.name: Pincer Movement
cards.description: Close both jaws at once: every enemy piece except a king caught directly between two of your pieces (left and right, above and below, or across a diagonal) is pinned and frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Praetorian Guard
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it cannot be captured and may also step one square in any direction like a king.

cards.name: Shieldbearers
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, while at least one of your pawns stands on a square beside your king, your king cannot be captured, for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Absolute Aegis
cards.description: Every one of your pieces cannot be captured for 2 full turns, and this time that includes your king. But each protected piece loses its protection once it makes a capture.

cards.name: Aegis of the Ages
cards.description: Lift the ancient aegis and its ward falls over your whole host, your king included: nothing you own can be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. Lifting it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Age of Heroes
cards.description: The old songs come true for three champions: choose one of your knights, one bishop, and one rook. Until each next moves it may also move like a queen, a single stroke apiece.

cards.name: Amazon
cards.description: Your queen is crowned an Amazon: she still moves like a queen and now banks a single knight leap, regaining one every four of your turns (never more than one banked), which she may spend to jump like a knight.

cards.name: Amazon Army
cards.description: For your next three turns your knights also move as bishops and your bishops also move as knights. Neither becomes a full amazon.

cards.name: Ban Hammer
cards.description: Moderator privileges activated: point at one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and up to two enemy pieces of that type are permanently banned from the board.

cards.name: Ascension of the Small
cards.description: Choose one of your knights or bishops. After your opponent's next move, it ascends: it becomes a queen where it stands.

cards.name: Champion's Rest
cards.description: For the rest of the game, every rook or queen you capture suspends your nerf for your next 4 turns.

cards.name: Debtor's Holiday
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns, and gain 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: Escape Artist
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your king steps out of check, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Eye of Ages
cards.description: See both the cards and the tier of your opponent's next draft offer, gain 3 draft rerolls, and every enemy piece that no other enemy piece defends lights up until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Feast of Fools
cards.description: You keep both cards of your next draft offer, and gain 2 draft rerolls.

cards.name: The Grand Bargain
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 14 turns, and your next draft shows three cards, of which you keep one.

cards.name: Half-Moon Charter
cards.description: For the rest of the game, your nerf is suspended on every other one of your turns, starting with your next. The charter costs you your next two drafts, which are skipped.

cards.name: Harbor Queen
cards.description: For the rest of the game, your queen cannot be captured while she stands in your half of the board. Across the middle line she sails at her own risk.

cards.name: Jubilee
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 8 turns, and your next draft offer rolls one tier higher.

cards.name: Keys to the City
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 8 turns, used at the moment you choose. While suspended, your pieces ignore the boundaries your nerf would impose.

cards.name: Moonlit Reprieve
cards.description: For the rest of the game the moon keeps your schedule: your nerf is suspended for 2 of your turns, returns for 2, and so on.

cards.name: Promotion Charter
cards.description: For your opponent's next 4 turns, any pawn move of yours that reaches your opponent's second rank may promote to a queen on the spot, one rank early. The charter ends early the moment one such move captures.

cards.name: Salt in the Wound
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns. When it returns, take 20 seconds from your opponent's clock.

cards.name: Warden's Retirement
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 4 turns. For your opponent's next 4 turns, every capture you make suspends it for 2 more of your turns; this clause ends after two such captures.

cards.name: Brr Brr Patapim
cards.description: The cold finds whoever wanders alone: every enemy piece except the king with no friendly piece on any square beside it freezes solid for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Buff Siphon
cards.description: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

cards.name: Carnival of Masks
cards.description: Every one of your pieces except your king puts on another's mask: their types are shuffled among their squares at random. You keep exactly the same pieces, but nobody is where their powers say they are. Pawns never land on a first or last rank.

cards.name: Kingmaker's Pact
cards.description: Sign with the power behind every throne: for your opponent's next four turns, every one of your draft offers rolls one tier higher. In exchange you forfeit your draft rerolls now. The pact ends the moment your opponent spends a reroll.

cards.name: Restitution
cards.description: For every kind of piece where your opponent outnumbers you on the board, one of your captured pieces of that kind returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. The most valuable returning piece is rooted and cannot move on your next turn.

cards.name: Covenant of Return
