cards.description: Swear the covenant and death loses its next three arguments: the next 3 of your pieces that are captured each return at once to the empty square nearest your home rank.

cards.name: High Stakes
cards.description: Sweep the table twice: you keep every card offered in each of your next 2 drafts instead of just one, and one of your drafts is skipped besides. In return you forfeit all of your rerolls, now and forever.

cards.name: Home Guard
cards.description: The threshold is warded for good: no enemy piece may ever move onto your first rank. Your back rank stays yours, and no enemy pawn can promote on it.

cards.name: Pretender to the Throne
cards.description: Crown a claimant waiting in the wings: a brand new queen joins your pocket, ready to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn (that drop spends the turn). The court is not cheap - your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: The Homecoming
cards.description: Your best captured major and best captured minor return to the empty squares nearest your home rank. Your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Vantage Point
cards.description: Dig in on the heights and they cannot dislodge you: any of your pieces (your king aside) standing on your opponent's back two ranks cannot be captured. Step back off the heights and it is fair game again.

cards.name: Cappuccino Assassino
cards.description: The espresso assassin strikes before the foam settles: the enemy piece nearest your king (never their king) is destroyed, and the two enemy pieces nearest the scene of the crime are stunned for their next turn.

cards.name: Celestial Ascension
cards.description: Your bishops ascend to a higher plane: for the game every one of them also moves in straight lines like a rook, wielding a queen's full reach.

cards.name: Chain Atomic
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, whenever a capture involves one of your pieces the capturing piece is destroyed, along with up to one enemy piece beside it, kings aside. No chains.

cards.name: Checkmate Denial
cards.description: Once, when your king would be captured, it survives and is moved to the nearest safe square in your own half. No timed immunity.

cards.name: Chisel Curse
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, turn the enemy piece you targeted into a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the enemy pieces then directly to its left and right into walnuts for 2 of their turns each. Kings are never affected.

cards.name: Cockatrice Gaze
cards.description: Every enemy knight and bishop in your half turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns. Minors still in their own half only catch the reflection and are frozen for 1 turn. The first piece the gaze lands on petrifies only after their next move, and escapes if moved.

cards.name: Contagion
cards.description: The strain lies dormant until after your opponent's next move. Once it wakes, whenever one of their pieces is newly frozen, one adjacent enemy piece, never a king, catches it and is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Court in Exile
cards.description: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king, and their queen is the last to return from exile: she cannot move for 2 further turns after the court comes back.

cards.name: Draft Tyranny
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, both cards in your next draft are set to tier 7, once.

cards.name: Dragon's Breath
cards.description: One rook captures every enemy piece in a straight line in a single move, once. Loosing the breath spends the card even if the line is empty and nothing burns.

cards.name: Dragonslayer
cards.description: The old blade remembers its work: name one enemy rook or queen and it is slain where it stands. Using it consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Fingertip Maltese
cards.description: Elite fingertip hold on one enemy piece: it freezes for their next 3 turns and the empty squares around it are sealed, so no fresh piece can move in to rescue it, though pieces already beside it may leave normally.

cards.name: Royal Road
cards.description: Your king steps to any empty square on your back rank.

cards.name: King's Moat
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns none of their pieces may move onto a square next to your king.

cards.name: Sunforge
cards.description: Choose one of your pawns on your 5th rank or beyond. It becomes a knight where it stands.

cards.name: Full Pardon
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns and store one bonus move: after your opponent's next move you take an extra move on your following turn.

cards.name: Genesis
cards.description: Reset the entire board to the opening position, once. Every lingering effect is washed away.

cards.name: Glacial Tomb
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 1 of their turns. As the ice lifts, only their queen and rooks stay behind as walnuts for 1 more turn, able to shuffle only one square at a time.

cards.name: Break the Bank
cards.description: Three laser grids, 60% each to slip through. Three clean: your best captured piece returns AND a random tier 6 card joins your hand. Two: the tier 6 card. One: a pawn, and a random piece of yours is jailed 2 turns. Zero: two pieces jailed 2 turns.

cards.name: Devil's Deck
cards.description: Six cards fanned face up, three drawn at random, all three resolve. The blessings: summon a knight, stun three enemy pieces, revive a captured minor, shield your army for a turn. The two curses: lose a random pawn, or freeze one of your minors for 2 turns.

cards.name: God Knight
cards.description: One knight becomes an amazon (queen plus knight), for the game.

cards.name: Golden Touch
cards.description: The next two enemy pieces you capture (other than kings) are reforged as your own and added to your army on empty squares in your half. The price of greed: each reforging turns one of your pawns to gold, and it is lost.

cards.name: Crown of Thorns
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any enemy piece whose move leaves your king in check is seized by the thorns and frozen for 2 of their turns where it stands. The check still counts; the attacker is simply rooted.

cards.name: The Hollow Crown
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent's king moves, castling included, the court mourns: on their following turn they may move only pawns or the king.

cards.name: Doomed Vow
cards.description: Condemn one enemy piece: in 4 of their turns it is dragged off the board, unless their own king comes to stand on a square next to it first, which breaks the vow at once. Kings themselves cannot be condemned.

cards.name: Crossbow Curfew
cards.description: Ranged warfare is outlawed: after your opponent's next move, for their following 4 turns they may only capture from 1 square away. Long range kills are forbidden.

cards.name: Glass Floor
cards.description: Every dark square becomes thin glass: for your opponent's next 2 turns their pieces may not stop on dark squares. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Gorgon Field
cards.description: A gorgon's gaze sweeps the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that ends a move on the central 4x4 (c3 to f6) becomes a walnut for 1 of their turns. Kings resist the gaze.

cards.name: Grim Procession
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, no piece of theirs may end a move farther from their own king than it started. The army huddles toward the crown. Their king walks free.

cards.name: Muster of Silence
cards.description: For your opponent's next 2 turns, any piece of theirs that is defended by another of their pieces may not move. Only the unguarded stragglers may act. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Veil of Moths
cards.description: A living veil settles over your half of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, they cannot capture anything standing in your half.

cards.name: Watchman's Whistle
cards.description: For your opponent's next 5 turns, any piece of theirs that gives check to your king is arrested on the spot and frozen for 2 of their turns. Kings are never arrested.

cards.name: I Love Cami
cards.description: Place Cami on an empty square in your half: a queen who also leaps like a knight. Devotion: allies standing beside her cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. If she is ever taken, her captor is frozen for 2 turns.

cards.name: I Love My Sister
cards.description: Bring your strongest fallen piece home to an empty square in your half. She arrives shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns, but the shield ends once she has made two captures.

cards.name: Judgment Day

terms.note: 4-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: A pillar of holy light smites one enemy knight, bishop, rook, or queen you name, then petrifies the two enemy pieces nearest the impact into stone for the rest of the game. Kings are never petrified.

cards.name: King's Legion
cards.description: Add a rook and a knight to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Leaden Limbs
cards.description: Your opponent may move each piece at most one square in any direction for their next 2 turns.

cards.name: Magnetism
cards.description: Your knights are magnetized: after each knight move, the nearest enemy piece (never a king) is dragged up to two squares toward that knight, as long as the squares between them are empty.

cards.name: Mass Freeze
cards.description: After your opponent replies, freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 full turn.

cards.name: Meteor
cards.description: Pick an impact square, then a rank or a file through it, not both. Remove up to three enemy pieces on that line, kings aside, nearest the impact square.

cards.name: Molten Heart
cards.description: Their blades run molten: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece is destroyed along with its victim. Their single most valuable piece is exempt and captures freely, and kings burn nothing and are never destroyed.

cards.name: Nerf Reversal
cards.description: Turn your nerf against itself: suspend it for your next 10 turns, and your pieces in your own half cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Noble Rout
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the nobles break and run: for their following 3 turns their knights, bishops, rooks and queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Only their pawns and king may still advance.

cards.name: All the King's Men
cards.description: Up to four of your captured pieces return at once, strongest first, on random empty squares in your half.

cards.name: The Big Nap
cards.description: Night falls: every knight, bishop, rook and queen on the board (both sides) sleeps and cannot move for 1 turn of its owner. Kings and pawns keep watch.

cards.name: Coup d'Etat
cards.description: The queen takes the throne: she cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns, and for 6 of your turns your king moves like a queen.

cards.name: Patient Grift
cards.description: Fold twice to win the pot: your next 2 drafts are skipped, and the draft after them is dealt from tier 8.

cards.name: Phoenix Line
cards.description: Revive all your captured pawns to your 2nd rank, once.

cards.name: Queen Storm
cards.description: Promote up to two of your pawns on your 4th rank or beyond: the first becomes a queen, the second a rook. No two promotions are alike, so there is no mass of queens.

cards.name: Queen's Rampage
cards.description: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line you choose and removes every enemy piece on it; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

cards.name: Resurrect Queen
cards.description: Bring your captured queen back to any empty square on the board, and she cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Roost of Rocs
cards.description: Three titanic rocs descend and perch along the board's edge: place three knights on empty squares of the outer rim, then skip your next draft.

cards.name: Roulette
cards.description: Spin the wheel three times: three random enemy pieces other than the king are removed from the board.

cards.name: Ruin
cards.description: Clear all enemy pawns, and destroy one enemy minor piece (or a rook if they have no minor).

cards.name: Sabbatical
cards.description: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 10 turns, used at the moment you choose, but your next draft is skipped.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Your queen sweeps one diagonal, reaping every enemy piece she passes and landing on an empty square beyond them, never on a capture; for each piece reaped, a friendly pawn rises on an empty square in your half, plus one bonus pawn, once.

cards.name: Stone Prelates
cards.description: The pews claim whoever lingers: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any of their bishops standing in their own half may only shuffle one square at a time. Bishops that cross into your half move freely.

cards.name: Summon Dragon
cards.description: Choose an empty square in your half now, and after your opponent's next move a new queen lands there, so she cannot capture until they reply. Whenever she captures she breathes fire: every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her kill dies too.

cards.name: Termites
cards.description: Termites gnaw at your opponent's towers: every 2 of their turns, their rooks lose one more square of reach. The decay stops at a reach of 1, so a rook can always shuffle a single square.

cards.name: Threads of Fate
cards.description: The loom repays every cut thread: for your opponent's next 3 captures, you weave an extra move into your reply.

cards.name: Throne and Silence
cards.description: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their single most valuable piece, and their next draft is skipped entirely.

cards.name: Total Atomic
cards.description: Your next three captures each detonate one square in every direction, destroying up to two adjacent enemy pieces. Shielded pieces resist, and the blast never chains.

cards.name: Total Warp
cards.description: Teleport your whole army except the king anywhere you like, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

cards.name: Total Whiteout
cards.description: A blizzard buries every sightline: for their next 3 turns, your opponent's pieces can only capture at arm's length, exactly one square away.

cards.name: Triple Amazon
cards.description: Up to three of your knights move as amazons for your next 2 turns.

cards.name: Twin Queens
cards.description: Promote two pawns to queens instantly if both are on your 5th rank or beyond. Using it spends your next unused reroll, if any.

cards.name: Unshackled Wrath
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 14 turns, then it returns at full strength. Your opponent skips their next turn.

cards.name: Grand Dominion

terms.note: 2-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Take control of one enemy rook or queen: it becomes yours, once.

cards.name: Whiteout
cards.description: A blizzard freezes every enemy piece except the king and pawns for their next turn. The pawns can still trudge.

cards.name: The Wild Hunt
cards.description: The horns of the twilight court sound: pick any square, and the Hunt rides both diagonals through it, carrying off every enemy piece on them. Kings are never taken.

cards.name: Withered Hands
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, they cannot capture with any piece for their following 3 turns.

cards.name: Iron Bulwark
cards.description: Choose one of your pieces, your king aside: while it stands in your half it cannot be captured, and enemy pieces standing next to it cannot capture at all.

cards.name: Absolute Nullify
cards.description: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs and block their next draft, but they gain a reroll in return. Locked-in upgrades resist.

cards.name: Absolute Zero
cards.description: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king and pawns for 2 of their turns. The cold outlives the ice: for their next 2 turns after the thaw, each of those pieces can only step a single square. Kings and pawns move freely throughout.

cards.name: Annihilation
cards.description: Remove any two enemy pieces below the queen from the board.

cards.name: Atomic Captures
cards.description: Whenever one of your pieces captures, every enemy piece on the 8 squares around the captured square is also removed, except kings and pawns. Lasts the whole game.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.description: For your next 3 turns, all your pieces except your king also move like a queen. For the 2 turns after that, all your pieces can move only one square.

cards.name: Blighted Furrows
cards.description: Every enemy pawn standing in your half rots away and is removed, and their remaining pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, though the first pawn to try may make one advance before the lock takes hold.

cards.name: Age of Peace
cards.description: For your opponent's next 3 turns, each of your pieces cannot be captured and your king cannot be taken. A protected piece loses its protection once it makes a capture.

cards.name: Flag on Their Wall
cards.description: While any piece of yours stands on your opponent's back rank, your nerf is suspended.

cards.name: Hall of Doors
cards.description: For your next 5 turns, your king may step through any door: he may move to any empty square in your half of the board. Once, one other piece of yours (your king excepted) may also step to any empty square in your half.

cards.name: Haven Law
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, nothing of yours standing in your own half of the board can be captured for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Hundred-Year Lease
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the lease begins: your nerf is suspended for the 30 turns that follow.

cards.name: Liberator's March
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 18 turns. Each capture you make while it is suspended gains you 1 draft reroll, up to 3.

cards.name: The Long Winter
cards.description: Every enemy piece (their king excepted) is frozen for your opponent's next 2 turns, and your king cannot be captured on their next turn, unless your king makes a capture, which ends that safety.

cards.name: The Meek Inherit
cards.description: Beginning after your opponent's next move, your nerf is suspended while your opponent has at least as many pieces as you (kings aside). Pull ahead in material, and it wakes.

cards.name: Pact of the Dawn
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 12 turns, and every one of your captured pawns returns at once to squares nearest your home rank. The most advanced returning pawn cannot move until your opponent replies.

cards.name: Queen's Aegis
cards.description: While your queen stands on the board, your nerf is suspended. Lose her, and it returns.

cards.name: Royal Privilege
cards.description: For the rest of the game, every time you move your queen, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns. Your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Siege Mentality
cards.description: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent puts your king in check, your nerf is suspended for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: The Unequal Treaty
cards.description: Your nerf is suspended for your next 10 turns; your opponent's is suspended for their next 3. Diplomacy, as practiced.

cards.name: Written in Stone
cards.description: After your next 10 turns, the inscription takes effect: your nerf is suspended for the 20 turns that follow.

cards.name: Year of Jubilee
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 25 turns. When it returns, gain 1 draft reroll.

cards.name: Boneca Ambalabu
cards.description: The tire-frog drags your opponent down: for their next 4 turns none of their pieces may move more than 1 square in a single move.

cards.name: The Great Return
cards.description: Every captured piece of BOTH sides still owed to the board returns at once, each placed on the empty square nearest its own home rank. Your most valuable returning piece arrives rooted and cannot move on your next turn.

cards.name: The Long Truce
cards.description: Heralds cross the field and every blade is lowered: for 2 full turns, no piece on EITHER side can be captured, kings included. While the truce holds you breathe freely: your own nerf is suspended for your next 3 turns.

cards.name: Shadow Reserve
cards.description: A knight, a bishop and a rook join your pocket to drop onto empty squares on later turns. Your next 2 drafts are skipped.

cards.name: Drive Them Out
cards.description: Clear the homeland and let the invaders regret the crossing: every enemy piece standing in your half of the board is removed, and every one of your own pieces standing in your opponent's half is removed with them. Both kings are spared.

cards.name: The Reckoning
cards.description: Call in every debt the minor pieces owe: every knight and every bishop on the board, yours and your opponent's alike, is removed at once. Kings, queens, rooks and pawns are untouched.

cards.name: Cataclysmic Meteor
cards.description: Pick a 3x3 area. Remove up to three enemy pieces in it, kings aside. If more than three are present the least valuable are destroyed, so the defender keeps their strongest.

cards.name: Celestial Alignment
cards.description: The stars chart the light squares and hold everything found there: every enemy piece except the king standing on a light square is frozen for 2 of their turns.

cards.name: Danya's Speedrun
cards.description: For your opponent's next 6 turns they may only play a capture, a check, or a pawn move. Each held turn pays you more time: 2 seconds, then 3, then 4, and so on.

cards.name: Divine Fortress
cards.description: Every piece on your half of the board, your king aside, is uncapturable for 3 turns, but while the fortress stands those pieces cannot give check.

cards.name: Divine Right
cards.description: For your next 5 turns your king may move and capture as a queen, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

cards.name: Endless Night
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn. On the turn they return, up to four non-king enemy pieces you choose are frozen for that one turn.

cards.name: Eternal Reign
cards.description: Your king gains permanent queen movement and cannot be captured for 3 turns.

cards.name: Extinction
cards.description: Remove every enemy minor and pawn from the board except one: the defender's strongest such piece is spared.

cards.name: Worldheart
cards.description: Take two extra moves right now. Your army cannot be captured until your next turn begins.

cards.name: Eclipse Crown
cards.description: Your opponent's next turn is skipped, and none of your pieces can be captured until your following turn begins.

cards.name: Winter Court
cards.description: Every enemy piece other than the king standing in your half of the board is frozen for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: The Last Bet
cards.description: Push your queen across the felt. 70%: she returns empowered, adding knight leaps to her slides for 6 of your turns, though those leaps cannot capture. 30%: the back room keeps her for 2 of your turns, then returns her to her square or the nearest empty one.

cards.name: Godslayer Knight
cards.description: One knight moves as an amazon, is uncapturable, and explodes on capture, for 3 turns. While shielded it cannot give check.

cards.name: Grand Reset
cards.description: Add replacements to your pocket until your army would be back to full starting strength, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns. You skip your next draft in exchange.

cards.name: Heaven's Wrath

terms.note: 4-way choice, priced at the cheapest / permanent / board-state gate

cards.description: The sky splits and three bolts of wrath descend: smite three enemy knights, bishops, rooks, or queens you name from the board. Calling the storm consumes your next unused reroll, if you have one.

cards.name: Death Knell

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / temporary 3 turns / unconditional

cards.description: Toll the knell over one enemy piece: in 3 of their turns it crumbles to dust and is removed. The bell accepts one bribe: if the doomed piece captures anything before the last toll, the curse breaks and it lives. Kings cannot be tolled.

cards.name: Blood Tithe
cards.description: It holds off until after their next move, then for their next 6 turns: whenever they capture anything larger than a pawn, one of their own pawns is claimed as tribute and removed from the board. Once they have no pawns left, the tithe goes unpaid.

cards.name: Martyr's Crown
cards.description: A patient briar guards your king for your opponent's next 6 turns. The first check passes; on the second, every enemy piece standing next to your king is frozen for 2 of their turns and the count resets. Their two best pieces there are spared.

cards.name: Maze of Thorns
cards.description: Thorn hedges spring up across every lane: for your opponent's next 4 turns, no piece of theirs may move more than 1 square, except knights, who leap the hedges. Their king is exempt.

cards.name: Puppet Court
cards.description: Every officer's strings are cut: for your opponent's next 3 turns they may move only pawns and their king. The first officer the strings would bind may make one move, then it binds fully.

cards.name: Tempest
cards.description: 6 random empty squares become wreckage your opponent cannot stop on for their next 3 turns, save one bridge, the wreckage nearest their king. 2 of their pieces, chosen at random, are also stunned for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Tithe of Silence
cards.description: Your opponent's next move passes freely. Then, for their following 6 turns, shouting at a king is taxed: each of their first 2 checks against your king costs them their following turn, skipped outright.

cards.name: I Love My GF
cards.description: Your pieces standing in your own half cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn, and you take one bonus move right now. Your king shares the shield only if it is currently in check.

cards.name: I Hate My Ex
cards.description: Bring the whole thing down. Every piece on the board is destroyed instantly, yours and theirs alike. Only the two kings are left standing in the wreckage.

cards.name: Immortal King
cards.description: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 8 turns, but this protection ends the instant your king captures a piece. You can still lose by running out of moves.

cards.name: Mass Mind Control
cards.description: Mark two enemy pieces of any type below queen. After your opponent's next move, any of them still in place defect to your side for the game.

cards.name: Obsidian Bastions
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for the rest of the game, able only to shuffle one square at a time. A rook breaks free the instant it makes a capture.

cards.name: Orb of Dominion
cards.description: Choose one enemy rook or queen; after your opponent's next move you take control of it for the rest of the game, once. While you still hold the dominated piece, the enemy queen cannot capture. Kings cannot be taken.

cards.name: Crown of the Undying
cards.description: Once, the moment an enemy move leaves your king under attack, the crown answers: every enemy piece standing beside your king is destroyed. Enemy kings survive it.

cards.name: Split the Timeline
cards.description: The timeline splits and both of you act at once: you and your opponent each gain one extra move, you first.

cards.name: The Menu
cards.description: Your next draft is dealt three cards, and you keep every one of them.

cards.name: Phoenix Rebirth
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, revive every captured piece you have to your half, once.

cards.name: Sacked Capital
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn and their next draft. On the turn they return, they may move only pawns or their king.

cards.name: Sealed Ramparts
cards.description: Your opponent's rooks are frozen for their next 2 turns, then for the rest of the game each rook may move at most three squares in a single move. They are never fully disabled.

cards.name: Summoning Circle
cards.description: An Amazon steps through onto an empty square in your half and serves for four of your turns, moving as queen and knight both, then fades back through the circle. Whoever fells her is frozen in place for one of their turns.

cards.name: Time Freeze
cards.description: Your opponent skips their next turn, then on their following turn every enemy piece except the king is frozen.

cards.name: Time Prison
cards.description: Skip your opponent's next turn. For their following two turns they may move only pawns, knights, or the king; any capture, by either player, ends the restriction early.

cards.name: Titan
cards.description: One piece gains amazon movement for your next 3 turns and cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Total Annihilation
cards.description: Choose any square: the enemy piece there, unless it is a king, is removed, along with up to two adjacent enemy pieces. Shielded pieces and pawns survive the collateral blast.

cards.name: Transcendence
cards.description: Suspend your nerf for your next 20 turns, then it returns. Your next draft shows three cards.

cards.name: Walnut Court
cards.description: The whole court hardens where it sits: every enemy piece except the king still on its own back rank turns into a walnut for 3 of their turns. A walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.

cards.name: World End
cards.description: The outer rim of the board is barred to your opponent for their next two turns. Then it collapses inward: the next ring is barred for one more of their turns.

cards.name: World Lock
cards.description: Seal the border: your opponent cannot move any piece into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.description: Your opponent's next turn is skipped. For their following two turns they may make only a single non-pawn move in total; otherwise they must move a pawn.

cards.name: The Culling
cards.description: Two random enemy pieces other than the king are marked: one is destroyed after your opponent's next turn, the other freezes for your opponent's next 2 turns.

cards.name: Eternal Freeze
cards.description: Turn every enemy knight, bishop, rook, and queen to stone for 3 of their turns: each can only shuffle one square at a time. Enemy pawns are left free.

cards.name: Full Resurrection
cards.description: Revive your queen, both rooks, and one minor piece to your half.

cards.name: Grand Conjunction
cards.description: All enemy pieces except the king and their most valuable piece are frozen for 2 of their turns. None of your pieces can be captured for 2 turns.

cards.name: The Curse Engine
cards.description: A grinding machine of malice runs over their army for the next 9 of their turns. Every turn it winds one notch tighter, and on every third notch it freezes whichever of their pieces is strongest for 2 of their turns, then resets. Their king is never seized.

cards.name: Mirror of Winter
cards.description: A sympathetic frost binds their army: for your opponent's next 2 turns, whenever they move a piece, every OTHER piece they own of that same type is frozen for 1 of their turns.

cards.name: Ice Age
cards.description: Choose up to three enemy pieces other than the king; each freezes solid and cannot move for your opponent's next 3 turns.

cards.name: I Love Whimpering Audios
cards.description: After your opponent's next move, the charm sets in: on each of their following 3 moves, the enemy queen, rook, bishop, or knight nearest your king is charmed and joins your army. Kings never fall for it.

cards.name: Iron Legion
cards.description: A rook and a knight join your pocket to drop onto empty squares on later turns; a queen joins them only if your queen has already been captured.

cards.name: Living God
cards.description: One piece gains amazon movement and explosive captures for your next 4 turns. Its captures blow up the surrounding ring but do not chain.

cards.name: Mass Petrify
cards.description: Choose up to five enemy pieces other than the king to turn to stone for your opponent's next 2 turns; the two most valuable among them resist and are spared. A petrified piece may only shuffle one square.

cards.name: Anti-Gravity Gala
cards.description: For 3 of your turns everything floats: your sliding pieces may pass over the first piece in their path, friend or foe, and continue beyond it. Kings are too dignified to be floated over.

cards.name: Continental Drift
cards.description: A chasm tears the board between the fourth and fifth ranks for your opponent's next 5 turns: their pieces cannot cross it, except knights or through the two bridge squares you choose.

cards.name: Let Me Play For You
cards.description: Three times, at most once per your turn and as a free action, move one of your opponent's pieces yourself: any empty square its normal movement reaches. No captures, kings excluded.

cards.name: Leviathan Below
cards.description: Mark three squares; both players see the water darken. The moment your opponent's next move ends, tentacles erupt from all three at once: any piece standing there except a king is dragged below, and the wreckage blocks those squares for 2 turns.

cards.name: Ragnarok Postponed
cards.description: The doomsday bell begins to toll: in 10 of your turns, every piece on the board except kings and pawns is removed. Both armies. No exceptions, no cancellations.

cards.name: Peace of the Grave
cards.description: Your opponent cannot capture with any piece for their next 3 turns, and for those turns they cannot move any piece onto a square next to your king.

cards.name: Philosopher's Stone
cards.description: Press the fabled stone to your ranks and transmute base metal to gold: three of your pawns become queens, once.

cards.name: Queen's Apocalypse
cards.description: Choose one of your queens and remove up to four enemy pieces it can see along its lines. That queen is then frozen for your next turn. Requires a queen.

cards.name: Reality Warp
cards.description: Rewrite the rules of matter: any two of your pieces, king aside, become queens.

cards.name: Resurrection
cards.description: Every piece your opponent has captured returns to the board, filling empty squares in your half from your back rank outward, spilling into the rest of the board if your half runs out of room.

cards.name: Second Coming
cards.description: Summon a queen on an empty square in your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Titan Legion
cards.description: Choose three of your pieces; each moves as an amazon (a queen that also leaps like a knight) for your next 2 turns, and the first chosen piece cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Ascendancy
cards.description: Choose up to four of your pieces other than the king; each moves and captures as an amazon (a queen that also leaps like a knight) for your next 2 turns, and your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Grand Army
cards.description: A fresh queen, rook, bishop, and knight join your pocket to drop onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Oblivion
cards.description: Destroy up to five enemy pieces other than the king, and restore up to five of your captured pieces onto empty squares in your half from your back rank outward. Neither side gains immunity.

cards.name: Total War
cards.description: Destroy up to five enemy pieces other than the king, then a fresh queen, rook, bishop, and knight join your pocket to drop onto empty squares on later turns.

cards.name: Escort Mission
cards.description: If your king can capture, it must. This activates only after your move 3.

cards.name: Pixie Curse
cards.description: Your knights cannot move onto an edge square of the board, unless that is your only legal move.

cards.name: Lucky
cards.description: You have no nerf. A rare gift from the gods of chess.

cards.name: Gentle Shepherds
cards.description: Your bishops can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Minor Nobility
cards.description: Your pawns can only promote to knights or bishops, never to queens or rooks.

cards.name: Opening Ceremony
cards.description: Your fourth move of the game must be a pawn move.

cards.name: Silent Infantry
cards.description: From your fourth move on, your pawns can't give check: any pawn move that would leave the enemy king in check is forbidden. A pawn may still capture the king itself.

cards.name: Pen Pusher
cards.description: Your rooks can't capture, unless your king is in check.

cards.name: Teetotaler
cards.description: You can't capture rooks, unless the rook is giving check.

cards.name: Battle Fatigue
cards.description: After a piece captures, it can't capture again until it makes a non-capturing move. Capturing a piece that is checking your king is always allowed.

cards.name: Columnar Rooks
cards.description: The squares your rooks may not slide sideways into are shown from the start. From your second turn on, your rooks glide any distance up and down a file, but can only shuffle one square at a time sideways along a rank.

cards.name: Flat Footed
cards.description: Your pawns can't advance two squares.

cards.name: Gnome's Bargain
cards.description: From your fourth move on, you cannot capture with the same type of piece that made your previous capture.

cards.name: Homebody King
cards.description: Your king can't leave your first two ranks.

cards.name: Keep Off the Grass
cards.description: Starting on your fourth move, your king can't move onto the four center squares.

cards.name: Knights Abroad
cards.description: Once one of your knights crosses into the enemy half, it can't come back to your own half, except once per game, when no other legal move is available, one knight may return home.

cards.name: Knights Off the Rail
cards.description: Your knights can't move to the a-file or h-file, unless you have no other legal move, in which case one king move is allowed.

cards.name: Level Headed
cards.description: Your queen can't move diagonally more than 3 squares, unless you are answering a check.

cards.name: Merciful Queen
cards.description: Your queen won't cut down the common soldiers: she can't capture pawns, except capturing a pawn that has your king in check is always legal.

cards.name: No Drawbridge
cards.description: You can't castle.

cards.name: Squeamish
cards.description: Your pawns can't make the game's first capture.

cards.name: Clean Hands
cards.description: Your king can't capture anything, unless the captured piece is checking your king. Capturing the checker is always legal.

cards.name: Late Riser
cards.description: Your queen can't move during your first four moves. From your fifth move on she is free.

cards.name: Rusty Hinges
cards.description: You can only castle during your first ten moves. From your 11th move on, the castle gate is rusted shut, unless you have no other legal move: then a single emergency castle is allowed, once per game.

cards.name: Prima Donna
cards.description: Can't have more than one pawn on the same file, except one open file may hold doubled pawns: the file of your most advanced pawn (ties break to the lower file).

cards.name: Queen Bee
cards.description: Once you capture with your queen, you can no longer move queens. This activates only after your move 3.

cards.name: Quit Horsing Around
cards.description: If you moved a knight last move, you can't move a knight this move.

cards.name: Rook Buddies
cards.description: Your rooks can't move while any piece sits between them on your home rank; clear the back rank between them first.

cards.name: Sacred File
cards.description: A random file is sacred, shown from the start. From your second turn on, you can't capture on it, unless the ban would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

cards.name: Separation Anxiety
cards.description: Pawns adjacent to your king can't move away from him.

cards.name: Soft Paws
cards.description: Your knights can't capture pawns, except one pawn, once per game.

cards.name: Edge-Shy Queen
cards.description: Your queen can't move onto the a-file or the h-file.

cards.name: Knight Toll
cards.description: You can't capture with a knight if a knight of yours captured on your previous turn.

cards.name: No Takebacks
cards.description: You can't move a piece to the exact square your last move started from.

cards.name: Wallflower
cards.description: Your rooks can't move onto the four center squares (d4, d5, e4, e5).

cards.name: Anchored Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks may leave your back rank, but once a rook has left it, that rook can never return to it.

cards.name: Artillery
cards.description: Rooks must capture at distance ≥ 4.

cards.name: Cautious Cavalry
cards.description: The enemy half of the board is shown from the start. From your second turn on, your knights can't cross into it.

cards.name: Cramped Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks can't move more than 4 squares, except one longer rook move is allowed once per game.

cards.name: Evil Twin
cards.description: If you can capture a piece with a same-type piece, you must. This activates only after your move 3.

cards.name: Famine
cards.description: After move 15, you can't capture pawns.

cards.name: Selkie Skin
cards.description: Your rooks cannot move more than 3 squares along a file. Moves along a rank are free.

cards.name: Kingfisher
cards.description: Starting after your third move, when your king can capture it must dive for the richest prize: it has to take the most valuable enemy piece within its reach.

cards.name: No Stone Cutting
cards.description: You can't capture bishops.

cards.name: Orthodox King
cards.description: Your king can only move horizontally or vertically, never diagonally, except if no other legal move is available, your king may move diagonally.

cards.name: Prince Charming
cards.description: If your queen is attacked, must move a knight if possible.

cards.name: Promotion Phobia
cards.description: Your pawns can't promote, so they can't advance onto the back rank. A pawn already on the back rank may still move away normally.

cards.name: Protected Pawns
cards.description: Can only move pawns to defended squares.

cards.name: Pull of the Center
cards.description: Your pawns can only capture toward the center files.

cards.name: Right Handed
cards.description: You can't move to the a-file, except once per game.

cards.name: Royal Bloodlust
cards.description: The turn after your king captures, you must make a capture with any piece if you can.

cards.name: Rusty Knights
cards.description: Knights can only move once every other turn.

cards.name: Separation of Church and State
cards.description: Can't move bishops next to a king and can't move king next to a bishop.

cards.name: Skittish
cards.description: While in check, you must move your king.

cards.name: Snipers
cards.description: Bishops can only capture from distance ≥ 4.

cards.name: Switchback
cards.description: You can't move in the exact same direction (same file and rank step) twice in a row.

cards.name: Vegan
cards.description: You can't capture knights, unless the knight is the piece checking your king.

cards.name: No Going Home
cards.description: Your non-pawn pieces can't move back onto your own back rank.

cards.name: Active Volcano
cards.description: Can't move onto or orthogonally adjacent to a fixed random square, shown on the board. The restriction never leaves you fewer than three legal moves.

cards.name: Advancing Faith
cards.description: Your bishops must gain ground on every move: each bishop move has to advance toward the enemy, never staying level and never falling back, except a bishop move that gets your king out of check is always allowed.

cards.name: Bishop Tunnel Vision
cards.description: Your bishops can't move more than three squares in a single move, unless the move gives check.

cards.name: Clergy
cards.description: Your bishops can't move backward toward your own side; each bishop move must stay level or advance toward the enemy.

cards.name: Cloistered Queen
cards.description: Your queen cannot move until you castle or reach your 12th move, whichever comes first.

cards.name: Conscientious Objectors
cards.description: Your pawns can't capture, unless the target is the piece checking your king.

cards.name: Court Martial
cards.description: A piece that's attacked at turn start can't capture.

cards.name: Crossing the Rubicon
cards.description: Once a piece crosses to the opponent's half, it can't return.

cards.name: Far Sighted
cards.description: You can't capture a piece standing right next to the capturing piece; captures must reach at least 2 squares away. The one exception: you may always capture the piece checking your king.

cards.name: Troll's Toll
cards.description: After you capture a pawn, your next move must be a pawn move, if you have one.

cards.name: Goldfish
cards.description: You can't move a piece you moved 3 turns ago.

cards.name: Greedy
cards.description: You can't capture a lesser piece when a higher-value capture is on the table. You may still play a quiet move.

cards.name: Haunted
cards.description: Can't move to a square where you've previously captured.

cards.name: Hipster
cards.description: You can't move the same piece type as your opponent's last move.

cards.name: Monastic Vows
cards.description: Your bishops can't capture, except capturing a piece that has your king in check is always legal.

cards.name: No Retreat Rooks
cards.description: From your 10th move on, your rooks can't move toward your own back rank, except for a single once-per-game move.

cards.name: No Shuffling
cards.description: Your rooks can't move sideways.

cards.name: Overzealous
cards.description: You lose if you capture more than 10 enemy pieces. The count is only checked after your sixth move.

cards.name: Quarantine
cards.description: You can't move a piece into your own first two ranks from outside them (pieces already on those ranks may still move within them). Separately, while your king is in check, only your king may move.

cards.name: Queen Disguise
cards.description: Your queen is secretly either a rook or a bishop. Once you move it like one, you can't move it like the other.

cards.name: Queen Fatigue
cards.description: You lose if you move your queen more than 12 times. The count is only checked after your sixth move.

cards.name: Queen Grounded
cards.description: From your 12th move on, your queen can't move into the opponent's half of the board, except for a single once-per-game move.

cards.name: Royal Berth
cards.description: Can't place a piece adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Royal Guard
cards.description: Your non-king pieces that are adjacent to your king at the start of your turn can't move. The king itself may still move.

cards.name: Royal Jubilee
cards.description: Whenever you capture a non-pawn, you must move your king or queen on the next move.

cards.name: Secret Garden
cards.description: Two random garden zones (each a 3-file-wide, 3-rank-deep block in front of one of your pawns, shown as marked squares) are off limits for the whole game: you can't move any piece onto those squares.

cards.name: Shadow Queen
cards.description: Your queen can only move to dark squares.

cards.name: Shellshocked
cards.description: When opponent captures, pieces adjacent to the captured square can't move next turn.

cards.name: Short Leash Knights
cards.description: Your knights may never move beyond your own first three ranks.

cards.name: Sibling Rivalry
cards.description: Can't move a piece adjacent to an opponent's piece of same type.

cards.name: Sidewinder
cards.description: Your rooks can only move horizontally along ranks, never up or down files, except one vertical move is allowed once per game.

cards.name: Stir Crazy
cards.description: If you haven't moved your king for 4 turns, you must on the 5th.

cards.name: Tripwire
cards.description: A random rank is a tripwire, shown from the start. From your second turn on, you can't cross it backwards, unless the ban would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

cards.name: True Gentleman
cards.description: You can't capture queens.

cards.name: Vertigo
cards.description: Can't move a piece more than 2 ranks in one move.

cards.name: Winds of Fate
cards.description: Each turn you randomly can't move left or can't move right, revealed a turn early. The restriction is dropped whenever it would leave you fewer than three legal moves.

cards.name: Flinch
cards.description: While your king is in check, you can't capture; you have to get out another way.

cards.name: Lonely King
cards.description: Your king can't move to a square adjacent to one of your own pieces.

cards.name: Shifting Sands
cards.description: Each turn, a random file is closed; you can't move any piece onto it this turn, unless the closure would leave you fewer than three legal moves. Next turn's closed file is revealed a turn early.

cards.name: Short Queen
cards.description: Your queen can't move more than 4 squares in a single move.

cards.name: Slow Start
cards.description: For your first 6 moves, you can only move pawns and knights.

cards.name: Stampede
cards.description: If you moved a knight on your last turn, you must move a knight again this turn (if you can).

cards.name: Armory
cards.description: Your rooks must stay defended at all times.

cards.name: Boxing with Shadow
cards.description: From your move 4 on, when opponent moves, if you can move to the square they vacated, you must.

cards.name: Broadside Rooks
cards.description: Your rooks glide any distance sideways along a rank, but can only inch one square at a time up or down a file.

cards.name: Caged Queen
cards.description: Until you have made 12 moves your queen may not leave your back rank; after that she may leave it but can never cross the midline into the enemy half.

cards.name: Carnivore Bishops
cards.description: Starting on your fourth move, your bishops can only move when they capture.

cards.name: Castle Curfew
cards.description: You lose if you have not castled by your 20th move. On your 20th move you get a visible warning if you still have not castled.

cards.name: Chivalry
cards.description: Can only capture heavies (rooks, queens) with a knight. This activates only after your move 3.

cards.name: Control Center
cards.description: Non-capturing moves must go to files c, d, e, or f, unless the piece already starts on those files, in which case it may leave normally.

cards.name: Court Jester
cards.description: Your queen can only move like a knight.

cards.name: Crippled Clergy
cards.description: Each bishop of yours shuffles: every bishop move covers a single diagonal step.

cards.name: Entrenched
cards.description: Rooks can't move more than 2 squares.

cards.name: Femme Fatale
cards.description: You can only capture the enemy king with your queen.

cards.name: Banshee Bond
cards.description: Your queen may only move to a square next to one of your other pieces. If she has no such move, she stays put.

cards.name: Get Down Mr. President
cards.description: Can't move your king while in check.

cards.name: Half a Queen
cards.description: Your queen can only move like a rook, never diagonally, except one diagonal move is allowed once per game.

cards.name: Heavy Boots
cards.description: All non-pawn moves are distance ≤ 3.

cards.name: Hobbled Knights
cards.description: Your knights can't advance toward the enemy side; their rank may never increase.

cards.name: Homebound Pawns
cards.description: From your fourth move on, your pawns can't advance past the halfway line unless the move is a capture; only by force can they cross into enemy soil.

cards.name: Ladies First
cards.description: Can only move king if you moved queen on previous turn.

cards.name: Leading the Charge
cards.description: As long as you have a knight, non-knights can't be ahead of your most advanced knight.

cards.name: March or Die
cards.description: You lose if four of your turns pass in a row without you moving a pawn.

cards.name: Moving Day
cards.description: After turn 20, no piece may be on your home row.

cards.name: Myopic Bishops
cards.description: From your fourth move on, your bishops can't move more than two squares.

cards.name: Out of Breath
cards.description: You can only move your king once the entire game.

cards.name: Pack Mentality
cards.description: Pieces must move to squares adjacent to another of your pieces.

cards.name: Predatory Knights
cards.description: Your knights can only move by capturing, except that every third turn a knight with no capture may make one quiet move.

cards.name: Retreating Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops can only retreat toward your own back rank, but once per game a bishop may make one non-retreating move.

cards.name: Retrograde Knights
cards.description: Your knights can only move homeward, toward your own side, and can never advance, except that each knight's first move off its home square is exempt from the homeward rule.

cards.name: Rook on the Seventh
cards.description: By move 15, you must get a rook to your 7th rank. Once a rook has reached it, that rook may leave normally without breaking the pledge.

cards.name: Scholarship
cards.description: You can only move a piece type after the opponent has moved it once.

cards.name: Scouting Ahead
cards.description: As long as you have a pawn, non-pawns can't go ahead of your most advanced pawn.

cards.name: Shapeshifter
cards.description: For your first 3 moves the queen moves normally. From then on she is a bishop; capturing a non-pawn turns her into a copy of that piece, and capturing a knight freezes her.

cards.name: Stunted Rooks
cards.description: From your fourth move on, your rooks can only move one square at a time.

cards.name: Three Check
cards.description: If you have been checked three times total, you lose.

cards.name: Timid Bishops
cards.description: Your bishops may only move toward your own side; their rank can never advance toward the enemy.

cards.name: Trophy Wife
cards.description: Your queen can't capture, unless the target is the piece checking your king.

cards.name: Warlord
cards.description: From turn 12 onward, your king can't be on your first two ranks. From turn 11, while your king is still on those ranks, you are warned one move early.

cards.name: Whites of Their Eyes
cards.description: You can only capture within 2 squares (king-steps) of the capturing piece.

cards.name: Curfew
cards.description: After your 25th move, you can't move any piece into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.description: Each turn, five random squares are struck and sealed; you can't move any piece onto them this turn, unless the strike would leave you fewer than three legal moves. Next turn's five squares are revealed a turn early.

cards.name: Bishop Fan Club
cards.description: Must promote to bishops. King and queen can only move diagonally.

cards.name: Blood Quota
cards.description: You may make only six captures all game. One compliance token excuses a single extra capture; you lose only when you make an eighth capture.

cards.name: Bloodthirsty
cards.description: After turn 3, if you go 2 turns without capturing, you must capture if able. No move granted by another card can dodge the required capture.

cards.name: Bridge Over Troubled Water
cards.description: A river runs through the middle. From your move 4 on, cross only via the center files.

cards.name: Centralized Command
cards.description: Can only capture if you moved your king in the last 3 turns. If that would leave you no legal move, a king move is allowed.

cards.name: Cheerleaders
cards.description: Non-pawns can only capture if adjacent to one of your pawns.

cards.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
cards.description: Each turn the devil suggests a bad move. Ignore him 7 turns in a row and on the 8th you must obey. A piece a card spawns or teleports in can be the demanded move at once.

cards.name: Doctor Octopus
cards.description: Can only capture non-king pieces 8 times total.

cards.name: Exclusivity Clause
cards.description: Can't move to squares more than one of your pieces can move to. Pieces a card spawns or teleports in are counted at once.

cards.name: Wyrm Hoard
cards.description: You cannot capture a piece worth more than the piece you capture it with. Capturing the king is always allowed.

cards.name: Glorious Battle
cards.description: On a midgame move drawn at random, the battle begins: for 3 consecutive moves you must capture, or lose.

cards.name: Guerilla Tactics
cards.description: After a capturing move, you must return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible.

cards.name: Hobbled Queen
cards.description: Your queen can only move one square at a time, like a second king.

cards.name: Hopscotch
cards.description: Must alternate light/dark destination squares. The required destination color is shown each turn.

cards.name: Horse Eats First
cards.description: As long as you have a knight, you can only capture with knights. This activates only after your move 3.

cards.name: Icy Squares
cards.description: Starting on move 4, after you move a piece it must slide once more in the same direction on your next move (if possible). Forced slides don't force another.

cards.name: Left for Dead
cards.description: Can only capture leftward (file decreasing).

cards.name: Left to Right
cards.description: Unless you just moved to the rightmost file, must move right of your last move's destination. If no rightward move exists, a king move is allowed.

cards.name: Medusa
cards.description: Pieces attacked by opponent's queen are stone; they cannot move.

cards.name: My Kingdom for a Horse
cards.description: If opponent captures a knight of yours, you lose.

cards.name: No Clean Trades
cards.description: You can't make a capture if the enemy could immediately recapture on that square. No card effect can make such a capture legal.

cards.name: Paranoid
cards.description: Your king must always be defended, or you lose. Any piece of yours can be the defender, including pieces a card spawns or teleports in.

cards.name: Reconnaissance
cards.description: Start unable to capture. After seeing each opponent piece type move, you may capture that type.

cards.name: Rook Fan Club
cards.description: Must promote to rooks. King/queen can't move diagonally.

cards.name: Rooks Charge
cards.description: Your rooks can only move straight forward toward the enemy, never sideways or backward. If that leaves you with no legal move, you may move your king instead.

cards.name: Savior Complex
cards.description: When in check, must move your queen, or lose.

cards.name: The Scent of Blood
cards.description: Any of your pieces that has a capture available can't make a non-capturing move; if you move that piece, it must capture. You may still move a different piece that has no capture. No card effect can grant such a piece a quiet move it would otherwise be denied.

cards.name: Siege
cards.description: You must capture at least one enemy rook by move 20. Miss the deadline and you get a one turn warning; if you still have no rook by move 21, you lose.

cards.name: Simon Says
cards.description: Must move onto same color square as opponent's last move.

cards.name: Simp
cards.description: You lose if you have no queen.

cards.name: Spread Out
cards.description: Can't move a non-pawn adjacent to another of your non-pawns. Can't castle.

cards.name: Stay-at-Home Mom
cards.description: Your queen can only move within your two home ranks.

cards.name: Taking Turns
cards.description: Can't move a piece a second time until every piece of its type has moved once. A piece a card spawns or teleports in obeys the restriction at once: it counts as an unmoved piece of its type until it makes its own move.

cards.name: Toothless Pawns
cards.description: Your pawns can never capture and can never move two squares.

cards.name: Tribute
cards.description: Every 8th turn, if you can push a pawn onto a square the enemy attacks, you must. This forced tribute cannot be dodged by card-granted moves.

cards.name: True Love
cards.description: King and queen can only move to squares adjacent to each other.

cards.name: Turn the Other Cheek
cards.description: Can't recapture.

cards.name: Windup Toys
cards.description: After move 12, can't move knights or bishops.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.description: You lose if your king ever has no friendly piece adjacent to it (after your first move).

cards.name: Deadline
cards.description: You must capture an enemy queen by your 25th move, or you lose. Any enemy queen counts, including one created or spawned mid-game.

cards.name: Gravity
cards.description: None of your pieces may move more than two ranks ahead of your own king, unless the piece already starts more than two ranks ahead (a piece inside the region may move freely).

cards.name: Weigh Station
cards.description: Your rooks and queen can't cross into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

cards.name: You Best Not Miss
cards.description: If you end your turn giving check, you must capture the king next turn or lose.

cards.name: Champing at the Bit
cards.description: All pawn moves must be distance 2.

cards.name: No Restraint
cards.description: From your 4th move on, if you can capture you must, and if any available capture also gives check, you must make a checking capture.

cards.name: Constriction
cards.description: Every 6 of your turns, the playable board loses a rank from the back, up to 3 ranks. This restriction cannot be overridden by card effects.

cards.name: Deer in the Headlights
cards.description: From your fourth move onward, you can't move pieces that are currently under attack. Your first three moves are free so the opening cannot be soft-locked.

cards.name: Defanged Queen
cards.description: Your queen can't capture and can't give check.

cards.name: Domino
cards.description: Each move must end adjacent to your previous move's destination. Spawned and teleported pieces obey this immediately.

cards.name: Drag
cards.description: Your queen is now royal: if it is captured, you lose.

cards.name: Echo Chamber
cards.description: Starting on move 4, you must move to the same rank as your last move's destination.

cards.name: Eye for an Eye
cards.description: If opponent captures, you must capture next turn or lose.

cards.name: Fischer Random Endgame
cards.description: By move 20, all your non-pawns must be on home row AND on a square they couldn't have started on. Pieces a card spawns or teleports in must comply too.

cards.name: Lich Pact
cards.description: From your sixth move on, you lose if 6 of your turns pass in a row without one of your pieces ending its move in the enemy half of the board.

cards.name: Iron Curtain
cards.description: You can't move any piece onto the central 16 squares (files c through f, ranks 3 through 6). Card-granted drops and teleports onto those squares are blocked the same way.

cards.name: Ivory Tower
cards.description: You lose if any opponent piece is adjacent to your king.

cards.name: Leaps and Bounds
cards.description: Every move must be a leap: a piece can't move to a square adjacent to the square it's leaving. A move granted by another card must also be a leap.

cards.name: No Hanging Pieces
cards.description: You can't make a move that leaves any of your pieces attacked by the enemy and undefended. Card-granted drops and teleports must obey this too.

cards.name: No Man's Land
cards.description: You can't move any piece onto a square your opponent currently attacks, except once per game you may step onto an attacked square.

cards.name: Noble Steed
cards.description: Non-knight pieces can only move if adjacent to one of your knights.

cards.name: Shield Wall

terms.note: bound to the previous sentence / permanent / unconditional

cards.description: Your king must always end your turn with at least one of your own pawns adjacent to him, or you lose. If the shield is broken on the opponent's turn, you get one move to restore it.

cards.name: Onward Only
cards.description: From your 4th move on, none of your pieces may move backward toward your own back rank.

cards.name: Pawn Storm
cards.description: If your last move wasn't a pawn move, you must move a pawn (if possible).

cards.name: Pilgrimage
cards.description: Your king must reach the opposite back rank by move 30.

cards.name: Relentless Hunter
cards.description: You must give check on every turn you are able to. No card effect can grant a move that escapes this.

cards.name: Rising Water
cards.description: Every 10 of your turns, water rises one rank from your back rank. You can't move underwater pieces or to underwater squares.

cards.name: Stand Your Ground
cards.description: Pieces can only capture if attacked.

cards.name: Torchlight
cards.description: Non-pawns can only move if start or end square is adjacent to one of your pawns.

cards.name: Tower Defense
cards.description: Can't move rooks. If you lose all rooks, you lose.

cards.name: Unspooling
cards.description: Total move distance budget = 100. When you run out, you lose.

cards.name: Velociraptor
cards.description: Can only capture a piece type if opponent moved that type in their last 3 moves. A piece a card spawns or teleports in obeys this at once.

cards.name: Daisy Chain
cards.description: From your 4th move on, the piece you move must start its move adjacent to the square your last move ended on (if any such move exists).

cards.name: King's Leash
cards.description: You can't move any piece to a square more than 3 king-steps from your own king. If no compliant move exists, only your king may move.

cards.name: Pin Cushion
cards.description: You lose if you end one of your turns with two or more of your pieces (other than the king) attacked by the enemy at once.

cards.name: Regicide Clock
cards.description: You must give check at least once every 6 of your turns, or you lose.

cards.name: Always Check, It Might Be Mate
cards.description: If you are checked, you lose. A temporary shield or suspension can't spare you: the check is read straight from the board.

cards.name: Boastful
cards.description: You lose if you end one of your turns with fewer pieces than your opponent.

cards.name: Bottled Lightning
cards.description: If your king can move forward or sideways, it must, and it may never move backward toward your own side. When every king move would go backward you may move another piece instead, but the move right after any non-king move must be a king move.

cards.name: Counting Sheep
cards.description: Once you've moved a piece type 5 times, you can't move it again.

cards.name: Eat Your Vegetables
cards.description: Can't capture non-pawns until opponent has ≤ 4 pawns remaining.

cards.name: Titan's Yoke
cards.description: On every second turn of yours, you must move your king if it has a legal move.

cards.name: Fog of War
cards.description: Enemy pieces are hidden by fog. An enemy piece is marked (its square lit) only if it is checking your king or stands within two squares of one of your pieces; everything else stays hidden.

cards.name: Glass King
cards.description: From your move 10 on, your king is exiled from his own back two ranks: he must leave them if he is still there, may never step back onto them, and from that move any check anywhere on the board loses instantly.

cards.name: Hoarder
cards.description: If you ever have fewer than 8 pawns, you lose the game. Every pawn loss counts, including self-removal and forced card sacrifices.

cards.name: Hold Them Back
cards.description: You lose the moment any enemy pawn reaches your half of the board.

cards.name: Homeland Security
cards.description: If opponent enters your two home ranks, you lose.

cards.name: No Retreat Ever
cards.description: Every move you make must advance toward the enemy; no piece may move backward or even hold its rank, except one non-advancing move is allowed once per game.

cards.name: Nurturer
cards.description: Can't capture the enemy king until you've promoted a pawn. No card effect can make that capture legal any sooner.

cards.name: Pyrrhic Victories
cards.description: Any of your pieces that captures turns to stone and can never move again; a petrified piece can still be captured by your opponent. Your king is immune to the curse.

cards.name: Own Half Only
cards.description: You can't move any piece past your own fourth rank; the enemy half of the board is off limits. Spawned pieces and teleports can't bypass the boundary either.

cards.name: Pawns Do the Dirty Work
cards.description: Only your pawns may capture; none of your other pieces can capture.

cards.name: Respectful
cards.description: You can't end your turn giving check. Once per game, if every legal move would give check, you may give check that one time.

cards.name: Serf Labor
cards.description: You can only move your pawns and your king. No other piece may ever move.

cards.name: Straight and Narrow
cards.description: You can't make any diagonal move: your bishops are stuck, your queen moves only like a rook, and your pawns can't capture.

cards.name: Total Pacifism
cards.description: You can never capture an enemy piece, except the king to win. No card effect can capture on your behalf either, except one that captures the king.

cards.name: Wagon Train
cards.description: Keep the wagons together: each move must land within one file and one rank of your previous move's destination. A knight may leap out of the convoy only on a turn when no such move exists.

cards.name: War Footing
cards.description: You lose if you make more than 12 non-capturing moves all game.

cards.name: Bottom Feeder
cards.description: You can only capture pawns. You can't capture any other piece, except the enemy king to win.

cards.name: Glass Army
cards.description: You lose the moment the opponent captures any of your non-pawn pieces (knight, bishop, rook, or queen).

cards.name: Kingpin
cards.description: Only your king may capture. No other piece can make a capture. If no compliant move exists, only your king may move.

cards.name: Perfect Defense
cards.description: You can't make any move that leaves one of your pieces (other than the king) standing on a square the enemy attacks, even if it is defended.

cards.name: Royal Meridian
cards.description: Every piece you move must land on your king's file or your king's rank. If no compliant move exists, only your king may move.
